```text
func TestHostingStorageArchiveCompiledRunnerHTTPS(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("NEROCD_STORAGE_ARCHIVE_RUNTIME") != "disposable-dind" {
		t.Skip("requires explicit archive storage runtime gate")
	}
	testHostingStorageCompiledRunnerHTTPS(t, true)
}

func storageRuntimeConfigureArchive(t *testing.T, f *storageRuntimeFixture, pg *store.PostgresStore) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("/fixture/archive-helper.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var helper domain.HostingStorageArchiveHelper
	if domain.DecodeHostingStorageArchiveJSON(raw, &helper) != nil || helper.Validate() != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid exact local helper descriptor")
	}
	actual := strings.TrimSpace(string(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "info", "--format", "{{.ID}} {{.OSType}} {{.Architecture}}")))
	if actual != helper.DaemonID+" linux aarch64" {
		t.Fatal("archive fixture helper daemon/profile mismatch")
	}
	roots := []string{filepath.Join(f.root, "archive-artifacts"), filepath.Join(f.root, "archive-temporary")}
	for _, root := range roots {
		if err := os.Mkdir(root, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	raw, err = json.Marshal(struct {
		Version       int                                `json:"version"`
		ArtifactRoot  string                             `json:"artifact_root"`
		TemporaryRoot string                             `json:"temporary_root"`
		DockerBinary  string                             `json:"docker_binary"`
		Helper        domain.HostingStorageArchiveHelper `json:"helper"`
	}{1, roots[0], roots[1], "/usr/local/bin/docker", helper})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.archiveConfig = filepath.Join(f.root, "archive-config.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(f.archiveConfig, raw, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	limits := domain.HostingStorageArchiveLimits{ArchiveBytes: 1 << 20, DataBytes: 512 << 10, FileBytes: 128 << 10, Members: 1000, Depth: 32, PathBytes: 255}
	if err := pg.ConfigureStorageArchive(&helper, limits); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("archive configured source=%s executable=%s image=%s platform=%s/%s daemon=%s helper=%s", helper.SourceCommit, helper.ExecutableSHA256, helper.ImageID, helper.OS, helper.Architecture, helper.DaemonID, helper.Hash)
}

func storageArchiveRuntimeLose(f *storageRuntimeFixture, fault *storageRuntimeFault, operation string) runner.JournalStorageArchive {
	f.t.Helper()
	select {
	case <-fault.entered:
	case <-time.After(90 * time.Second):
		f.t.Fatal("archive committed completion fault did not enter", f.logs.String())
	}
	f.stop()
	select {
	case <-fault.finished:
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		f.t.Fatal("archive fault handler did not join")
	}
	journal, err := runner.OpenAttemptJournal(filepath.Join(f.root, "journal"))
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot := journal.Snapshot()
	if err := journal.Close(); err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, entry := range snapshot.StorageArchive {
		if entry.Plan.OperationID == operation && entry.Complete != nil {
			f.t.Logf("durable archive completion operation=%s receipt=%s result=%s resume=%s", operation, entry.ID, entry.Complete.Result.ArchiveOutcome, entry.Complete.Result.ResumeOutcome)
			if entry.Complete.Result.FailureCode == "helper_failed" {
				storageArchiveHelperFailureProfile(f, entry, snapshot.StorageArchive)
			}
			return entry
		}
	}
	f.t.Fatal("archive completion missing from private durable journal")
	return runner.JournalStorageArchive{}
}

// Inspect only the exact uncertain ID already retained by this owned attempt.
// Diagnostics contain closed comparisons, never raw Docker configuration or authority.
func storageArchiveHelperFailureProfile(f *storageRuntimeFixture, complete runner.JournalStorageArchive, entries []runner.JournalStorageArchive) {
	f.t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("NEROCD_STORAGE_ARCHIVE_RUNTIME") != "disposable-dind" || !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(f.root), storageRuntimeOwner+"-") {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: fixture ownership missing")
		return
	}
	var uncertain *runner.JournalStorageArchive
	for i := range entries {
		e := &entries[i]
		if e.Phase == "helper_unverified" && e.Authority() == complete.Authority() && reflect.DeepEqual(e.Plan, complete.Plan) {
			if uncertain != nil {
				f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: ambiguous durable identity")
				return
			}
			uncertain = e
		}
	}
	if uncertain == nil {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: no exact unverified ID")
		return
	}
	p := uncertain.Plan
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte("archive\x00" + uncertain.Attempt.LeaseID + "\x00" + fmt.Sprint(uncertain.Attempt.Attempt) + "\x00helper_intent"))
	nonce := fmt.Sprintf("archive_%x", sum[:16])
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	inspect := func(args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
		return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "/usr/local/bin/docker", append([]string{"--host", "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"}, args...)...).Output()
	}
	daemon, err := inspect("info", "--format", "{{.ID}}")
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(string(daemon)) != p.Helper.DaemonID {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: daemon mismatch")
		return
	}
	raw, err := inspect("container", "inspect", uncertain.UncertainHelperContainerID)
	var objects []map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &objects) != nil || len(objects) != 1 {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: exact inspection failed")
		return
	}
	var id, image string
	var config, host, state map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["Id"], &id) != nil || json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["Image"], &image) != nil || json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["Config"], &config) != nil || json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["HostConfig"], &host) != nil || json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["State"], &state) != nil {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: malformed profile")
		return
	}
	labels := map[string]string{"io.nerocd.storage-archive.recipe": "scratch-v1", "io.nerocd.storage-archive.source-commit": p.Helper.SourceCommit, "io.nerocd.storage-archive.executable-sha256": strings.TrimPrefix(p.Helper.ExecutableSHA256, "sha256:"), "io.nerocd.archive.operation": p.OperationID, "io.nerocd.archive.plan": p.Hash, "io.nerocd.archive.nonce": nonce, "io.nerocd.archive.daemon": p.Helper.DaemonID, "io.nerocd.archive.helper": p.Helper.Hash, "io.nerocd.archive.mode": p.Mode, "io.nerocd.archive.source": p.SourceStorage.Hash}
	if p.Target != nil {
		labels["io.nerocd.archive.target"] = p.Target.Storage.Hash
	}
	match := func(raw json.RawMessage, expected any) bool {
		var got, want any
		encoded, marshalErr := json.Marshal(expected)
		return marshalErr == nil && json.Unmarshal(raw, &got) == nil && json.Unmarshal(encoded, &want) == nil && reflect.DeepEqual(got, want)
	}
	if id != uncertain.UncertainHelperContainerID || image != p.Helper.ImageID || !match(config["Labels"], labels) {
		f.t.Log("archive helper diagnostic unavailable: operation/plan/nonce/image ownership mismatch")
		return
	}
	mode, caps := "create", []string{"DAC_READ_SEARCH"}
	if p.Mode == "restore" {
		mode, caps = "restore", []string{"CHOWN", "FOWNER"}
	}
	l := p.Limits
	command := []string{mode, fmt.Sprintf("--max-archive-bytes=%d", l.ArchiveBytes), fmt.Sprintf("--max-data-bytes=%d", l.DataBytes), fmt.Sprintf("--max-file-bytes=%d", l.FileBytes), fmt.Sprintf("--max-members=%d", l.Members), fmt.Sprintf("--max-depth=%d", l.Depth), fmt.Sprintf("--max-path-bytes=%d", l.PathBytes)}
	memory := l.ArchiveBytes + (128 << 20)
	groups := map[string]struct {
		actual   map[string]json.RawMessage
		expected map[string]any
	}{
		"config": {config, map[string]any{"Cmd": command, "Entrypoint": []string{"/nerocd-storage-archive"}, "Env": []string{"PATH=/", "HOME=/"}, "User": "0:0", "Hostname": "nerocd-archive", "Tty": false}},
		"host":   {host, map[string]any{"ReadonlyRootfs": true, "Privileged": false, "PublishAllPorts": false, "AutoRemove": false, "NetworkMode": "none", "PidMode": "", "IpcMode": "private", "UsernsMode": "", "UTSMode": "", "CgroupnsMode": "private", "CapDrop": []string{"ALL"}, "CapAdd": caps, "SecurityOpt": []string{"no-new-privileges"}, "Memory": memory, "MemorySwap": memory, "NanoCpus": int64(1000000000), "PidsLimit": 64, "Tmpfs": map[string]string{"/tmp": fmt.Sprintf("rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=%d,mode=1777", l.ArchiveBytes+(32<<20))}}},
		"state":  {state, map[string]any{"Running": false, "Status": "created", "Dead": false, "OOMKilled": false}},
	}
	for name, group := range groups {
		checks := map[string]bool{}
		for key, expected := range group.expected {
			checks[key] = match(group.actual[key], expected)
		}
		f.t.Logf("archive helper closed profile %s matches=%v", name, checks)
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"Binds", "VolumesFrom", "PortBindings", "Devices", "DeviceRequests", "GroupAdd"} {
		var value any
		valid := json.Unmarshal(host[key], &value) == nil
		empty := value == nil
		switch v := value.(type) {
		case []any:
			empty = len(v) == 0
		case map[string]any:
			empty = len(v) == 0
		}
		f.t.Logf("archive helper closed profile host.%s empty=%t", key, valid && empty)
	}
	var runtime string
	var logs, restart map[string]json.RawMessage
	_ = json.Unmarshal(host["Runtime"], &runtime)
	_ = json.Unmarshal(host["LogConfig"], &logs)
	_ = json.Unmarshal(host["RestartPolicy"], &restart)
	f.t.Logf("archive helper closed profile runtime=%t log_driver=%t restart=%t name=%t", runtime == "" || runtime == "runc", match(logs["Type"], "none"), match(restart["Name"], "no"), match(objects[0]["Name"], "/ncd_archive_"+domain.HostingDocumentHash(struct{ Operation, Plan, Nonce string }{p.OperationID, p.Hash, nonce})[7:39]))
	var mounts []struct {
		Type, Name, Driver, Source, Destination string
		RW                                      bool
	}
	volume, destination, writable := p.SourceStorage.VolumeName, "/source", false
	if p.Target != nil {
		volume, destination, writable = p.Target.Storage.VolumeName, "/target", true
	}
	root, rootErr := inspect("info", "--format", "{{.DockerRootDir}}")
	mountOK := rootErr == nil && json.Unmarshal(objects[0]["Mounts"], &mounts) == nil && len(mounts) <= 2
	volumeCount := 0
	for _, mount := range mounts {
		if mount.Type == "tmpfs" && mount.Destination == "/tmp" && mount.RW {
			continue
		}
		volumeCount++
		mountOK = mountOK && mount.Type == "volume" && mount.Name == volume && mount.Driver == "local" && mount.Destination == destination && mount.RW == writable && mount.Source == filepath.Join(strings.TrimSpace(string(root)), "volumes", volume, "_data")
	}
	f.t.Logf("archive helper closed profile mounts=%t", mountOK && volumeCount == 1)
	for _, key := range []string{"CapAdd", "CapDrop", "SecurityOpt"} {
		var values []string
		if json.Unmarshal(host[key], &values) == nil {
			for i, value := range values {
				switch value {
				case "ALL", "DAC_READ_SEARCH", "CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH", "CHOWN", "CAP_CHOWN", "FOWNER", "CAP_FOWNER", "no-new-privileges", "no-new-privileges=true":
				default:
					values[i] = "other"
				}
			}
			f.t.Logf("archive helper closed profile host.%s observed=%v", key, values)
		}
	}
}

func storageArchiveRuntimeReplay(f *storageRuntimeFixture, operation string, before int64) {
	f.t.Helper()
	f.start()
	for deadline := time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second); f.archiveCompletions.Load() <= before; {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			f.t.Fatal("archive saved completion was not replayed")
		}
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	f.await(operation, "succeeded")
}

func storageArchiveWriterRunning(t *testing.T, id string) bool {
	t.Helper()
	var inspected []struct {
		ID    string `json:"Id"`
		State struct{ Running bool }
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "container", "inspect", id), &inspected); err != nil || len(inspected) != 1 || inspected[0].ID != id {
		t.Fatal("exact archive writer inspection failed", err)
	}
	return inspected[0].State.Running
}

func storageArchiveFileEvidence(t *testing.T, volume string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var inspected []struct{ Name, Mountpoint string }
	if err := json.Unmarshal(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "volume", "inspect", volume), &inspected); err != nil || len(inspected) != 1 || inspected[0].Name != volume {
		t.Fatal("archive metadata volume inspect", err)
	}
	directory := inspected[0].Mountpoint
	var evidence strings.Builder
	for _, relative := range []string{"saved", "nested", "nested/probe"} {
		info, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(directory, relative))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("numeric ownership unavailable")
		}
		size := info.Size()
		if info.IsDir() {
			size = 0
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&evidence, "%s:%d:%d:%04o:%d;", relative, stat.Uid, stat.Gid, info.Mode().Perm(), size)
	}
	return evidence.String()
}

// Count immutable helper lifecycle events rather than container names: completed
// helpers are intentionally removed, and a lost ACK must not create a second one.
func storageArchiveHelperStarts(t *testing.T, operation, since string) int {
	t.Helper()
	raw := storageRuntimeDocker(t, "events", "--since", since, "--until", time.Now().Add(time.Second).Format(time.RFC3339Nano), "--filter", "type=container", "--filter", "event=start", "--filter", "label=io.nerocd.archive.operation="+operation, "--format", "{{json .}}")
	var count int
	for _, line := range bytes.Split(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("\n")) {
		if len(line) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		var event struct {
			Actor struct {
				ID         string
				Attributes map[string]string
			}
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(line, &event) != nil || event.Actor.Attributes["io.nerocd.archive.operation"] != operation || len(event.Actor.ID) != 64 {
			t.Fatal("invalid exact helper event")
		}
		count++
	}
	return count
}

func storageRuntimeArchiveRoundtrip(t *testing.T, f *storageRuntimeFixture, resource domain.Resource, source domain.HostingStorage, origin domain.HostingStorageMaterializedRequest, a, b domain.HostingOperation, upload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	if storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, a.Result.ContainerID) || !storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, b.Result.ContainerID) {
		t.Fatal("backup fixture does not preserve original stopped/running inventory")
	}
	f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "POST", "/metadata", nil, 204)
	sourceMetadata := storageArchiveFileEvidence(t, source.VolumeName)
	if !strings.Contains(sourceMetadata, "saved:12345:12346:0640:") || !strings.Contains(sourceMetadata, "nested:12345:12346:0750:") {
		t.Fatal("nontrivial ownership/mode fixture missing", sourceMetadata)
	}
	since := time.Now().Add(-time.Second).Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	fault := f.arm("/api/v1/runners/hosting/storage-archive/complete")
	backup := storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingStorageBackup](f, "POST", "/api/v1/resources/"+resource.ID+"/storage-backups", domain.HostingStorageBackupInput{RequestID: strings.Repeat("a", 32), ExpectedResourceGeneration: resource.Generation}, 202)
	entry := storageArchiveRuntimeLose(f, fault, backup.OperationID)
	if entry.Complete.Result.ArchiveOutcome != "succeeded" || entry.Complete.Result.ResumeOutcome != "resumed" || entry.Complete.Result.Uncertain || entry.Complete.Result.Blob == nil {
		t.Fatal("backup did not complete before ACK loss", entry.Complete.Result)
	}
	var accepted domain.HostingOperation
	if json.Unmarshal(fault.response, &accepted) != nil || accepted.CompleteReceipt == nil || accepted.CompleteReceipt.BodyHash != domain.HostingDocumentHash(*entry.Complete) {
		t.Fatal("backup exact committed receipt missing")
	}
	if starts := storageArchiveHelperStarts(t, backup.OperationID, since); starts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("backup helper starts=%d want1", starts)
	}
	requests := f.archiveCompletions.Load()
	storageArchiveRuntimeReplay(f, backup.OperationID, requests)
	if starts := storageArchiveHelperStarts(t, backup.OperationID, since); starts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("backup completion replay repeated helper starts=%d", starts)
	}
	if got := f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "GET", "/download", nil, 200); !bytes.Equal(got, upload) {
		t.Fatal("source upload changed after backup")
	}
	if storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, a.Result.ContainerID) || !storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, b.Result.ContainerID) {
		t.Fatal("backup changed originally-stopped writer")
	}
	backup = storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingStorageBackup](f, "GET", "/api/v1/storage-backups/"+backup.ID, nil, 200)
	if backup.Blob == nil || backup.State != "succeeded" {
		t.Fatal("public backup metadata did not settle")
	}
	restoreLoss := f.arm("/api/v1/runners/hosting/storage-archive/complete")
	restored := storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingStorageRestore](f, "POST", "/api/v1/storage-backups/"+backup.ID+"/restores", domain.HostingStorageRestoreInput{RequestID: strings.Repeat("b", 32), Name: "restored uploads"}, 202)
	if restored.Storage.ID == source.ID || restored.Storage.VolumeName == source.VolumeName || restored.Resource.ID == resource.ID {
		t.Fatal("restore reused original identity")
	}
	restoreEntry := storageArchiveRuntimeLose(f, restoreLoss, restored.Operation.ID)
	if !restoreEntry.Complete.Result.RestoreVerified || !reflect.DeepEqual(restoreEntry.Complete.Result.Blob, backup.Blob) || restoreEntry.Complete.Result.Uncertain {
		t.Fatal("restore did not verify original immutable archive")
	}
	targetMetadata := storageArchiveFileEvidence(t, restored.Storage.VolumeName)
	if targetMetadata != sourceMetadata {
		t.Fatal("restored UID/GID/modes differ", sourceMetadata, targetMetadata)
	}
	targetCreated := strings.TrimSpace(string(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "volume", "inspect", "--format", "{{.CreatedAt}}", restored.Storage.VolumeName)))
	requests = f.archiveCompletions.Load()
	storageArchiveRuntimeReplay(f, restored.Operation.ID, requests)
	if storageArchiveHelperStarts(t, restored.Operation.ID, since) != 1 || strings.TrimSpace(string(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "volume", "inspect", "--format", "{{.CreatedAt}}", restored.Storage.VolumeName))) != targetCreated {
		t.Fatal("restore replay repeated extraction or recreated volume")
	}
	deployed := f.await(f.deploy(restored.Resource, "restore-ordinary-deploy", "/", 20104, nil).ID, "succeeded")
	if deployed.Result == nil || !deployed.Result.Ready {
		t.Fatal("ordinary restored application deploy not ready")
	}
	storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingHostnameGrant](f, "POST", "/api/v1/servers/"+f.serverID+"/proxy/hostname-grants", domain.HostingHostnameGrantInput{ProjectID: "proj_platform", Hostname: "storage-restored.example.test"}, 201)
	route := storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingRoute](f, "POST", "/api/v1/resources/"+restored.Resource.ID+"/routes", domain.HostingRouteInput{IdempotencyKey: "restored-route", Hostname: "storage-restored.example.test", PathPrefix: "/", ExpectedHealthyOperationID: deployed.ID}, 202)
	f.proxyAwait(route.OperationID)
	if got := f.https("storage-restored.example.test", "GET", "/download", nil, 200); !bytes.Equal(got, upload) {
		t.Fatal("restored application did not read old upload")
	}
	replacement := make([]byte, 65539)
	if _, err := rand.Read(replacement); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.https("storage-restored.example.test", "PUT", "/upload", replacement, 201)
	f.https("storage-restored.example.test", "POST", "/rename", nil, 204)
	if got := f.https("storage-restored.example.test", "GET", "/download", nil, 200); !bytes.Equal(got, replacement) {
		t.Fatal("restored application did not write/read new upload")
	}
	if got := f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "GET", "/download", nil, 200); !bytes.Equal(got, upload) {
		t.Fatal("restored writes changed source volume")
	}
	if storageArchiveFileEvidence(t, source.VolumeName) != sourceMetadata {
		t.Fatal("source ownership or modes changed during restore")
	}
	// A bounded oversized file is created by the ordinary application. The helper
	// must fail after the acknowledged stopped phase, then safely resume B only.
	f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "POST", "/oversize", nil, 201)
	failedBackup := storageRuntimeJSON[domain.HostingStorageBackup](f, "POST", "/api/v1/resources/"+resource.ID+"/storage-backups", domain.HostingStorageBackupInput{RequestID: strings.Repeat("c", 32), ExpectedResourceGeneration: resource.Generation}, 202)
	failed := f.await(failedBackup.OperationID, "failed")
	if failed.StorageArchive == nil || failed.StorageArchive.Result == nil || failed.StorageArchive.Result.ArchiveOutcome != "failed" || failed.StorageArchive.Result.ResumeOutcome != "resumed" || failed.StorageArchive.Result.Uncertain || failed.MutationHold {
		t.Fatal("failed backup did not truthfully settle compensated writers", failed.StorageArchive)
	}
	phases := map[string]bool{}
	for _, p := range failed.StorageArchive.Progress {
		phases[p.Phase] = true
	}
	if !phases["stopped"] || !phases["helper_identified"] || !phases["resumed"] || phases["archive_published"] {
		t.Fatal("failure did not occur after quiescence/before publication", phases)
	}
	if storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, a.Result.ContainerID) || !storageArchiveWriterRunning(t, b.Result.ContainerID) {
		t.Fatal("failed backup resumed originally-stopped writer or left B stopped")
	}
	f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "DELETE", "/oversize", nil, 204)
	if got := f.https("storage-runtime.example.test", "GET", "/download", nil, 200); !bytes.Equal(got, upload) {
		t.Fatal("failed backup changed serving upload")
	}
	if leftovers := strings.TrimSpace(string(storageRuntimeDocker(t, "ps", "-aq", "--filter", "label=io.nerocd.archive.helper"))); leftovers != "" {
		t.Fatal("archive helper remains after settlement", leftovers)
	}
	t.Logf("physical archive backup=%s restore=%s failed_backup=%s source_volume=%s restored_volume=%s source_upload=%x restored_new_upload=%x source_metadata=%s helper_backup_starts=1 helper_restore_starts=1 source_origin=%s", backup.OperationID, restored.Operation.ID, failedBackup.OperationID, source.VolumeName, restored.Storage.VolumeName, sha256.Sum256(upload), sha256.Sum256(replacement), sourceMetadata, origin.CreationOperationID)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"

	"nerocd/internal/auth"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// ServerInput associates one eligible enrolled runner with a stable server.
type ServerInput struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	RunnerID string `json:"runner_id"`
}

// ServerDetail pairs a server with its immutable default destination.
type ServerDetail struct {
	Server      domain.Server      `json:"server"`
	Destination domain.Destination `json:"destination"`
}

// DestinationProjectInput selects a project for an explicit grant or revocation.
type DestinationProjectInput struct {
	ProjectID string `json:"project_id"`
}

// ResourceBindingInput selects desired placement without accepting project scope or a namespace.
type ResourceBindingInput struct {
	DestinationID string `json:"destination_id"`
}

var destinationIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$`)

func validateDestinationID(value, field string) error {
	if !destinationIDPattern.MatchString(value) {
		return InvalidInput(errors.New(field + " must contain 1 to 128 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens"))
	}
	return nil
}
func (s *Service) requireDestinationAdmin(ctx context.Context) (auth.Principal, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	if !isRunnerAdmin(principal) {
		return auth.Principal{}, auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	return principal, nil
}
func (s *Service) destinationProjectExists(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	projects, err := s.projects.ListProjects(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, project := range projects {
		if project.ID == id && project.ArchivedAt == nil {
			return nil
		}
	}
	return store.ErrNotFound
}

// CreateServer atomically admits an enrolled Compose runner, default destination, and audit.
func (s *Service) CreateServer(ctx context.Context, in ServerInput) (ServerDetail, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	in.Name = strings.TrimSpace(in.Name)
	in.RunnerID = strings.TrimSpace(in.RunnerID)
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingName(in.Name); err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(in.RunnerID, "runner_id"); err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	// Missing identity is a lookup error. Eligibility remains atomic in the repository.
	if _, err = s.runners.GetRunnerByID(ctx, in.RunnerID); err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	serverID, err := prefixedID("server")
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	destinationID, err := prefixedID("dest")
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	now := s.clock().UTC()
	server := domain.Server{ID: serverID, Name: in.Name, RunnerID: in.RunnerID, CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: now}
	destination := domain.Destination{ID: destinationID, ServerID: serverID, Name: "default", RuntimeKind: "docker_compose", CreatedAt: now}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "server.created", serverID, map[string]any{"runner_id": in.RunnerID, "destination_id": destinationID})
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	created, target, err := s.destinations.CreateServerWithDestination(ctx, server, destination, event)
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	return ServerDetail{Server: created, Destination: target}, nil
}

// ListServers returns global server metadata only to runner administrators.
func (s *Service) ListServers(ctx context.Context, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.Server], error) {
	if _, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Server]{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.ListServers(ctx, page)
}

// GetServer returns the stable server and default destination without runtime credentials.
func (s *Service) GetServer(ctx context.Context, id string) (ServerDetail, error) {
	if _, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx); err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	if err := validateDestinationID(id, "server_id"); err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	server, err := s.destinations.GetServer(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	destinations, err := s.destinations.ListDestinations(ctx, id, store.Page{Enabled: true, LimitSpecified: true, Limit: 1})
	if err != nil {
		return ServerDetail{}, err
	}
	if len(destinations.Items) != 1 {
		return ServerDetail{}, store.ErrNotFound
	}
	return ServerDetail{Server: server, Destination: destinations.Items[0]}, nil
}

// ListDestinations requires exactly one project scope or administrative server scope.
func (s *Service) ListDestinations(ctx context.Context, projectID, serverID string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.Destination], error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
	}
	projectID = strings.TrimSpace(projectID)
	serverID = strings.TrimSpace(serverID)
	if (projectID == "") == (serverID == "") {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("exactly one of project_id or server_id is required"))
	}
	if projectID != "" {
		if err := validateDestinationID(projectID, "project_id"); err != nil {
			return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
		}
		if _, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, projectID, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
			return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
		}
		return s.destinations.ListProjectDestinations(ctx, projectID, page)
	}
	if _, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
	}
	if err := validateDestinationID(serverID, "server_id"); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
	}
	if _, err := s.destinations.GetServer(ctx, serverID); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Destination]{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.ListDestinations(ctx, serverID, page)
}

// ListDestinationProjectGrants includes retained revocations for global administrators.
func (s *Service) ListDestinationProjectGrants(ctx context.Context, id string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.DestinationProjectGrant], error) {
	if _, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.DestinationProjectGrant]{}, err
	}
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	if err := validateDestinationID(id, "destination_id"); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.DestinationProjectGrant]{}, err
	}
	if _, err := s.destinations.GetDestination(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.DestinationProjectGrant]{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.ListDestinationProjectGrants(ctx, id, page)
}

// GrantDestinationProject explicitly permits new bindings for an active project.
func (s *Service) GrantDestinationProject(ctx context.Context, id string, in DestinationProjectInput) (domain.DestinationProjectGrant, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	in.ProjectID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectID)
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "destination_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(in.ProjectID, "project_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.destinations.GetDestination(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	if err = s.destinationProjectExists(ctx, in.ProjectID); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "destination.project_granted", id, map[string]any{"project_id": in.ProjectID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	grant := domain.DestinationProjectGrant{DestinationID: id, ProjectID: in.ProjectID, GrantedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: s.clock().UTC()}
	return s.destinations.GrantDestinationProject(ctx, grant, event)
}

// RevokeDestinationProject retains bindings and does not stop or remove workloads.
func (s *Service) RevokeDestinationProject(ctx context.Context, id string, in DestinationProjectInput) (domain.DestinationProjectGrant, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	in.ProjectID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectID)
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "destination_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(in.ProjectID, "project_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.destinations.GetDestination(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "destination.project_revoked", id, map[string]any{"project_id": in.ProjectID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DestinationProjectGrant{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.RevokeDestinationProject(ctx, id, in.ProjectID, event)
}
func (s *Service) resourceForDestinationRole(ctx context.Context, id, role string) (domain.Resource, auth.Principal, error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
	if err := validateDestinationID(id, "resource_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	item, err := s.hosting.GetResource(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, item.ProjectID, role)
	return item, principal, err
}

// GetResourceBinding authorizes the resource's persisted project, including retained revoked placements.
func (s *Service) GetResourceBinding(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.ResourceBinding, error) {
	item, _, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.GetResourceBinding(ctx, item.ID)
}

// BindResourceDestination creates one immutable desired placement under the current project grant.
func (s *Service) BindResourceDestination(ctx context.Context, id string, in ResourceBindingInput) (domain.ResourceBinding, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	in.DestinationID = strings.TrimSpace(in.DestinationID)
	if err = validateDestinationID(in.DestinationID, "destination_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.destinations.GetDestination(ctx, in.DestinationID); err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	grant, err := s.destinations.GetDestinationProjectGrant(ctx, in.DestinationID, item.ProjectID)
	if errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	if grant.RevokedAt != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	bindingID, err := prefixedID("binding")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "resource.destination_bound", item.ID, map[string]any{"project_id": item.ProjectID, "destination_id": in.DestinationID, "binding_id": bindingID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ResourceBinding{}, err
	}
	return s.destinations.BindResourceDestination(ctx, store.ResourceBindingInput{ID: bindingID, ResourceID: item.ID, DestinationID: in.DestinationID, CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: s.clock().UTC()}, event)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingbuildprotocol"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

func (s *Service) buildController() (store.HostingBuildControllerRepository, error) {
	controller, ok := s.runs.(store.HostingBuildControllerRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, store.ErrHostingBuildUnavailable
	}
	return controller, nil
}

// RequestHostingBuild accepts Git intent and an optional owner-created source grant.
func (s *Service) RequestHostingBuild(ctx context.Context, resourceID string, in domain.HostingBuildRequest) (domain.PublicHostingBuild, error) {
	resource, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resourceID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	if resource.Source.Kind != "git" || resource.Source.Git == nil || (resource.Source.Git.CredentialKind != "public" && resource.Source.Git.CredentialKind != "https_basic") {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("unsupported Git credential kind"))
	}
	if (resource.Source.Git.CredentialKind == "public") != (in.GrantID == "") || len(in.GrantID) > 128 {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid source grant selection"))
	}
	if in.ExpectedResourceGeneration < 1 || in.ExpectedSourceGeneration < 1 || in.IdempotencyKey == "" || len(in.IdempotencyKey) > 128 || strings.TrimSpace(in.IdempotencyKey) != in.IdempotencyKey || strings.ContainsFunc(in.IdempotencyKey, unicode.IsControl) {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid hosting build request"))
	}
	controller, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("build")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	id = strings.ReplaceAll(id, "_", "-")
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.build.requested", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	b, err := controller.RequestConfiguredHostingBuild(ctx, id, resource.ID, principal.ID, in, audit)
	return domain.PublicBuild(b), err
}

// HostingBuild returns a safe projection under current persisted viewer authority.
func (s *Service) HostingBuild(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.PublicHostingBuild, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "build_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	controller, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	b, err := controller.GetHostingBuild(ctx, principal.ID, id)
	return domain.PublicBuild(b), err
}

// ListHostingBuilds returns bounded retained history for a persisted resource project.
func (s *Service) ListHostingBuilds(ctx context.Context, resourceID string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.PublicHostingBuild], error) {
	var result store.PageResult[domain.PublicHostingBuild]
	resource, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resourceID, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	controller, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	rows, err := controller.ListHostingBuilds(ctx, principal.ID, resource.ID, page)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	result = store.PageResult[domain.PublicHostingBuild]{Items: []domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, Limit: rows.Limit, Offset: rows.Offset, Total: rows.Total}
	for _, b := range rows.Items {
		result.Items = append(result.Items, domain.PublicBuild(b))
	}
	return result, nil
}

// CancelHostingBuild requests bounded cleanup; it never grants another engine attempt.
func (s *Service) CancelHostingBuild(ctx context.Context, id string, revision int64) (domain.PublicHostingBuild, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "build_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	if revision < 1 {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_revision is required"))
	}
	controller, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.build.cancel_requested", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PublicHostingBuild{}, err
	}
	b, err := controller.CancelHostingBuild(ctx, principal.ID, id, revision, audit)
	return domain.PublicBuild(b), err
}

// RunnerHostingBuildStatus returns historical proof separately from live permission.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingBuildStatus(ctx context.Context, in hostingbuildprotocol.StatusRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.StatusResponse, error) {
	p, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.StatusResponse{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.StatusResponse{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	controller, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.StatusResponse{}, err
	}
	return controller.HostingBuildStatus(ctx, p.RunnerID, in.Authority)
}

// RunnerHostingBuildSourceBegin starts a fenced source phase.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingBuildSourceBegin(ctx context.Context, in hostingbuildprotocol.SourceBeginRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error) {
	p, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	c, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	b, err := c.BeginHostingBuildSource(ctx, p.RunnerID, in.Authority, in.ExpectedRevision)
	return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{Build: b}, err
}

// RunnerHostingBuildSourceCommit acknowledges the exact immutable source receipt.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingBuildSourceCommit(ctx context.Context, in hostingbuildprotocol.SourceCommitRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error) {
	p, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	c, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	b, err := c.CommitHostingBuildSource(ctx, p.RunnerID, in.Authority, in.ReceiptID, in.Receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{Build: b, Acknowledgment: &hostingbuildprotocol.ReceiptAcknowledgment{Authority: in.Authority, Phase: "source", ReceiptID: in.ReceiptID, BodyHash: hostingbuildprotocol.SourceReceiptHash(in.Receipt)}}, nil
}

// RunnerHostingBuildPrepare pins observed daemon identity before engine effects.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingBuildPrepare(ctx context.Context, in hostingbuildprotocol.PrepareRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error) {
	p, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	c, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	b, err := c.PrepareHostingBuild(ctx, p.RunnerID, in.Authority, in.ExpectedRevision, in.DaemonID)
	return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{Build: b}, err
}

// RunnerHostingBuildComplete atomically settles typed execution and its exact receipt.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingBuildComplete(ctx context.Context, in hostingbuildprotocol.CompleteRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error) {
	p, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	c, err := s.buildController()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	b, err := c.CompleteHostingBuild(ctx, p.RunnerID, in.Authority, in.ReceiptID, in.ExpectedRevision, store.HostingBuildCompletion{State: in.Completion.State, FailureCode: in.Completion.FailureCode, Artifact: in.Completion.Artifact})
	if err != nil {
		return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{}, err
	}
	phase, _ := hostingbuildprotocol.CompletionPhase(in.Completion)
	return hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse{Build: b, Acknowledgment: &hostingbuildprotocol.ReceiptAcknowledgment{Authority: in.Authority, Phase: phase, ReceiptID: in.ReceiptID, BodyHash: hostingbuildprotocol.CompletionHash(in.Completion)}}, nil
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/base64"
	"errors"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/secretcrypto"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// CreateHostingDatabase generates distinct credentials and seals them before
// the repository atomically commits desired metadata. It never starts an engine.
func (s *Service) CreateHostingDatabase(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingDatabaseCreateInput) (domain.HostingDatabase, error) {
	var zero domain.HostingDatabase
	actor, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return zero, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	if _, err = s.hostingEnvironmentInProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, in.ProjectEnvironmentID); err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	repo, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingDatabaseRepository)
	if !ok {
		return zero, store.ErrHostingDatabaseUnavailable
	}
	if s.secretKeyring == nil {
		return zero, ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable
	}
	recipe, err := domain.HostingDatabaseRecipeFor(in.Engine, in.RecipeVersion)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	resource := domain.HostingDatabaseResourceID(in.ProjectID, in.RequestID)
	now := s.clock().UTC()
	credentials := make([]store.HostingDatabaseCredentialRecord, 0, len(recipe.Credentials))
	for _, ref := range recipe.Credentials {
		ref.SecretID, ref.Version = domain.HostingDatabaseSecretID(resource, ref.Role), 1
		var entropy [32]byte
		if _, err = rand.Read(entropy[:]); err != nil {
			return zero, errors.New("database credential generation failed")
		}
		plaintext := []byte(base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(entropy[:]))
		envelope, sealErr := s.secretKeyring.Seal(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: in.ProjectID, SecretID: ref.SecretID, Version: 1}, plaintext)
		clear(plaintext)
		clear(entropy[:])
		if sealErr != nil {
			return zero, errors.New("database credential encryption failed")
		}
		credentials = append(credentials, store.HostingDatabaseCredentialRecord{Reference: ref, Record: store.ManagedSecretRecord{Metadata: domain.ManagedSecretVersion{SecretID: ref.SecretID, Version: 1, CreatedBy: actor.ID, CreatedAt: now}, Envelope: envelope}})
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor.ID, "hosting.database.created", resource, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	view, err := repo.CreateHostingDatabase(ctx, actor.ID, in, credentials, event)
	if err == nil && (view.Resource.ID != resource || view.Resource.ProjectID != in.ProjectID || view.Resource.Kind != "database" || view.Engine != in.Engine || view.RecipeVersion != in.RecipeVersion || view.RuntimeState != domain.HostingDatabaseUnqualified) {
		return zero, store.ErrConflict
	}
	return view, err
}

// GetHostingDatabase returns nonsecret metadata after persisted viewer checks.
func (s *Service) GetHostingDatabase(ctx context.Context, resource string) (domain.HostingDatabase, error) {
	var zero domain.HostingDatabase
	r, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	if r.Kind != "database" {
		return zero, store.ErrNotFound
	}
	repo, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingDatabaseRepository)
	if !ok {
		return zero, store.ErrHostingDatabaseUnavailable
	}
	view, err := repo.GetHostingDatabase(ctx, actor.ID, r.ID)
	if err == nil && (view.Resource.ID != r.ID || view.Resource.ProjectID != r.ProjectID || view.RuntimeState != domain.HostingDatabaseUnqualified) {
		return zero, store.ErrConflict
	}
	return view, err
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

func (s *Service) hostingExecutor() (store.HostingExecutionRepository, error) {
	executor, ok := s.runs.(store.HostingExecutionRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	return executor, nil
}

// RequestHostingDeployment authorizes the persisted resource project and submits
// an immutable operation through a real PostgreSQL/River transaction.
func (s *Service) RequestHostingDeployment(ctx context.Context, resourceID string, in domain.HostingDeploymentInput) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	resource, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resourceID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if resource.Kind != "application" {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("database resources require a qualified engine operation"))
	}
	if resource.Source.Kind != "image" {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("git resources cannot use image deployment"))
	}
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingDeployment(in); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	executor, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("hop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.deployment_requested", id, map[string]any{"resource_id": resource.ID, "expected_generation": in.ExpectedGeneration})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return executor.RequestHostingDeployment(ctx, id, resource.ID, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

func (s *Service) hostingOperationForRole(ctx context.Context, id, role string) (store.HostingExecutionRepository, domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err := validateDestinationID(id, "operation_id"); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	executor, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := executor.GetHostingOperation(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, op, err
	}
	if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, op.ProjectID, role); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.StorageArchive != nil {
		if _, _, err = s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, op.ResourceID, role); err != nil {
			return nil, domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	return executor, op, nil
}

// HostingOperation returns an operation after checking persisted project viewer access.
func (s *Service) HostingOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	_, op, err := s.hostingOperationForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	return op, err
}

// CancelHostingOperation requests cancellation with current maintainer authority.
func (s *Service) CancelHostingOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	executor, op, err := s.hostingOperationForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	if op.StorageArchive != nil {
		if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, op.ProjectID, domain.RoleOwner); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.cancel_requested", id, map[string]any{"binding_id": op.BindingID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return executor.CancelHostingOperation(ctx, id, audit)
}

// ReconcileHostingOperation requests an exact-target observation with current owner authority.
func (s *Service) ReconcileHostingOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	executor, op, err := s.hostingOperationForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.reconciliation_requested", id, map[string]any{"binding_id": op.BindingID, "runner_id": op.Snapshot.RunnerID, "destination_id": op.Snapshot.DestinationID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return executor.RequestHostingReconciliation(ctx, id, audit)
}

func (s *Service) withHostingRunner(ctx context.Context, call func(store.HostingExecutionRepository, string) (domain.HostingOperation, error)) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	identity, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	executor, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return call(executor, identity.RunnerID)
}

// RunnerHostingPlan loads the immutable plan for the authenticated runner lease.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingPlan(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		return repo.HostingRunnerPlan(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// RunnerHostingPrepared commits or replays the authenticated preparation receipt.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingPrepared(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingPreparedRequest) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		return repo.HostingPrepared(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// RunnerHostingApplyBegin acquires the independent mutation hold before external effects.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingApplyBegin(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		return repo.HostingApplyBegin(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// RunnerHostingComplete settles durable execution evidence for the authenticated attempt.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingComplete(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingCompleteRequest) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		return repo.HostingComplete(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// RunnerHostingStatus reads fenced status or claims an owner-requested observation.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingStatus(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingStatusRequest) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		if in.Phase == "claim_observation" {
			return repo.ClaimHostingObservation(ctx, id, in.HostingAuthority, s.leaseTTL)
		}
		return repo.HostingStatus(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// RunnerHostingReconciliation submits read-only evidence under an observation lease.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingReconciliation(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingObservation) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return s.withHostingRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingExecutionRepository, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		return repo.HostingReconciliation(ctx, id, in)
	})
}

// ListHostingDeployments authorizes the resource's persisted project before pagination.
func (s *Service) ListHostingDeployments(ctx context.Context, id string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.HostingOperation], error) {
	resource, _, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.HostingOperation]{}, err
	}
	repo, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.HostingOperation]{}, err
	}
	return repo.ListHostingOperations(ctx, resource.ID, page)
```

```text
// ConfigureGitHubPushPolicy records explicit disabled delegation with reviewed current generations.
func (s *Service) ConfigureGitHubPushPolicy(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.GitHubPushConfigure) (domain.GitHubPushPolicy, error) {
	if err := in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	item, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, err
	}
	if item.Source.Kind != "git" || item.Source.Git == nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("select a supported GitHub.com Git source"))
	}
	source := item.Source.Git
	if _, _, _, err = domain.GitHubPushRepositoryBranch(domain.HostingGitSource{RepositoryURL: source.RepositoryURL, RequestedRef: source.RequestedRef, CredentialKind: source.CredentialKind}); err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("select a GitHub.com HTTPS source with one exact branch"))
	}
	if source.CredentialKind == "https_basic" && in.Configuration.ProviderReadSecret == nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("select a provider-read managed secret version"))
	}
	repo, err := s.githubPushRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, err
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor.ID, "hosting.github_push.configured", resource, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, err
	}
	return repo.ConfigureGitHubPushPolicy(ctx, actor.ID, resource, in, event)
}
func validPushCommand(in domain.GitHubPushCommand) bool {
	return in.ExpectedPolicyGeneration > 0 && domain.ValidGitHubPushRequestID(in.RequestID)
}

// VerifyGitHubPushPolicy verifies current repository identity without admitting work.
func (s *Service) VerifyGitHubPushPolicy(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.GitHubPushCommand) (domain.GitHubPushPolicy, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if !validPushCommand(in) {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid verification command"))
	}
	repo, actor, err := s.githubPushActor(ctx, resource, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, err
	}
	if s.githubPushProvider == nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, store.ErrGitHubPushUnavailable
	}
	authorized, err := repo.BeginGitHubPushVerification(ctx, actor, resource, in)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GitHubPushPolicy{}, err
	}
	if authorized.Replay != nil {
		return *authorized.Replay, nil
	}
	evidence, reason := s.verifyGitHubPush(ctx, repo, authorized)
	return repo.FinishGitHubPushVerification(ctx, authorized, evidence, reason)
}

// SetGitHubPushEnabled requires fresh verification and current owner authorization.

}

	}

}

// RetryGitHubPushDelivery opens one idempotent bounded owner recovery window.
func (s *Service) RetryGitHubPushDelivery(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.GitHubPushRetry) (domain.GitHubPushDelivery, error) {

func (s *Service) pushSecret(ctx context.Context, repo store.GitHubPushRepository, a store.GitHubPushAuthorization, purpose string) ([]byte, error) {
	if s.secretKeyring == nil {
		return nil, store.ErrGitHubPushUnavailable
	}
	record, err := repo.AuthorizeGitHubPushSecret(ctx, a, purpose)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer clear(record.Envelope.Data)
	plaintext, err := s.secretKeyring.Open(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: a.Policy.ProjectID, SecretID: record.Metadata.SecretID, Version: record.Metadata.Version}, record.Envelope)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, store.ErrGitHubPushUnavailable
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil || !s.clock().Before(a.Until) {
		clear(plaintext)
		return nil, store.ErrGitHubPushUnavailable
	}
	return plaintext, nil
}
func (s *Service) verifyGitHubPush(ctx context.Context, repo store.GitHubPushRepository, a store.GitHubPushAuthorization) (githubpush.Evidence, string) {
	var zero githubpush.Evidence
	if s.githubPushProvider == nil {
		return zero, "provider_unavailable"
	}
	var credential []byte
	if a.Configuration.ProviderReadSecret != nil {
		plaintext, err := s.pushSecret(ctx, repo, a, "github_read")
		if err != nil {
			return zero, "authority_unavailable"
		}
		defer clear(plaintext)
		material, err := decodeHostingSourceCredential("https_basic", plaintext)
		if err != nil {
			return zero, "provider_credentials_required"
		}
		defer material.Close()
		credential = material.Bytes
	} else if a.Source.CredentialKind == "https_basic" {
		return zero, "provider_credentials_required"
	}
	parts := strings.Split(a.Policy.Repository, "/")
	if len(parts) != 2 {
		return zero, "provider_response_invalid"
	}
	proof, err := s.githubPushProvider.Verify(ctx, githubpush.Request{Owner: parts[0], Repository: parts[1], Branch: a.Policy.Branch, RepositoryID: a.Policy.RepositoryID, DesiredCommit: a.Policy.DesiredCommit, Private: a.Source.CredentialKind == "https_basic"}, credential)
	if err != nil {
		var failure *githubpush.Failure
		if errors.As(err, &failure) {
			return zero, failure.Reason
		}
		return zero, "provider_unavailable"
	}
	return proof, ""
}

// ProcessGitHubPushDelivery resolves only opaque durable intent. No keys enter River arguments.
func (s *Service) ProcessGitHubPushDelivery(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	repo, err := s.githubPushRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	a, err := repo.BeginGitHubPushDelivery(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if a.IntentID == "" {
		return nil
	}
	evidence, reason := s.verifyGitHubPush(ctx, repo, a)
	return repo.CommitGitHubPushDelivery(ctx, a, evidence, reason)
}

// ReceiveGitHubPush verifies HMAC over bounded raw bytes before JSON interpretation or persistence.
func (s *Service) ReceiveGitHubPush(ctx context.Context, policy, delivery, event, signature string, raw []byte) (domain.GitHubPushReceipt, error) {
	var zero domain.GitHubPushReceipt
	if len(raw) > domain.GitHubPushPayloadLimit || !domain.ValidGitHubPushRequestID(delivery) || (event != "push" && event != "ping") {
		return zero, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid GitHub webhook headers"))
	}
	repo, err := s.githubPushRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	a, err := repo.GitHubPushWebhookAuthority(ctx, policy)
	if err != nil {
		return zero, err
	}
	key, err := s.pushSecret(ctx, repo, a, "webhook_hmac")
	if err != nil {
		return zero, store.ErrGitHubPushUnavailable
	}
	defer clear(key)
	if len(key) < 32 || len(key) > 256 || !githubpush.VerifySignature(key, raw, signature) {
		return zero, ErrGitHubPushSignature
	}
	if !uniquePushJSON(raw) {
		return zero, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid GitHub webhook JSON"))
	}
	var payload struct {
		Ref        *string `json:"ref"`
		Before     *string `json:"before"`
		After      *string `json:"after"`
		Deleted    *bool   `json:"deleted"`
		Forced     *bool   `json:"forced"`
		Repository *struct {
			ID   *int64 `json:"id"`
			Fork *bool  `json:"fork"`
		} `json:"repository"`
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload) != nil || payload.Repository == nil || payload.Repository.ID == nil || payload.Repository.Fork == nil || *payload.Repository.ID != a.Policy.RepositoryID || *payload.Repository.Fork {
		return zero, InvalidInput(errors.New("GitHub repository identity mismatch"))
	}
	after := ""
	if event == "push" {
		if payload.Ref == nil || payload.Before == nil || payload.After == nil || payload.Deleted == nil || payload.Forced == nil || *payload.Deleted || *payload.Forced || *payload.Ref != "refs/heads/"+a.Policy.Branch || !domain.ValidGitHubPushCommit(*payload.After) {
			return zero, InvalidInput(errors.New("unsupported GitHub push"))
		}
		before, err := hex.DecodeString(*payload.Before)
		if err != nil || len(before) != 20 || strings.ToLower(*payload.Before) != *payload.Before {
			return zero, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid GitHub before commit"))
		}
		after = *payload.After
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return repo.AcceptGitHubPushDelivery(ctx, a, delivery, "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), after, event == "ping")
}

// uniquePushJSON rejects duplicate keys and trailing documents while permitting
// unrelated nullable fields in GitHub's extensible payload. Only fixed fields are interpreted.
func uniquePushJSON(raw []byte) bool {
	if !utf8.Valid(raw) {
		return false
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	var walk func(int) bool
	walk = func(depth int) bool {
		if depth > 32 {
			return false
		}
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		delimiter, ok := token.(json.Delim)
		if !ok {
			return true
		}
		switch delimiter {
		case '{':
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for decoder.More() {
				token, e := decoder.Token()
				key, ok := token.(string)
				if e != nil || !ok || seen[key] {
					return false
				}
				seen[key] = true
				if !walk(depth + 1) {
					return false
				}
			}
			end, e := decoder.Token()
			return e == nil && end == json.Delim('}')
		case '[':
			for decoder.More() {
				if !walk(depth + 1) {
					return false
				}
			}
			end, e := decoder.Token()
			return e == nil && end == json.Delim(']')
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	if !walk(0) {
		return false
	}
	_, err := decoder.Token()
	return errors.Is(err, io.EOF)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode"

	"nerocd/internal/auth"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
```
