```text
)

func (s *Service) proxyRepository() (store.HostingProxyRepository, error) {
	repository, ok := s.runs.(store.HostingProxyRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	return repository, nil
}
func validateProxyKey(key string) error {
	if key == "" || len(key) > 128 || strings.ContainsFunc(key, func(r rune) bool { return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.IsSpace(r) }) {
		return InvalidInput(errors.New("a bounded idempotency_key is required"))
	}
	return nil
}
func (s *Service) proxyAdmin(ctx context.Context, server string, mutation bool) (store.HostingProxyRepository, domain.HostingProxy, auth.Principal, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingProxy{}, principal, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(server, "server_id"); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingProxy{}, principal, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, domain.HostingProxy{}, principal, err
	}
	p, err := repository.GetHostingProxyByServer(ctx, server)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, p, principal, err
	}
	if mutation {
		if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, p.ControlProjectID, domain.RoleOwner); err != nil {
			return nil, p, principal, err
		}
	}
	return repository, p, principal, nil
}

// ConfigureHostingProxy requires server administration and explicit ownership
// of the existing immutable control project. It never accepts local host paths.
func (s *Service) ConfigureHostingProxy(ctx context.Context, server string, in domain.HostingProxyInput) (domain.HostingProxy, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(server, "server_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, in.ControlProjectID, domain.RoleOwner); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	if err = validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	if in.Configuration.GeneratedDomain != "" {
		in.Configuration.GeneratedDomain, err = domain.NormalizeHostingHostname(in.Configuration.GeneratedDomain)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxy{}, InvalidInput(err)
		}
	}
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingProxyConfiguration(in.Configuration); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("proxy")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.proxy_configured", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxy{}, err
	}
	return repository.ConfigureHostingProxy(ctx, id, server, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

// HostingProxy returns server-administrator detail without operator filesystem settings.
func (s *Service) HostingProxy(ctx context.Context, server string) (domain.HostingProxy, error) {
	_, p, _, err := s.proxyAdmin(ctx, server, false)
	return p, err
}

// DisableHostingProxy queues an empty generation; owned proxy state and certificates persist.
func (s *Service) DisableHostingProxy(ctx context.Context, server string, in domain.HostingProxyMutationInput) (domain.HostingProxy, error) {
	repository, p, principal, err := s.proxyAdmin(ctx, server, true)
	if err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	if err = validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.proxy_disabled", p.ID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	return repository.SetHostingProxyEnabled(ctx, p.ID, principal.ID, in.IdempotencyKey, false, audit)
}

// HostingHostnameGrants lists explicit administrator delegations for one proxy.
func (s *Service) HostingHostnameGrants(ctx context.Context, server string) ([]domain.HostingHostnameGrant, error) {
	repository, p, _, err := s.proxyAdmin(ctx, server, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return repository.ListHostingHostnameGrants(ctx, p.ID)
}

// GrantHostingHostname delegates an exact hostname or an explicit descendant namespace.
func (s *Service) GrantHostingHostname(ctx context.Context, server string, in domain.HostingHostnameGrantInput) (domain.HostingHostnameGrant, error) {
	repository, p, principal, err := s.proxyAdmin(ctx, server, true)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingHostnameGrant{}, err
	}
	if err = s.destinationProjectExists(ctx, in.ProjectID); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingHostnameGrant{}, err
	}
	in.Hostname, err = domain.NormalizeHostingHostname(in.Hostname)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingHostnameGrant{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("hostgrant")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingHostnameGrant{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.proxy_hostname_granted", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingHostnameGrant{}, err
	}
	return repository.GrantHostingHostname(ctx, p.ID, id, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

// RevokeHostingHostname queues withdrawal while retaining admitted uncertainty.
func (s *Service) RevokeHostingHostname(ctx context.Context, server, grant string, in domain.HostingProxyMutationInput) (domain.HostingProxy, error) {
	repository, p, principal, err := s.proxyAdmin(ctx, server, true)
	if err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(grant, "grant_id"); err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	if err = validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.proxy_hostname_revoked", grant, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	return repository.RevokeHostingHostname(ctx, p.ID, grant, principal.ID, in.IdempotencyKey, audit)
}

func normalizeProxyRoute(in domain.HostingRouteInput) (domain.HostingRouteInput, error) {
	if err := validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return in, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedRouteVersion < 0 {
		return in, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_route_version must not be negative"))
	}
	if err := validateDestinationID(in.ExpectedHealthyOperationID, "expected_healthy_operation_id"); err != nil {
		return in, err
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateHostingRoutePath(in.PathPrefix); err != nil {
		return in, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	if in.GenerateHostname {
		if in.Hostname != "" {
			return in, InvalidInput(errors.New("generated hostname requests must omit hostname"))
		}
	} else {
		host, err := domain.NormalizeHostingHostname(in.Hostname)
		if err != nil {
			return in, InvalidInput(err)
		}
		in.Hostname = host
	}
	return in, nil
}

// HostingRoutes returns only routes for a viewer-authorized persisted resource.
func (s *Service) HostingRoutes(ctx context.Context, resource string) ([]domain.HostingRoute, error) {
	item, _, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return repository.ListHostingRoutes(ctx, item.ID)
}

// RequestHostingRoute selects the caller's current settled healthy resource release.
func (s *Service) RequestHostingRoute(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.HostingRouteInput) (domain.HostingRoute, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedRouteVersion != 0 {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("new routes require expected_route_version zero"))
	}
	in, err = normalizeProxyRoute(in)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("pop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.route_requested", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	return repository.RequestHostingRoute(ctx, item.ID, "", id, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

func (s *Service) proxyRouteForRole(ctx context.Context, id, role string) (store.HostingProxyRepository, store.HostingProxyRouteRecord, auth.Principal, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, store.HostingProxyRouteRecord{}, principal, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "route_id"); err != nil {
		return nil, store.HostingProxyRouteRecord{}, principal, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, store.HostingProxyRouteRecord{}, principal, err
	}
	row, err := repository.GetHostingRoute(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, row, principal, err
	}
	if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, row.ProjectID, role); err != nil {
		return nil, store.HostingProxyRouteRecord{}, principal, err
	}
	return repository, row, principal, nil
}

// HostingRoute returns a route after checking its persisted project scope.
func (s *Service) HostingRoute(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingRoute, error) {
	_, row, _, err := s.proxyRouteForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	return row.Route, err
}

// UpdateHostingRoute advances one expected route version and selects a healthy release explicitly.
func (s *Service) UpdateHostingRoute(ctx context.Context, id string, in domain.HostingRouteInput) (domain.HostingRoute, error) {
	repository, row, principal, err := s.proxyRouteForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedRouteVersion < 1 {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_route_version is required"))
	}
	in, err = normalizeProxyRoute(in)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	operation, err := prefixedID("pop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.route_changed", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	return repository.RequestHostingRoute(ctx, row.Route.ResourceID, id, operation, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

// DeleteHostingRoute queues withdrawal without deleting immutable release references.
func (s *Service) DeleteHostingRoute(ctx context.Context, id string, in domain.HostingRouteDeletionInput) (domain.HostingRoute, error) {
	repository, _, principal, err := s.proxyRouteForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedRouteVersion < 1 {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_route_version is required"))
	}
	if err = validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	operation, err := prefixedID("pop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.route_withdrawn", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRoute{}, err
	}
	return repository.DeleteHostingRoute(ctx, id, operation, principal.ID, in, audit)
}

// ProxyOperation returns administrator detail or a project-sanitized route-only view.
func (s *Service) ProxyOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (any, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "operation_id"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	op, err := repository.GetHostingProxyOperation(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if isRunnerAdmin(principal) {
		return op, nil
	}
	return s.proxyProjectOperationView(ctx, op)
}

func (s *Service) proxyProjectOperationView(ctx context.Context, op domain.HostingProxyOperation) (domain.HostingProxyOperationView, error) {
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	view := domain.HostingProxyOperationView{ID: op.ID, State: op.State, MutationHold: op.MutationHold, RestoreOwnershipHeld: op.RestoreOwnershipHeld, MetadataConflict: op.MetadataConflict, Routes: make([]domain.HostingRoute, 0)}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	checked := map[string]bool{}
	check := func(project string) (bool, error) {
		if checked[project] {
			return allowed[project], nil
		}
		checked[project] = true
		_, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, project, domain.RoleViewer)
		if errors.Is(err, auth.ErrForbidden) || errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
			return false, nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		allowed[project] = true
		return true, nil
	}
	for _, target := range op.Snapshot.Routes {
		ok, err := check(target.ProjectID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		record, err := repository.GetHostingRoute(ctx, target.RouteID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		if record.ProjectID != target.ProjectID {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, store.ErrConflict
		}
		view.Routes = append(view.Routes, record.Route)
	}
	if op.RouteID != "" {
		record, err := repository.GetHostingRoute(ctx, op.RouteID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		ok, err := check(record.ProjectID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		if ok {
			found := false
			for _, route := range view.Routes {
				found = found || route.ID == record.Route.ID
			}
			if !found {
				view.Routes = append(view.Routes, record.Route)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(view.Routes) == 0 {
		ok, err := check(op.ProjectID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		if !ok {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, auth.ErrForbidden
		}
	}
	return view, nil
}

// CancelProxyOperation requires server administration and control-project ownership.
func (s *Service) CancelProxyOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	principal, err := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := repository.GetHostingProxyOperation(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	p, err := repository.GetHostingProxy(ctx, op.ProxyID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, p.ControlProjectID, domain.RoleOwner); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.proxy_cancel_requested", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	return repository.CancelHostingProxyOperation(ctx, id, principal.ID, audit)
}

func (s *Service) withProxyRunner(ctx context.Context, call func(store.HostingProxyRepository, string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error)) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	identity, err := s.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperation{}, err
	}
	return call(repository, identity.RunnerID)
}

// RunnerProxyPlan returns typed input for one exact live runner attempt.
func (s *Service) RunnerProxyPlan(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	return s.withProxyRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingProxyRepository, runner string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
		return repo.RunnerProxyPlan(ctx, runner, in)
	})
}

// RunnerProxyPrepared commits or replays exact local preparation evidence.
func (s *Service) RunnerProxyPrepared(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingProxyPreparedRequest) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	return s.withProxyRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingProxyRepository, runner string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
		return repo.RunnerProxyPrepared(ctx, runner, in)
	})
}

// RunnerProxyApplyBegin obtains durable proxy ownership before external effects.
func (s *Service) RunnerProxyApplyBegin(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	return s.withProxyRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingProxyRepository, runner string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
		return repo.RunnerProxyApplyBegin(ctx, runner, in)
	})
}

// RunnerProxyComplete settles only live first reports or exact committed replay.
func (s *Service) RunnerProxyComplete(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingProxyCompleteRequest) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	return s.withProxyRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingProxyRepository, runner string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
		return repo.RunnerProxyComplete(ctx, runner, in)
	})
}

// RunnerProxyStatus reads exact attempt identity without restoring mutation authority.
func (s *Service) RunnerProxyStatus(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
	return s.withProxyRunner(ctx, func(repo store.HostingProxyRepository, runner string) (domain.HostingProxyOperation, error) {
		return repo.RunnerProxyStatus(ctx, runner, in)
	})
}

// ListHostingRetainedReleases returns only releases owned by the authorized resource.
func (s *Service) ListHostingRetainedReleases(ctx context.Context, resourceID string) ([]domain.HostingRetainedRelease, error) {
	resource, _, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resourceID, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	repository, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return repository.ListHostingRetainedReleases(ctx, resource.ID)
}

// RequestHostingReleaseCleanup authorizes cleanup by resource and release identity.
// The repository selects the container and refuses every protected route reference.
func (s *Service) RequestHostingReleaseCleanup(ctx context.Context, resourceID, releaseID string, in domain.HostingCleanupInput) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	resource, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resourceID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(releaseID, "release_operation_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	repository, err := s.hostingExecutor()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("hop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.release_cleanup_requested", id, map[string]any{"resource_id": resource.ID, "release_operation_id": releaseID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return repository.RequestHostingReleaseCleanup(ctx, id, resource.ID, releaseID, principal.ID, in, audit)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// RequestHostingRouteSwitch authorizes a bounded selection and returns project-safe status.
func (s *Service) RequestHostingRouteSwitch(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.HostingRouteSwitchInput) (domain.HostingProxyOperationView, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	if err = validateProxyKey(in.IdempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	in, err = domain.CanonicalHostingRouteSwitchInput(in)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	switches, ok := repository.(store.HostingRouteSwitchRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("pop")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "hosting.route_switch_requested", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	op, err := switches.RequestHostingRouteSwitch(ctx, item.ID, id, principal.ID, in, audit)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	view, ok := domain.HostingRouteSwitchOperationView(op, item.ID, item.ProjectID, nil)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, store.ErrConflict
	}
	for _, target := range op.Snapshot.Routes {
		if target.ResourceID != item.ID || target.ProjectID != item.ProjectID {
			continue
		}
		record, err := repository.GetHostingRoute(ctx, target.RouteID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
		}
		if record.ProjectID != item.ProjectID || record.Route.ResourceID != item.ID {
			return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, store.ErrConflict
		}
		view.Routes = append(view.Routes, record.Route)
	}
	return view, nil
}

func (s *Service) routeSwitchReader(ctx context.Context, resource string) (domain.Resource, string, store.HostingRouteSwitchReadRepository, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return item, "", nil, err
	}
	repository, err := s.proxyRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return item, "", nil, err
	}
	reader, ok := repository.(store.HostingRouteSwitchReadRepository)
	if !ok {
		return item, "", nil, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	return item, principal.ID, reader, nil
}

// HostingRouteSwitchOptions explains current choices; POST rechecks all authority.
func (s *Service) HostingRouteSwitchOptions(ctx context.Context, resource, after string) (domain.HostingRouteSwitchOptions, error) {
	item, actor, reader, err := s.routeSwitchReader(ctx, resource)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRouteSwitchOptions{}, err
	}
	if after != "" {
		if err = validateDestinationID(after, "after_operation_id"); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingRouteSwitchOptions{}, err
		}
	}
	return reader.HostingRouteSwitchOptions(ctx, item.ID, actor, after)
}

// HostingRouteSwitchOperation always returns the resource-safe recovery view.
func (s *Service) HostingRouteSwitchOperation(ctx context.Context, resource, operation string) (domain.HostingProxyOperationView, error) {
	item, actor, reader, err := s.routeSwitchReader(ctx, resource)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	if operation == "" {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("operation_id is required"))
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(operation, "operation_id"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingProxyOperationView{}, err
	}
	return reader.HostingRouteSwitchOperation(ctx, item.ID, actor, operation)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

func supportedRuntimeConfiguration(resource domain.Resource) error {
	if resource.Kind != "application" || (resource.Source.Kind != "image" && resource.Source.Kind != "git") {
		return InvalidInput(errors.New("runtime configuration supports application resources with image or Git sources"))
	}
	return nil
}

// GetHostingRuntimeConfiguration returns literals and exact secret references only.
func (s *Service) GetHostingRuntimeConfiguration(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration, error) {
	resource, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, err
	}
	if err = supportedRuntimeConfiguration(resource); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, err
	}
	repository, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingRuntimeConfigurationRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, store.ErrHostingRuntimeConfigurationUnavailable
	}
	return repository.GetHostingRuntimeConfiguration(ctx, actor.ID, resource.ID)
}

// PutHostingRuntimeConfiguration saves desired input without starting a deployment.
func (s *Service) PutHostingRuntimeConfiguration(ctx context.Context, id string, in domain.HostingRuntimeConfigurationInput) (domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration, error) {
	resource, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, err
	}
	if err = supportedRuntimeConfiguration(resource); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, err
	}
	if _, _, err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repository, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingRuntimeConfigurationRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, store.ErrHostingRuntimeConfigurationUnavailable
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor.ID, "hosting.runtime_configuration.updated", resource.ID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeConfiguration{}, err
	}
	return repository.PutHostingRuntimeConfiguration(ctx, actor.ID, resource.ID, in, event)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"nerocd/internal/auth"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingruntimeprotocol"
	"nerocd/internal/secretcrypto"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable excludes secret and storage diagnostics.
var ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable = errors.New("hosting_runtime_environment_unavailable")

// HostingRuntimeRunnerIdentity verifies the request's original bearer as well as current capabilities.
type HostingRuntimeRunnerIdentity interface {
	CurrentRunnerIdentity(context.Context) (RunnerIdentity, error)
	AuthenticateRunnerToken(context.Context, string) (auth.Principal, error)
}

// HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery decrypts only after the repository commits authorization.
type HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery struct {
	auth       auth.Provider
	runners    HostingRuntimeRunnerIdentity
	repository store.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentRepository
	keys       *secretcrypto.Keyring
	clock      func() time.Time
}

// NewHostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery accepts immutable keys and a trusted clock.
func NewHostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery(provider auth.Provider, runners HostingRuntimeRunnerIdentity, repository store.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentRepository, keys *secretcrypto.Keyring, clock func() time.Time) (*HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery, error) {
	if provider == nil || runners == nil || repository == nil || clock == nil {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	return &HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery{provider, runners, repository, keys, clock}, nil
}

// Deliver verifies current authority and consumes only committed authorization.
func (s *HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery) Deliver(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentRequest, token string) (*hostingruntimeprotocol.Environment, error) {
	token = strings.TrimSpace(token)
	if hostingruntimeprotocol.ValidateRequest(in) != nil {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	principal, err := s.auth.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if principal.Provider != domain.PrincipalRunner || principal.ID == "" {
		return nil, auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	runner, err := s.currentCredential(ctx, token, principal.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	verified, err := s.repository.AuthorizeHostingRuntimeEnvironment(ctx, runner.RunnerID, runnerTokenHash(token), in)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	defer verified.Close()
	hash := hostingruntimeprotocol.RuntimeEnvironmentRequestHash(runner.RunnerID, in)
	if verified.ProjectID == "" || verified.Window.DeliveryID != in.DeliveryID || verified.Window.RequestHash != hash || !s.clock().Before(verified.Window.UseUntil) {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	doc, refs, err := domain.CanonicalHostingRuntimeDocument(verified.Document.Entries)
	if err != nil || domain.HostingDocumentHash(doc) != in.RuntimeConfiguration.Hash || len(refs) != len(verified.Records) {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	if _, err = s.currentCredential(ctx, token, runner.RunnerID); err != nil || ctx.Err() != nil || !s.clock().Before(verified.Window.UseUntil) {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	entries := make([]hostingruntimeprotocol.Entry, 0, len(doc.Entries))
	defer func() {
		for _, entry := range entries {
			clear(entry.Value)
		}
	}()
	for _, entry := range doc.Entries {
		var value []byte
		if entry.Kind == "literal" {
			value = []byte(*entry.Value)
		} else {
			record, ok := verified.Records[*entry.Secret]
			if !ok || s.keys == nil || record.Metadata.SecretID != entry.Secret.SecretID || record.Metadata.Version != entry.Secret.Version {
				return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
			}
			value, err = s.keys.Open(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: verified.ProjectID, SecretID: entry.Secret.SecretID, Version: entry.Secret.Version}, record.Envelope)
			if err != nil {
				clear(value)
				return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
			}
		}
		resolved := hostingruntimeprotocol.Entry{Name: entry.Name, Value: value}
		if hostingruntimeprotocol.ValidateEntries([]hostingruntimeprotocol.Entry{resolved}) != nil {
			clear(value)
			return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
		}
		entries = append(entries, resolved)
	}
	out, err := hostingruntimeprotocol.NewEnvironment(hostingruntimeprotocol.Metadata{Authority: in.Authority, DeliveryID: in.DeliveryID, PlanHash: in.PlanHash, RuntimeConfiguration: in.RuntimeConfiguration, RequestHash: hash, Purpose: hostingruntimeprotocol.Purpose, UseUntil: verified.Window.UseUntil}, entries)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	// This is the final authority boundary before returning owned bytes. Rotation
	// after this check cannot recall bytes already returned or sent to the peer.
	if _, err = s.currentCredential(ctx, token, runner.RunnerID); err != nil || ctx.Err() != nil || !s.clock().Before(verified.Window.UseUntil) {
		out.Close()
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (s *HostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery) currentCredential(ctx context.Context, token, runnerID string) (RunnerIdentity, error) {
	if token == "" {
		return RunnerIdentity{}, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	identity, err := s.runners.CurrentRunnerIdentity(ctx)
	if err != nil || identity.RunnerID != runnerID || !slices.Contains(identity.Capabilities, domain.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentCapability) {
		return RunnerIdentity{}, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	// Authenticate after the identity read so a replacement during that read is
	// compared against the original bearer, rather than accepted by runner ID.
	principal, err := s.runners.AuthenticateRunnerToken(ctx, token)
	if err != nil || principal.ID != runnerID || principal.Provider != domain.PrincipalRunner {
		return RunnerIdentity{}, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	return identity, nil
}

// RunnerHostingRuntimeEnvironment connects dedicated runner authentication to delivery.
func (s *Service) RunnerHostingRuntimeEnvironment(ctx context.Context, in domain.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentRequest, token string) (*hostingruntimeprotocol.Environment, error) {
	if hostingruntimeprotocol.ValidateRequest(in) != nil {
		return nil, InvalidInput(hostingruntimeprotocol.ErrInvalidMessage)
	}
	repository, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingRuntimeEnvironmentRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, ErrHostingRuntimeEnvironmentUnavailable
	}
	delivery, err := NewHostingRuntimeEnvironmentDelivery(s.auth, s, repository, s.secretKeyring, s.clock)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return delivery.Deliver(ctx, in, token)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"nerocd/internal/auth"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

func (s *Service) runtimeLogs() (store.HostingRuntimeLogsRepository, error) {
	repo, ok := s.runs.(store.HostingRuntimeLogsRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	return repo, nil
}

// OpenRuntimeLogSession admits bounded demand under the current resource viewer.
// Revoked cookies deny new HTTP requests. Already admitted background demand may
// remain for at most thirty seconds and does not promise instant cookie revocation.
func (s *Service) OpenRuntimeLogSession(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.HostingRuntimeLogOpen) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession, error) {
	item, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession{}, err
	}
	in, err = in.Canonical()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repo, err := s.runtimeLogs()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession{}, err
	}
	return repo.OpenRuntimeLogSession(ctx, actor.ID, item.ID, in)
}

func (s *Service) runtimeLogSessionActor(ctx context.Context, id string) (store.HostingRuntimeLogsRepository, string, error) {
	actor, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if err = validateDestinationID(id, "session_id"); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	repo, err := s.runtimeLogs()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	scope, err := repo.RuntimeLogSessionScope(ctx, actor.ID, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if scope.ActorID != actor.ID {
		return nil, "", auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	if _, _, err = s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, scope.ResourceID, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return repo, actor.ID, nil
}

// RenewRuntimeLogSession extends only live actor-owned demand.
func (s *Service) RenewRuntimeLogSession(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession, error) {
	repo, actor, err := s.runtimeLogSessionActor(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession{}, err
	}
	return repo.RenewRuntimeLogSession(ctx, actor, id)
}

// CloseRuntimeLogSession ends actor-owned demand immediately.
func (s *Service) CloseRuntimeLogSession(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession, error) {
	repo, actor, err := s.runtimeLogSessionActor(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogSession{}, err
	}
	return repo.CloseRuntimeLogSession(ctx, actor, id)
}

// RuntimeLogPage returns explicitly sensitive cached output under current access.
func (s *Service) RuntimeLogPage(ctx context.Context, id string, after, limit int) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogPage, error) {
	if after < 0 || after > math.MaxInt32 || limit < 1 || limit > domain.HostingRuntimeLogReadLimit {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogPage{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid runtime log pagination"))
	}
	repo, actor, err := s.runtimeLogSessionActor(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogPage{}, err
	}
	return repo.RuntimeLogPage(ctx, actor, id, after, limit)
}

// ClaimRuntimeLogSessions binds collection to the actual authenticated runner bearer.
func (s *Service) ClaimRuntimeLogSessions(ctx context.Context, token string, in domain.HostingRuntimeLogClaimInput) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogClaims, error) {
	runner, hash, err := s.observationRunner(ctx, token)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogClaims{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogClaims{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repo, err := s.runtimeLogs()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogClaims{}, err
	}
	return repo.ClaimRuntimeLogSessions(ctx, runner, hash, in)
}

// AppendRuntimeLogs passes the known bearer only for bounded pre-storage redaction.
// Arbitrary application secrets can remain in this sensitive log output.
func (s *Service) AppendRuntimeLogs(ctx context.Context, token string, in domain.HostingRuntimeLogBatch) (domain.HostingRuntimeLogAck, error) {
	runner, hash, err := s.observationRunner(ctx, token)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogAck{}, err
	}
	in, err = in.Canonical()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogAck{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repo, err := s.runtimeLogs()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingRuntimeLogAck{}, err
	}
	return repo.AppendRuntimeLogs(ctx, runner, hash, token, in)
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/source"
	"net"
	"regexp"

// ProjectEnvironmentInput creates a shared environment in an existing project.
type ProjectEnvironmentInput struct {
	ProjectID string `json:"project_id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
}

// ResourceInput creates desired application configuration.
type ResourceInput struct {
	ProjectID            string                `json:"project_id"`
	ProjectEnvironmentID string                `json:"project_environment_id"`
	Name                 string                `json:"name"`
	Kind                 string                `json:"kind"`
	Source               domain.ResourceSource `json:"source"`
}

// ResourcePatch changes only mutable configuration at the expected generation.
type ResourcePatch struct {
	Name               *string                `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Source             *domain.ResourceSource `json:"source,omitempty"`
	ExpectedGeneration int64                  `json:"expected_generation"`
}

func (s *Service) authorizeHostingProject(ctx context.Context, projectID, role string) (auth.Principal, error) {
	principal, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	if err = s.requireProjectRole(ctx, principal, projectID, role); err != nil {
		return auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	// Administrators bypass membership checks, but never project existence.
	projects, err := s.projects.ListProjects(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	for _, p := range projects {
		if p.ID == projectID && p.ArchivedAt == nil {
			return principal, nil
		}
	}
	return auth.Principal{}, store.ErrNotFound
}
func (s *Service) hostingEnvironmentInProject(ctx context.Context, projectID, environmentID string) (domain.ProjectEnvironment, error) {
	environment, err := s.hosting.GetProjectEnvironment(ctx, environmentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, err
	}
	if environment.ProjectID != projectID {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, auth.ErrForbidden
	}
	return environment, nil
}

// ListProjectEnvironments requires an explicit authorized project scope.
func (s *Service) ListProjectEnvironments(ctx context.Context, projectID string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.ProjectEnvironment], error) {
	projectID = strings.TrimSpace(projectID)
	if _, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, projectID, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.ProjectEnvironment]{}, err
	}
	return s.hosting.ListProjectEnvironments(ctx, projectID, page)
}

// CreateProjectEnvironment persists shared configuration with atomic audit evidence.
func (s *Service) CreateProjectEnvironment(ctx context.Context, in ProjectEnvironmentInput) (domain.ProjectEnvironment, error) {
	in.ProjectID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectID)
	in.Name = strings.TrimSpace(in.Name)
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, err
	}
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingName(in.Name); err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("penv")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, err
	}
	environment := domain.ProjectEnvironment{ID: id, ProjectID: in.ProjectID, Name: in.Name, CreatedAt: s.clock().UTC()}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "project_environment.created", id, map[string]any{"project_id": in.ProjectID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ProjectEnvironment{}, err
	}
	return s.hosting.CreateProjectEnvironment(ctx, environment, store.WithAudit(audit))
}

// ListResources lists desired resources after checking project and environment scope.
func (s *Service) ListResources(ctx context.Context, projectID, environmentID string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.Resource], error) {
	projectID = strings.TrimSpace(projectID)
	environmentID = strings.TrimSpace(environmentID)
	if _, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, projectID, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.Resource]{}, err
	}
	if environmentID != "" {
		if _, err := s.hostingEnvironmentInProject(ctx, projectID, environmentID); err != nil {
			return store.PageResult[domain.Resource]{}, err
		}
	}
	return s.hosting.ListResources(ctx, projectID, environmentID, page)
}

// GetResource authorizes access using persisted scope rather than caller input.
func (s *Service) GetResource(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.Resource, error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	item, err := s.hosting.GetResource(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, item.ProjectID, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	return item, nil
}

// CreateResource validates and stores an image application without starting it.
func (s *Service) CreateResource(ctx context.Context, in ResourceInput) (domain.Resource, error) {
	in.ProjectID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectID)
	in.ProjectEnvironmentID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectEnvironmentID)
	in.Name = strings.TrimSpace(in.Name)
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingName(in.Name); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	if in.Kind != "application" {
		return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("kind must be application"))
	}
	if in.Source.Kind != "git" {
		if err = domain.ValidateResourceSource(in.Source); err != nil {
			return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(err)
		}
	}
	if in.ProjectEnvironmentID == "" {
		return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("project_environment_id is required"))
	}
	if _, err = s.hostingEnvironmentInProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, in.ProjectEnvironmentID); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("res")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	now := s.clock().UTC()
	item := domain.Resource{ID: id, ProjectID: in.ProjectID, ProjectEnvironmentID: in.ProjectEnvironmentID, Name: in.Name, Kind: in.Kind, Source: in.Source, Generation: 1, CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "resource.created", id, map[string]any{"project_id": in.ProjectID, "project_environment_id": in.ProjectEnvironmentID, "generation": int64(1)})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	opts := []store.MutationOption{store.WithAudit(audit)}
	if item.Source.Kind == "git" {
		src, sourceErr := s.publicGitSource(item, in.Source, "", 1)
		if sourceErr != nil {
			return domain.Resource{}, sourceErr
		}
		item.Source = publicGitResourceSource(src)
		opts = append(opts, store.WithHostingGitSource(src))
	}
	out, err := s.hosting.CreateResource(ctx, item, opts...)
	return out, gitResourceError(err)
}

// UpdateResource advances generation for every accepted change, including names.
func (s *Service) UpdateResource(ctx context.Context, id string, in ResourcePatch) (domain.Resource, error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	item, err := s.hosting.GetResource(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, item.ProjectID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	if item.Kind != "application" {
		return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("database resources require a qualified engine operation"))
	}
	if in.ExpectedGeneration < 1 || in.Name == nil && in.Source == nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_generation and at least one of name or source are required"))
	}
	if in.Name != nil {
		item.Name = strings.TrimSpace(*in.Name)
		if err = domain.ValidateHostingName(item.Name); err != nil {
			return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(err)
		}
	}
	originalSource := item.Source
	if in.Source != nil {
		if item.Source.Kind != in.Source.Kind {
			return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("image and Git source conversion is not supported"))
		}
		item.Source = *in.Source
		if item.Source.Kind != "git" {
			if err = domain.ValidateResourceSource(item.Source); err != nil {
				return domain.Resource{}, InvalidInput(err)
			}
		}
	}
	if item.Generation != in.ExpectedGeneration || item.Generation == 9223372036854775807 {
		return domain.Resource{}, store.ErrConflict
	}
	item.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC()
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "resource.updated", id, map[string]any{"project_id": item.ProjectID, "project_environment_id": item.ProjectEnvironmentID, "generation": in.ExpectedGeneration + 1})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Resource{}, err
	}
	opts := []store.MutationOption{store.WithAudit(audit)}
	if in.Source != nil && item.Source.Kind == "git" {
		src, sourceErr := s.publicGitSource(item, *in.Source, originalSource.Git.SourceID, originalSource.Git.Generation)
		if sourceErr != nil {
			return domain.Resource{}, sourceErr
		}
		item.Source = publicGitResourceSource(src)
		opts = append(opts, store.WithHostingGitSource(src))
	}
	out, err := s.hosting.UpdateResource(ctx, item, in.ExpectedGeneration, opts...)
	return out, gitResourceError(err)
}

// ConfigureHostingGitHosts sets the startup-only public HTTPS repository allowlist.
func (s *Service) ConfigureHostingGitHosts(hosts []string) error {
	policy, err := PublicHostingGitPolicy(hosts)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.hostingGitPolicy = policy
	return nil
}

// PublicHostingGitPolicy validates bounded exact public DNS hosts without network IO.
func PublicHostingGitPolicy(hosts []string) (source.RepositoryPolicy, error) {
	if len(hosts) == 0 {
		hosts = []string{"github.com"}
	}
	if len(hosts) > 32 {
		return source.RepositoryPolicy{}, errors.New("at most 32 Git repository hosts are allowed")
	}
	normalized := make([]string, 0, len(hosts))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	label := regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`)
	for _, host := range hosts {
		host = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(host))
		if len(host) > 253 || !strings.Contains(host, ".") || net.ParseIP(host) != nil || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".") {
			return source.RepositoryPolicy{}, errors.New("git repository hosts must be exact public DNS names")
		}
		for _, part := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
			if !label.MatchString(part) {
				return source.RepositoryPolicy{}, errors.New("invalid Git repository host")
			}
		}
		if !seen[host] {
			normalized = append(normalized, host)
			seen[host] = true
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(normalized)
	p := source.RepositoryPolicy{Version: 1, State: "configured", Mode: "public", AllowedSchemes: []string{"https"}, AllowedHosts: normalized}
	return p, p.ValidatePolicy()
}
func (s *Service) publicGitSource(item domain.Resource, input domain.ResourceSource, id string, generation int64) (domain.HostingGitSource, error) {
	if input.Git == nil || input.Image.Reference != "" || input.Git.SourceID != "" || input.Git.Generation != 0 {
		return domain.HostingGitSource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("git input must contain configuration only"))
	}
	c := input.Git.GitResourceConfiguration
	if c.CredentialKind != "public" && c.CredentialKind != "https_basic" {
		return domain.HostingGitSource{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("unsupported Git credential kind"))
	}
	if id == "" {
		var err error
		id, err = prefixedID("hsrc")
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingGitSource{}, err
		}
	}
	src := domain.HostingGitSource{ID: id, ResourceID: item.ID, ProjectID: item.ProjectID, Generation: generation, RepositoryURL: c.RepositoryURL, RequestedRef: c.RequestedRef, CredentialKind: c.CredentialKind, Settings: c.Settings, Policy: s.hostingGitPolicy}
	if err := domain.ValidateHostingGitSource(src); err != nil {
		return src, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	return src, nil
}
func publicGitResourceSource(src domain.HostingGitSource) domain.ResourceSource {
	return domain.ResourceSource{Kind: "git", Git: &domain.GitResourceSource{SourceID: src.ID, Generation: src.Generation, GitResourceConfiguration: domain.GitResourceConfiguration{RepositoryURL: src.RepositoryURL, RequestedRef: src.RequestedRef, CredentialKind: src.CredentialKind, Settings: src.Settings}}}
}
func gitResourceError(err error) error {
	if errors.Is(err, store.ErrGitResourceUnavailable) {
		return fmt.Errorf("git resource configuration requires PostgreSQL: %w", hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable)
	}
	return err
}
```

```text
	audit, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor.ID, "hosting.storage_archive.restore_requested", id, nil)
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

func supportedHostingStorage(resource domain.Resource) error {
	if resource.Kind != "application" || resource.Source.Kind != "image" {
		return InvalidInput(domain.ErrInvalidHostingStorage)
	}
	return nil
}

// GetHostingStorage returns immutable desired metadata under current viewer authority.
// The repository also rechecks membership and the current destination grant.
func (s *Service) GetHostingStorage(ctx context.Context, resource string) (domain.HostingStorage, error) {
	r, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleViewer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, err
	}
	if err = supportedHostingStorage(r); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, err
	}
	repo, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingStorageRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, store.ErrHostingStorageUnavailable
	}
	return repo.GetHostingStorage(ctx, actor.ID, r.ID)
}

// CreateHostingStorage records one immutable local volume selection. It never
// creates a Docker volume, changes a deployment plan, or schedules execution.
func (s *Service) CreateHostingStorage(ctx context.Context, resource string, in domain.HostingStorageInput) (domain.HostingStorage, error) {
	r, actor, err := s.resourceForDestinationRole(ctx, resource, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, err
	}
	if err = supportedHostingStorage(r); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, err
	}
	if err = in.Validate(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	repo, ok := s.hosting.(store.HostingStorageRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, store.ErrHostingStorageUnavailable
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor.ID, "hosting.storage.created", r.ID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingStorage{}, err
	}
	return repo.CreateHostingStorage(ctx, actor.ID, r.ID, in, event)
}
```

Subject `563fb88f707b75563d03f0408df0267e3af473e9`. Reproduce with `git show 563fb88f707b75563d03f0408df0267e3af473e9:internal/app/managed_secrets_service.go` and select lines 1-208.

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"nerocd/internal/auth"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/secretcrypto"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable safely reports an unconfigured encryption dependency.
var ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable = errors.New("managed secrets unavailable")

// ManagedSecretInput supplies an exact value. Value is never trimmed or included in errors.
type ManagedSecretInput struct {
	ProjectID string `json:"project_id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Value     string `json:"value"`
}

// ManagedSecretRotateInput appends a version only at the caller's expected version.
type ManagedSecretRotateInput struct {
	ExpectedVersion int64  `json:"expected_version"`
	Value           string `json:"value"`
}

// ManagedSecretRevokeInput makes revocation conditional on the expected version.
type ManagedSecretRevokeInput struct {
	ExpectedVersion int64 `json:"expected_version"`
}

// ManagedSecretRevealInput selects an explicit immutable historical version.
type ManagedSecretRevealInput struct {
	Version int64 `json:"version"`
}

// ManagedSecretReveal is the only response that contains a plaintext value.
type ManagedSecretReveal struct {
	SecretID string `json:"secret_id"`
	Version  int64  `json:"version"`
	Value    string `json:"value"`
}

func validateManagedValue(value string) error {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 65536 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return InvalidInput(errors.New("value must be nonempty UTF-8 and at most 65536 bytes"))
	}
	return nil
}
func (s *Service) managedSecretForRole(ctx context.Context, id, role string) (domain.ManagedSecret, auth.Principal, error) {
	if _, err := s.CurrentPrincipal(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	item, err := s.managedSecrets.GetManagedSecret(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, item.ProjectID, role)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, auth.Principal{}, err
	}
	return item, principal, nil
}

// ListManagedSecrets requires an explicit project and viewer access.
func (s *Service) ListManagedSecrets(ctx context.Context, project string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.ManagedSecret], error) {
	project = strings.TrimSpace(project)
	if _, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, project, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.ManagedSecret]{}, err
	}
	return s.managedSecrets.ListManagedSecrets(ctx, project, page)
}

// GetManagedSecret checks persisted project scope before returning metadata.
func (s *Service) GetManagedSecret(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.ManagedSecret, error) {
	item, _, err := s.managedSecretForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer)
	return item, err
}

// ListManagedSecretVersions returns metadata even when encryption is unconfigured or the secret is revoked.
func (s *Service) ListManagedSecretVersions(ctx context.Context, id string, page store.Page) (store.PageResult[domain.ManagedSecretVersion], error) {
	if _, _, err := s.managedSecretForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleViewer); err != nil {
		return store.PageResult[domain.ManagedSecretVersion]{}, err
	}
	return s.managedSecrets.ListManagedSecretVersions(ctx, id, page)
}

// CreateManagedSecret encrypts before atomically committing version one and its audit.
func (s *Service) CreateManagedSecret(ctx context.Context, in ManagedSecretInput) (domain.ManagedSecret, error) {
	in.ProjectID = strings.TrimSpace(in.ProjectID)
	in.Name = strings.TrimSpace(in.Name)
	principal, err := s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, in.ProjectID, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	if err = domain.ValidateHostingName(in.Name); err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, InvalidInput(err)
	}
	if err = validateManagedValue(in.Value); err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	if s.secretKeyring == nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable
	}
	id, err := prefixedID("msec")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	now := s.clock().UTC()
	item := domain.ManagedSecret{ID: id, ProjectID: in.ProjectID, Name: in.Name, CurrentVersion: 1, Status: "active", CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	envelope, err := s.secretKeyring.Seal(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: in.ProjectID, SecretID: id, Version: 1}, []byte(in.Value))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, errors.New("managed secret encryption failed")
	}
	record := store.ManagedSecretRecord{Metadata: domain.ManagedSecretVersion{SecretID: id, Version: 1, CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: now}, Envelope: envelope}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "managed_secret.created", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	return s.managedSecrets.CreateManagedSecret(ctx, item, record, event)
}

// RotateManagedSecret encrypts a new version and commits with compare-and-swap and audit.
func (s *Service) RotateManagedSecret(ctx context.Context, id string, in ManagedSecretRotateInput) (domain.ManagedSecret, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.managedSecretForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleMaintainer)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedVersion < 1 {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_version must be positive"))
	}
	if err = validateManagedValue(in.Value); err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	if item.Status != "active" || item.CurrentVersion != in.ExpectedVersion || in.ExpectedVersion == 9223372036854775807 {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, store.ErrConflict
	}
	if s.secretKeyring == nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable
	}
	version := in.ExpectedVersion + 1
	envelope, err := s.secretKeyring.Seal(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: item.ProjectID, SecretID: id, Version: version}, []byte(in.Value))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, errors.New("managed secret encryption failed")
	}
	record := store.ManagedSecretRecord{Metadata: domain.ManagedSecretVersion{SecretID: id, Version: version, CreatedBy: principal.ID, CreatedAt: s.clock().UTC()}, Envelope: envelope}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "managed_secret.rotated", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	return s.managedSecrets.RotateManagedSecret(ctx, id, in.ExpectedVersion, record, event)
}

// RevokeManagedSecret needs owner access but no decryption keys.
func (s *Service) RevokeManagedSecret(ctx context.Context, id string, in ManagedSecretRevokeInput) (domain.ManagedSecret, error) {
	_, principal, err := s.managedSecretForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	if in.ExpectedVersion < 1 {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("expected_version must be positive"))
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "managed_secret.revoked", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ManagedSecret{}, err
	}
	return s.managedSecrets.RevokeManagedSecret(ctx, id, in.ExpectedVersion, event)
}

// RevealManagedSecret returns plaintext only after decryption and a fresh committed active-state audit.
func (s *Service) RevealManagedSecret(ctx context.Context, id string, in ManagedSecretRevealInput) (ManagedSecretReveal, error) {
	item, principal, err := s.managedSecretForRole(ctx, id, domain.RoleOwner)
	if err != nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, err
	}
	if in.Version < 1 {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("version must be positive"))
	}
	if item.Status != "active" {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, store.ErrConflict
	}
	if s.secretKeyring == nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, ErrManagedSecretsUnavailable
	}
	record, err := s.managedSecrets.GetManagedSecretRecord(ctx, id, in.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, err
	}
	plaintext, err := s.secretKeyring.Open(secretcrypto.Binding{ProjectID: item.ProjectID, SecretID: id, Version: in.Version}, record.Envelope)
	if err != nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, errors.New("managed secret decryption failed")
	}
	if !utf8.Valid(plaintext) {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, errors.New("managed secret decryption failed")
	}
	event, err := s.auditEvent(ctx, principal.ID, "managed_secret.revealed", id, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, err
	}
	if err = s.managedSecrets.AuthorizeManagedSecretReveal(ctx, id, in.Version, event); err != nil {
		return ManagedSecretReveal{}, err
	}
	return ManagedSecretReveal{SecretID: id, Version: in.Version, Value: string(plaintext)}, nil
}
```

```text
package app

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"time"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/serverbootstrap"
	"nerocd/internal/store"
)

// ServerBootstrapArtifact qualifies one operator-provisioned binary. Path stays private.
type ServerBootstrapArtifact struct {
	ArtifactID   string `json:"artifact_id"`
	Path         string `json:"path"`
	Size         int64  `json:"size"`
	SHA256       string `json:"sha256"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	Architecture string `json:"architecture"`
	Profile      string `json:"profile"`
}

// ServerBootstrapConfig is frozen before workers start; nil disables onboarding.
type ServerBootstrapConfig struct {
	ControllerOrigin string                    `json:"controller_origin"`
	Artifacts        []ServerBootstrapArtifact `json:"artifacts"`
}

// ConfigureServerBootstrap validates explicit operator policy without remote I/O.
func (s *Service) ConfigureServerBootstrap(cfg *ServerBootstrapConfig) error {
	if cfg == nil {
		s.serverBootstrap = nil
		return nil
	}
	u, e := url.Parse(cfg.ControllerOrigin)
	if e != nil || u.Scheme != "https" || u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil || u.Path != "" || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" || u.Opaque != "" || len(cfg.Artifacts) < 1 || len(cfg.Artifacts) > 16 {
		return errors.New("invalid server bootstrap policy")
	}
	copyCfg := *cfg
	copyCfg.Artifacts = append([]ServerBootstrapArtifact(nil), cfg.Artifacts...)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, a := range copyCfg.Artifacts {
		info, e := os.Lstat(a.Path)
		if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !filepath.IsAbs(a.Path) || info.Size() != a.Size || !bootstrapOpaqueID.MatchString(a.ArtifactID) || seen[a.ArtifactID] || a.Profile != "prepared_debian12_v1" || a.Architecture != "arm64" {
			return errors.New("unqualified server bootstrap artifact")
		}

		f, err := os.Open(a.Path)
		if err != nil {
			return errors.New("unqualified server bootstrap artifact")
		}
		hash := sha256.New()
		n, err := io.Copy(hash, io.LimitReader(f, 256<<20+1))
		closeErr := f.Close()
		if err != nil || closeErr != nil || n != a.Size || hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)) != a.SHA256 {
			return errors.New("unqualified server bootstrap artifact")
		}
		seen[a.ArtifactID] = true
		_, _, e = serverbootstrap.CanonicalManifest(serverbootstrap.InstallManifest{Version: 1, InstallationID: "00000000000000000000000000000000", InstallOperationID: "00000000000000000000000000000001", RunnerID: "runner_validation", CredentialReferenceID: "credential_validation", ControllerURL: cfg.ControllerOrigin, Artifact: serverbootstrap.Artifact{Size: a.Size, SHA256: a.SHA256, Version: a.Version, Architecture: a.Architecture}, CapabilityPreset: domain.ServerBootstrapPreset})
		if e != nil {
			return errors.New("unqualified server bootstrap artifact")
		}
	}
	s.serverBootstrap = &copyCfg
	return nil
}

var bootstrapUUID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`)
var bootstrapOpaqueID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,127}$`)

// ServerBootstrapArtifactOption omits local paths and controller configuration.
type ServerBootstrapArtifactOption struct {
	ArtifactID   string `json:"artifact_id"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	Architecture string `json:"architecture"`
	Size         int64  `json:"size"`
	SHA256       string `json:"sha256"`
	Profile      string `json:"profile"`
}

// ServerBootstrapOptions explains availability without disclosing private configuration.
type ServerBootstrapOptions struct {
	Available         bool                            `json:"available"`
	UnavailableReason string                          `json:"unavailable_reason"`
	Profile           string                          `json:"profile"`
	Preset            string                          `json:"preset"`
	Artifacts         []ServerBootstrapArtifactOption `json:"artifacts"`
}

// ServerBootstrapCreateInput excludes caller-selected execution configuration.
type ServerBootstrapCreateInput struct {
	RequestID        string                       `json:"request_id"`
	ProjectID        string                       `json:"project_id"`
	Name             string                       `json:"name"`
	Target           domain.ServerBootstrapTarget `json:"target"`
	SSHSecretID      string                       `json:"ssh_secret_id"`
	SSHSecretVersion int64                        `json:"ssh_secret_version"`
	ArtifactID       string                       `json:"artifact_id"`
}

// ServerBootstrapCommandInput is closed at the HTTP boundary for each action.
type ServerBootstrapCommandInput struct {
	CommandID                  string `json:"command_id"`
	ExpectedVersion            int64  `json:"expected_version"`
	ProbeReceiptID             string `json:"probe_receipt_id,omitempty"`
	ManifestSHA256             string `json:"manifest_sha256,omitempty"`
	AcknowledgeInstallAndStart bool   `json:"acknowledge_install_and_start,omitempty"`
	GrantProject               *bool  `json:"grant_project,omitempty"`
}

// ServerBootstrapProgress exposes bounded command status without lease authority.
type ServerBootstrapProgress struct {
	CommandID string `json:"command_id"`
	Action    string `json:"action"`
	Status    string `json:"status"`
	Outcome   string `json:"outcome"`
	ReceiptID string `json:"receipt_id,omitempty"`
}

// ServerBootstrapProbe projects a committed, expiring prepared-host observation.
type ServerBootstrapProbe struct {
	ReceiptID     string                              `json:"receipt_id"`
	Prerequisites domain.ServerBootstrapPrerequisites `json:"prerequisites"`
	ObservedAt    time.Time                           `json:"observed_at"`
	ExpiresAt     time.Time                           `json:"expires_at"`
}

// ServerBootstrapReview identifies the exact reviewed installer manifest.
type ServerBootstrapReview struct {
	ManifestSHA256 string    `json:"manifest_sha256"`
	ProbeReceiptID string    `json:"probe_receipt_id"`
	ExpiresAt      time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
}

// ServerBootstrap is the public metadata projection; internal authority never crosses this boundary.
type ServerBootstrap struct {
	Artifact         ServerBootstrapArtifactOption `json:"artifact"`
	ID               string                        `json:"id"`
	ProjectID        string                        `json:"project_id"`
	Name             string                        `json:"name"`
	Target           domain.ServerBootstrapTarget  `json:"target"`
	ArtifactID       string                        `json:"artifact_id"`
	State            string                        `json:"state"`
	Version          int64                         `json:"version"`
	RemoteHold       bool                          `json:"remote_hold"`
	RestoreHeld      bool                          `json:"restore_held"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time                     `json:"created_at"`
	Progress         []ServerBootstrapProgress     `json:"progress"`
	Probe            *ServerBootstrapProbe         `json:"probe,omitempty"`
	Review           *ServerBootstrapReview        `json:"review,omitempty"`
	AvailableActions []string                      `json:"available_actions"`
	ServerID         string                        `json:"server_id,omitempty"`
	DestinationID    string                        `json:"destination_id,omitempty"`
	ReadinessState   string                        `json:"readiness_state"`
}

// ServerBootstrapList bounds metadata pages and reports whether another page exists.
type ServerBootstrapList struct {
	Items   []ServerBootstrap `json:"items"`
	Limit   int               `json:"limit"`
	Offset  int               `json:"offset"`
	HasMore bool              `json:"has_more"`
}

type serverBootstrapRepository interface {
	store.ServerBootstrapRepository
	ListServerBootstraps(context.Context, string, string, int, int) ([]domain.ServerBootstrapOperation, error)
	ServerBootstrapActor(context.Context, string) (string, error)
	ServerBootstrapEnrollmentConsumed(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error)
}

func (s *Service) bootstrapAdmin(ctx context.Context, project string) (serverBootstrapRepository, string, error) {
	p, e := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, "", e
	}
	if project != "" {
		if _, e = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, project, domain.RoleOwner); e != nil {
			return nil, "", e
		}
	}
	r, ok := s.hosting.(serverBootstrapRepository)
	if !ok {
		return nil, p.ID, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	return r, p.ID, nil
}

// ServerBootstrapOptions rechecks administrator and project owner access.
func (s *Service) ServerBootstrapOptions(ctx context.Context, project string) (ServerBootstrapOptions, error) {
	o := ServerBootstrapOptions{Profile: "prepared_debian12_v1", Preset: domain.ServerBootstrapPreset, Artifacts: []ServerBootstrapArtifactOption{}}
	if project == "" {
		return o, InvalidInput(errors.New("project_id is required"))
	}
	p, e := s.requireDestinationAdmin(ctx)
	if e != nil {
		return o, e
	}
	_ = p
	if _, e = s.authorizeHostingProject(ctx, project, domain.RoleOwner); e != nil {
		return o, e
	}
	switch {
	case s.serverBootstrap == nil:
		o.UnavailableReason = "disabled"
	case s.secretKeyring == nil:
		o.UnavailableReason = "managed_secrets_unavailable"
	default:
		if _, ok := s.hosting.(serverBootstrapRepository); !ok {
			o.UnavailableReason = "durable_store_required"
		} else {
			o.Available = true
		}
	}
	if o.Available {
		for _, a := range s.serverBootstrap.Artifacts {
			o.Artifacts = append(o.Artifacts, ServerBootstrapArtifactOption{a.ArtifactID, a.Version, a.Architecture, a.Size, a.SHA256, a.Profile})
		}
	}
	return o, nil
}

// CreateServerBootstrap reserves stable identities under an actor-bound request UUID.
func (s *Service) CreateServerBootstrap(ctx context.Context, in ServerBootstrapCreateInput) (ServerBootstrap, error) {
	r, actor, e := s.bootstrapAdmin(ctx, in.ProjectID)
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	options, e := s.ServerBootstrapOptions(ctx, in.ProjectID)
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	if !options.Available {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	if !bootstrapUUID.MatchString(in.RequestID) {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("request_id must be a UUID"))
	}
	var artifact *ServerBootstrapArtifact
	for i := range s.serverBootstrap.Artifacts {
		if s.serverBootstrap.Artifacts[i].ArtifactID == in.ArtifactID {
			artifact = &s.serverBootstrap.Artifacts[i]
		}
	}
	if artifact == nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("artifact_id is unavailable"))
	}
	input := domain.ServerBootstrapInput{ArtifactID: artifact.ArtifactID, ProjectID: in.ProjectID, Name: in.Name, Target: in.Target, ControllerURL: s.serverBootstrap.ControllerOrigin, Artifact: domain.ServerBootstrapArtifact{Size: artifact.Size, SHA256: artifact.SHA256, Version: artifact.Version, Architecture: artifact.Architecture}, SSHSecretID: in.SSHSecretID, SSHSecretVersion: in.SSHSecretVersion}
	if e = input.Validate(); e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(e)
	}
	event, e := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor, "server_bootstrap.created", "", nil)
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	op, e := r.CreateServerBootstrap(ctx, actor, in.RequestID, input, event)
	return s.bootstrapProjection(op, actor), e
}

// GetServerBootstrap returns the closed projection under current authority.
func (s *Service) GetServerBootstrap(ctx context.Context, id string) (ServerBootstrap, error) {
	r, actor, e := s.bootstrapAdmin(ctx, "")
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	op, e := r.GetServerBootstrap(ctx, actor, id)
	return s.bootstrapProjection(op, actor), e
}

// ListServerBootstraps returns one bounded, authorized project page.
func (s *Service) ListServerBootstraps(ctx context.Context, project string, limit, offset int) (ServerBootstrapList, error) {
	out := ServerBootstrapList{Items: []ServerBootstrap{}, Limit: limit, Offset: offset}
	if project == "" || limit < 1 || limit > 100 || offset < 0 || offset > 100000 {
		return out, InvalidInput(errors.New("invalid list parameters"))
	}
	r, actor, e := s.bootstrapAdmin(ctx, project)
	if e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	ops, e := r.ListServerBootstraps(ctx, actor, project, limit+1, offset)
	if e != nil {
		return out, e
	}
	out.HasMore = len(ops) > limit
	if out.HasMore {
		ops = ops[:limit]
	}
	for _, op := range ops {
		out.Items = append(out.Items, s.bootstrapProjection(op, actor))
	}
	return out, nil
}
func bootstrapManifest(op domain.ServerBootstrapOperation) (serverbootstrap.InstallManifest, []byte, string, error) {
	m := serverbootstrap.InstallManifest{Version: 1, InstallationID: op.IDs.InstallationID, InstallOperationID: op.IDs.InstallOperationID, RunnerID: op.IDs.RunnerID, CredentialReferenceID: op.IDs.CredentialReferenceID, ControllerURL: op.Input.ControllerURL, Artifact: serverbootstrap.Artifact(op.Input.Artifact), CapabilityPreset: domain.ServerBootstrapPreset}
	b, h, e := serverbootstrap.CanonicalManifest(m)
	return m, b, h, e
}

// CommandServerBootstrap binds action-specific public input to durable control.
func (s *Service) CommandServerBootstrap(ctx context.Context, id, action string, in ServerBootstrapCommandInput) (ServerBootstrap, error) {
	r, actor, e := s.bootstrapAdmin(ctx, "")
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	if s.serverBootstrap == nil && action != "cancel" {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	if !bootstrapUUID.MatchString(in.CommandID) || in.ExpectedVersion < 1 {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("command_id UUID and expected_version are required"))
	}
	if action != "review" && in.ProbeReceiptID != "" || action != "install" && (in.ManifestSHA256 != "" || in.AcknowledgeInstallAndStart || in.GrantProject != nil) {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("fields do not match command action"))
	}
	op, e := r.GetServerBootstrap(ctx, actor, id)
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	internalAction := action
	switch action {
	case "inspect":
		internalAction = "inspect_owned"
	case "register":
		internalAction = "register_server"
	case "grant":
		internalAction = "grant_destination"
	case "probe", "review", "install", "cancel":
	default:
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("unsupported command"))
	}
	command := domain.ServerBootstrapCommand{Key: in.CommandID, Action: internalAction, ExpectedVersion: in.ExpectedVersion, Deadline: op.CreatedAt.Add(domain.ServerBootstrapMaxLifetime), ProbeReceiptID: in.ProbeReceiptID, ManifestSHA256: in.ManifestSHA256, InstallAcknowledged: in.AcknowledgeInstallAndStart, GrantProject: in.GrantProject}
	if action == "review" {
		if in.ProbeReceiptID == "" {
			return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("probe_receipt_id is required"))
		}
		var probe *domain.ServerBootstrapProbeReceipt
		for _, stage := range op.Commands {
			if stage.Command.ID == in.ProbeReceiptID && stage.Command.Action == "probe" && stage.Receipt != nil && stage.Receipt.Outcome == "observed" {
				probe = stage.Receipt.Probe
			}
		}
		if probe == nil {
			return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("committed probe receipt is required"))
		}
		_, b, h, err := bootstrapManifest(op)
		if err != nil {
			return ServerBootstrap{}, err
		}
		command.Review = &domain.ServerBootstrapReview{Prerequisites: probe.Prerequisites, Manifest: b, ManifestSHA256: h, ProbeObservedAt: probe.ObservedAt, ProbeExpiresAt: probe.ExpiresAt, TargetHash: domain.HostingDocumentHash(op.Input.Target)}
	}
	if action == "install" && (!in.AcknowledgeInstallAndStart || in.GrantProject == nil || in.ManifestSHA256 == "") {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, InvalidInput(errors.New("reviewed manifest, installation acknowledgment, and explicit project grant choice are required"))
	}
	event, e := s.auditEvent(ctx, actor, "server_bootstrap.command_requested", id, nil)
	if e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	if _, e = r.RequestServerBootstrapCommand(ctx, actor, id, command, event); e != nil {
		return ServerBootstrap{}, e
	}
	op, e = r.GetServerBootstrap(ctx, actor, id)
	return s.bootstrapProjection(op, actor), e
}
func (s *Service) bootstrapProjection(op domain.ServerBootstrapOperation, actor string) ServerBootstrap {
	out := ServerBootstrap{ID: op.IDs.OperationID, ProjectID: op.Input.ProjectID, Name: op.Input.Name, Target: op.Input.Target, ArtifactID: op.Input.ArtifactID, State: op.State, Version: op.Version, RemoteHold: op.RemoteHold, RestoreHeld: op.RestoreHeld, CreatedAt: op.CreatedAt, Progress: []ServerBootstrapProgress{}, AvailableActions: []string{}, ReadinessState: "not_registered"}
	out.Artifact = ServerBootstrapArtifactOption{ArtifactID: op.Input.ArtifactID, Version: op.Input.Artifact.Version, Architecture: op.Input.Artifact.Architecture, Size: op.Input.Artifact.Size, SHA256: op.Input.Artifact.SHA256, Profile: "prepared_debian12_v1"}
	for _, stage := range op.Commands {
		action := stage.Command.Action
		switch action {
		case "inspect_owned":
			action = "inspect"
		case "register_server":
			action = "register"
		case "grant_destination":
			action = "grant"
		}
		p := ServerBootstrapProgress{CommandID: stage.Command.Key, Action: action, Status: "pending"}
		if stage.LeaseID != "" {
			p.Status = "running"
		}
		if stage.Receipt != nil {
			p.Status = "completed"
			p.Outcome = stage.Receipt.Outcome
			p.ReceiptID = stage.Command.ID
			if stage.Receipt.Probe != nil {
				v := stage.Receipt.Probe
				out.Probe = &ServerBootstrapProbe{stage.Command.ID, v.Prerequisites, v.ObservedAt, v.ExpiresAt}
			}
		}
		out.Progress = append(out.Progress, p)
		if stage.Command.Review != nil && stage.Receipt != nil {
			out.Review = &ServerBootstrapReview{stage.Command.Review.ManifestSHA256, stage.Command.ProbeReceiptID, stage.Command.Review.ProbeExpiresAt}
		}
	}
	if op.State == "registered" || op.State == "completed" {
		out.ServerID = op.IDs.ServerID
		out.DestinationID = op.IDs.DestinationID
		out.ReadinessState = "check_server_readiness"
	}
	if op.RestoreHeld || actor != op.CreatedBy || !op.CreatedAt.Add(domain.ServerBootstrapMaxLifetime).After(s.clock()) {
		return out
	}
	for _, a := range []string{"probe", "review", "install", "inspect", "register", "grant", "cancel"} {
		internal := a
		switch a {
		case "inspect":
			internal = "inspect_owned"
		case "register":
			internal = "register_server"
		case "grant":
			internal = "grant_destination"
		}
		if !domain.ServerBootstrapActionAllowed(internal, op.State, op.RemoteHold) || actor != op.CreatedBy && a != "inspect" {
			continue
		}
		if op.ActiveStage != nil && a != "inspect" && a != "cancel" {
			continue
		}
		if a == "review" && (out.Probe == nil || !out.Probe.ExpiresAt.After(s.clock()) || !out.Probe.Prerequisites.Qualifies(op.Input.Artifact.Architecture)) {
			continue
		}
		if a == "install" && (out.Review == nil || !out.Review.ExpiresAt.After(s.clock())) {
			continue
		}
		out.AvailableActions = append(out.AvailableActions, a)
	}
	return out
}
```
