package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"time"
)

// HostingAutoDeployMode delegates only unprotected deployment approval policy.
// It makes no claim about GitHub branch-protection configuration.
const HostingAutoDeployMode = "automatic_unprotected"

// HostingAutoDeployConfiguration explicitly reviews an existing healthy app and
// existing HTTPS routes. Host ports are always allocated by existing admission.
type HostingAutoDeployConfiguration struct {
	Mode                                   string                        `json:"mode"`
	ExpectedHealthyOperationID             string                        `json:"expected_healthy_operation_id"`
	ExpectedLoadedProxyOperationID         string                        `json:"expected_loaded_proxy_operation_id"`
	ExpectedLoadedGeneration               int64                         `json:"expected_loaded_generation"`
	ExpectedRuntimeConfigurationGeneration int64                         `json:"expected_runtime_configuration_generation"`
	ContainerPort                          int                           `json:"container_port"`
	Readiness                              HostingReadiness              `json:"readiness"`
	Routes                                 []HostingRouteSwitchSelection `json:"routes"`
}

// CanonicalHostingAutoDeployConfiguration validates and copies reviewed selectors.
func CanonicalHostingAutoDeployConfiguration(in HostingAutoDeployConfiguration) (HostingAutoDeployConfiguration, error) {
	if in.Mode != HostingAutoDeployMode || !hostingProxyID.MatchString(in.ExpectedHealthyOperationID) || !hostingProxyID.MatchString(in.ExpectedLoadedProxyOperationID) || in.ExpectedRuntimeConfigurationGeneration < 0 {
		return HostingAutoDeployConfiguration{}, errors.New("invalid automatic deployment configuration")
	}
	if err := ValidateHostingDeployment(HostingDeploymentInput{ExpectedGeneration: 1, IdempotencyKey: "automatic", ContainerPort: in.ContainerPort, HostPort: 0, Readiness: in.Readiness, ExpectedRuntimeConfigurationGeneration: in.ExpectedRuntimeConfigurationGeneration}); err != nil {
		return HostingAutoDeployConfiguration{}, err
	}
	route, err := CanonicalHostingRouteSwitchInput(HostingRouteSwitchInput{ExpectedLoadedGeneration: in.ExpectedLoadedGeneration, TargetReleaseOperationID: in.ExpectedHealthyOperationID, Routes: in.Routes})
	if err != nil {
		return HostingAutoDeployConfiguration{}, err
	}
	in.Routes = route.Routes
	return in, nil
}

// HostingAutoDeployStatus is viewer-safe current demand, not execution authority.
type HostingAutoDeployStatus struct {
	Mode                     string     `json:"mode"`
	State                    string     `json:"state"`
	Reason                   string     `json:"reason"`
	ManualEpoch              int64      `json:"manual_epoch"`
	DesiredCommit            string     `json:"desired_commit"`
	BuildID                  string     `json:"build_id"`
	DeploymentOperationID    string     `json:"deployment_operation_id"`
	SwitchOperationID        string     `json:"switch_operation_id"`
	Attempts                 int        `json:"attempts"`
	ExpiresAt                *time.Time `json:"expires_at,omitempty"`
	ObservedLoadedGeneration int64      `json:"observed_loaded_generation"`
}

// HostingAutoDeployOptions is fresh owner-only GET guidance, never admission.
// Baseline is absent when the current snapshot cannot qualify reviewed facts.
type HostingAutoDeployOptions struct {
	Available bool                       `json:"available"`
	Reason    string                     `json:"reason"`
	Baseline  *HostingAutoDeployBaseline `json:"baseline,omitempty"`
}

// HostingAutoDeployBaseline copies immutable manual bootstrap evidence. Port,
// readiness and runtime generation are reviewed facts, not editable defaults.
type HostingAutoDeployBaseline struct {
	HealthyOperationID             string                         `json:"healthy_operation_id"`
	LoadedProxyOperationID         string                         `json:"loaded_proxy_operation_id"`
	LoadedGeneration               int64                          `json:"loaded_generation"`
	RuntimeConfigurationGeneration int64                          `json:"runtime_configuration_generation"`
	ContainerPort                  int                            `json:"container_port"`
	Readiness                      HostingReadiness               `json:"readiness"`
	Routes                         []HostingAutoDeployRouteOption `json:"routes"`
	ManualEpoch                    int64                          `json:"manual_epoch"`
}

// HostingAutoDeployRouteOption is one currently eligible versioned owned route.
type HostingAutoDeployRouteOption struct {
	RouteID                    string `json:"route_id"`
	Hostname                   string `json:"hostname"`
	PathPrefix                 string `json:"path_prefix"`
	Version                    int64  `json:"version"`
	SelectedReleaseOperationID string `json:"selected_release_operation_id"`
}

// HostingBuildTriggerRevisionCapability identifies first-checkout commit pinning support.
const HostingBuildTriggerRevisionCapability = "hosting_build_trigger_revision_v1"

// HostingPrivateGitCapability identifies runners that implement bounded HTTPS
// Basic credential acquisition and private checkout. Public build support alone
// does not advertise this feature.
const HostingPrivateGitCapability = "hosting_git_https_basic_v1"

// HostingBuildProtocol identifies the immutable local source/build persistence contract.
const HostingBuildProtocol = "local-build.v1"

// HostingBuildSettings mirrors the accepted local engine's non-secret settings.

type HostingBuildSettings struct {

// HostingSourceGrant authorizes only Git transport for this exact source/policy.

var buildSettingTarget = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$`)
var buildDigest = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
var buildCommit = regexp.MustCompile(`^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$`)

// ValidateHostingBuildSettings checks canonical settings before any database mutation.
func ValidateHostingBuildSettings(s HostingBuildSettings) error {
	if s.Strategy != "dockerfile" && s.Strategy != "railpack" && s.Strategy != "static" {
		return errors.New("unsupported build strategy")
	}
	for _, p := range []string{s.ContextDir, s.DockerfilePath, s.PublishDir} {
		if p == "" {
			continue
		}
		if len(p) > 512 || !fs.ValidPath(p) || p == "." || path.Clean(p) != p || strings.ContainsAny(p, "\\:") || len(strings.Split(p, "/")) > 32 {
			return errors.New("invalid build settings path")
		}
		for _, c := range p {
			if unicode.IsControl(c) {
				return errors.New("invalid build settings path")
			}
		}
		for _, part := range strings.Split(p, "/") {
			n := strings.ToLower(part)
			if n == ".git-credentials" || n == ".kube" || n == ".azure" || n == ".gnupg" || n == ".terraform" || n == "auth.json" || n == ".yarnrc" || n == ".yarnrc.yml" || n == ".pypirc" || n == "credentials" || n == "credentials.json" || n == "id_rsa" || n == "id_ed25519" || n == ".git" || n == ".env" || strings.HasPrefix(n, ".env.") || n == ".ssh" || n == ".aws" || n == ".docker" || n == ".config" || n == ".npmrc" || n == ".netrc" || strings.HasSuffix(n, ".key") || strings.HasSuffix(n, ".pem") {
				return errors.New("credential path denied")
			}
		}
	}
	if s.BuildTarget != "" && !buildSettingTarget.MatchString(s.BuildTarget) {
		return errors.New("invalid build target")
	}
	if s.Strategy != "dockerfile" && (s.BuildTarget != "" || s.DockerfilePath != "") {
		return errors.New("dockerfile settings require dockerfile strategy")
	}
	if s.Strategy != "static" && (s.PublishDir != "" || s.SPAFallback) {
		return errors.New("static settings require static strategy")
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateHostingGitSource admits explicit policy-controlled Git source configuration.
func ValidateHostingGitSource(s HostingGitSource) error {
	if !buildID(s.ID) || !buildID(s.ResourceID) || !buildID(s.ProjectID) || s.Generation < 1 {
		return errors.New("invalid source identity")
	}
	u, err := s.Policy.ValidateURL(s.RepositoryURL, false)
	if err != nil || u.String() != s.RepositoryURL || len(s.RepositoryURL) > 8192 || s.Policy.CredentialReferenceID != "" {
		return errors.New("invalid repository policy or URL")
	}
	if s.CredentialKind != "public" && s.CredentialKind != "https_basic" && s.CredentialKind != "ssh_private_key" {
		return errors.New("invalid source credential kind")
	}
	if u.Scheme != "https" && u.Scheme != "ssh" || u.Scheme == "ssh" && s.CredentialKind != "ssh_private_key" || u.Scheme == "https" && s.CredentialKind == "ssh_private_key" {
		return errors.New("source authentication does not match transport")
	}
	if p := u.Port(); p != "" {
		if port, parseErr := strconv.Atoi(p); parseErr != nil || port < 1 || port > 65535 {
			return errors.New("invalid source port")
		}
	}
	r := s.RequestedRef
	if r == "" || r != strings.TrimSpace(r) || len(r) > 512 || strings.HasPrefix(r, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(r, ":*?[]\\~^ \t\r\n\x00") || strings.Contains(r, "..") || strings.Contains(r, "@{") || strings.ContainsFunc(r, unicode.IsControl) {
		return errors.New("invalid source ref")
	}
	return ValidateHostingBuildSettings(s.Settings)
}
func buildID(s string) bool {
	return s != "" && len(s) <= 128 && s == strings.TrimSpace(s) && !strings.ContainsFunc(s, unicode.IsControl)
}

// ValidateHostingBuildPolicy checks trusted engine and source acquisition budgets.
func ValidateHostingBuildPolicy(p HostingBuildPolicy) error {
	if !buildDigest.MatchString(p.Identity) || !buildDigest.MatchString(p.ToolchainIdentity) || p.Protocol != HostingBuildProtocol || (p.Platform != "linux/amd64" && p.Platform != "linux/arm64") {
		return errors.New("invalid trusted build policy")
	}
	a := p.SourceLimits
	if a.MaxTreeBytes <= 0 || a.MaxTreeBytes > 1<<50 || a.MaxWorkspaceBytes < a.MaxTreeBytes || a.MaxWorkspaceBytes > 1<<50 || a.MinFreeBytes <= 0 || a.MinFreeBytes > 1<<50 || a.MaxEntries < 1 || a.MaxEntries > 1000000 || a.MaxDepth < 1 || a.MaxDepth > 256 || a.PollInterval < 10*time.Millisecond || a.PollInterval > time.Second {
		return errors.New("invalid source acquisition limits")
	}
	l := p.Limits
	if l.CPUQuota < 2000 || l.CPUQuota > 1000000000 || l.MemoryBytes < 64<<20 || l.SwapBytes < 0 || l.Deadline <= 0 || l.Deadline > 24*time.Hour || l.ContextFiles <= 0 || l.DiskMode != "monitored" || l.PollInterval < 10*time.Millisecond || l.PollInterval > time.Second || l.ReserveBytes == 0 || l.ReserveBytes > 1<<50 || l.LogBytes > 64<<20 || l.PlanBytes > 16<<20 {
		return errors.New("invalid build limits")
	}
	for _, n := range []int64{l.ContextBytes, l.PlanBytes, l.LogBytes, l.ExportBytes, l.UnpackedBytes, l.UsageBytes, l.MemoryBytes} {
		if n <= 0 || n > 1<<50 {
			return errors.New("invalid bounded build limits")
		}
	}
	if l.SwapBytes > 1<<50 {
		return errors.New("invalid swap budget")
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateHostingBuildTriggerRevision checks optional trusted intent without
// changing historical nil-revision source semantics.
func ValidateHostingBuildTriggerRevision(s HostingBuildSnapshot) error {
	r := s.TriggerRevision
	if r == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if r.Version != 1 || !buildCommit.MatchString(r.ExpectedCommit) || strings.Trim(r.ExpectedCommit, "0") == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid build trigger revision")
	}
	configured := strings.ToLower(s.Source.RequestedRef)
	if buildCommit.MatchString(configured) && configured != r.ExpectedCommit {
		return errors.New("configured commit does not match trigger revision")
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateHostingBuildSourceReceipt binds a full commit and tree to the frozen source input.
func ValidateHostingBuildSourceReceipt(r HostingBuildSourceReceipt, s HostingBuildSnapshot) error {
	if ValidateHostingBuildTriggerRevision(s) != nil || s.TriggerRevision != nil && r.Commit != s.TriggerRevision.ExpectedCommit || (buildCommit.MatchString(s.Source.RequestedRef) && r.Commit != s.Source.RequestedRef) || r.BuildID != s.BuildID || r.SourceID != s.Source.ID || r.InputID != s.InputID || !buildCommit.MatchString(r.Commit) || r.PolicyHash != HostingDocumentHash(s.Source.Policy) || !buildDigest.MatchString(r.TreeDigest) {
		return errors.New("source receipt identity mismatch")
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidateHostingBuildArtifact checks local artifact identity against its committed source and daemon.
func ValidateHostingBuildArtifact(a HostingBuildArtifact, b HostingBuild) error {
	if b.SourceReceipt == nil || b.Snapshot.TriggerRevision != nil && ValidateHostingBuildSourceReceipt(*b.SourceReceipt, b.Snapshot) != nil || a.Origin != "local_build" || a.BuildID != b.ID || a.SourceID != b.Snapshot.Source.ID || a.InputID != b.Snapshot.InputID || a.SourceReceiptHash != HostingDocumentHash(b.SourceReceipt) || a.DaemonID == "" || a.DaemonID != b.DaemonID || a.Platform != b.Snapshot.Policy.Platform {
		return errors.New("artifact binding mismatch")
	}
	for _, d := range []string{a.ContextDigest, a.RequestDigest, a.ImageID, a.IndexDigest, a.ManifestDigest, a.ConfigDigest} {
		if !buildDigest.MatchString(d) {
			return errors.New("invalid artifact identity")
		}
	}
	if a.ImageID != a.IndexDigest && a.ImageID != a.ManifestDigest && a.ImageID != a.ConfigDigest {
		return errors.New("unrelated daemon image identity")
	}
	if b.Snapshot.Source.Settings.Strategy == "static" {
		if a.ContextPolicy != "static-assets-v1" {
			return errors.New("static artifact policy required")
		}
	} else if a.ContextPolicy != "" {
		return errors.New("unexpected artifact policy")
	}
	return nil
}

// ValidHostingBuildFailure admits fixed nonsecret codes, never stderr.
func ValidHostingBuildFailure(code string) bool {
	switch code {
	case "cancel_requested", "source_failed", "build_failed", "deadline_exceeded", "limits_exceeded", "cleanup_unconfirmed", "authority_lost", "canceled":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// ValidateHostingBuildTask rejects any generic execution material on an internal task.
// Persisted task targets and live lease authorization are separately mandatory.
func ValidateHostingBuildTask(run TaskRun) error {
	s := run.RunSpec
	if !validBuildTaskID(s.HostingBuildID) || run.ID != "build_run_"+s.HostingBuildID || s.Type != HostingBuildTaskType || s.Process != nil || s.Repository != nil || s.Workflow != nil || len(s.Inputs) != 0 || len(s.Secrets) != 0 || len(s.Artifacts) != 0 || len(run.Workflow.Steps) != 0 || s.HostingOperationID != "" || s.HostingMode != "" || s.ProxyOperationID != "" || s.ProxyMode != "" {
		return errors.New("invalid internal hosting build task")
	}
	return nil
}

func validBuildTaskID(id string) bool {
	if len(id) < 1 || len(id) > 63 {
		return false
	}
	for i, c := range id {
		if (c < 'a' || c > 'z') && (c < '0' || c > '9') && (c != '-' || i == 0) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

	}
	static := domain.HostingBuildSettings{Strategy: "static", ContextDir: "apps/web", PublishDir: "dist", SPAFallback: true}
	if domain.ValidateHostingBuildSettings(static) != nil {
		t.Fatal("prepared static settings denied")
	}

package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"path"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// ErrInvalidHostingStorage reports a closed metadata validation failure.
var ErrInvalidHostingStorage = errors.New("invalid hosting storage")

// HostingStorageInput creates desired metadata only. RequestID contains exactly
// 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated from 128 random bits and is
// retained unchanged across retries. It is not a hyphenated UUID.
type HostingStorageInput struct {
	RequestID                  string `json:"request_id"`
	ExpectedResourceGeneration int64  `json:"expected_resource_generation"`
	MountPath                  string `json:"mount_path"`
}

// HostingStorage is one immutable, retained local volume for a resource binding.
// Its binding-derived identifiers are nonsecret and independent of display names.
// Saving this document neither creates a Docker volume nor schedules execution.
type HostingStorage struct {
	ID            string    `json:"id"`
	ProjectID     string    `json:"project_id"`
	ResourceID    string    `json:"resource_id"`
	BindingID     string    `json:"binding_id"`
	DestinationID string    `json:"destination_id"`
	Kind          string    `json:"kind"`
	Driver        string    `json:"driver"`
	VolumeName    string    `json:"volume_name"`
	MountPath     string    `json:"mount_path"`
	AccessMode    string    `json:"access_mode"`
	Retention     string    `json:"retention"`
	Generation    int64     `json:"generation"`
	Hash          string    `json:"hash"`
	CreatedBy     string    `json:"created_by"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time `json:"created_at"`
}

// HostingStorageRef pins immutable metadata. Generation is initially always one;
// a later metadata version must never imply relocation or a different data volume.
type HostingStorageRef struct {
	StorageID  string `json:"storage_id"`
	Generation int64  `json:"generation"`
	Hash       string `json:"hash"`
}

var hostingStoragePath = regexp.MustCompile(`\A/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\z`)
var hostingStorageRequest = regexp.MustCompile(`\A[0-9a-f]{32}\z`)

// ValidateHostingStorageMountPath accepts canonical absolute container paths up
// to 512 bytes. The restricted alphabet excludes Docker CSV and bind syntax.
func ValidateHostingStorageMountPath(value string) error {
	if len(value) > 512 || value == "/" || !hostingStoragePath.MatchString(value) || path.Clean(value) != value {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	for _, reserved := range []string{"/proc", "/sys", "/dev"} {
		if value == reserved || strings.HasPrefix(value, reserved+"/") {
			return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// UnmarshalJSON rejects server-owned fields, duplicate keys and ambiguous input.
func (in *HostingStorageInput) UnmarshalJSON(raw []byte) error {
	if len(raw) > 4096 || !validRuntimeJSONUnicode(raw) {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, 3)
	for decoder.More() {
		token, err = decoder.Token()
		key, ok := token.(string)
		if err != nil || !ok || seen[key] {
			return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
		}
		switch key {
		case "request_id", "expected_resource_generation", "mount_path":
		default:
			return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
		}
		seen[key] = true
		var field json.RawMessage
		if decoder.Decode(&field) != nil || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(field), []byte("null")) {
			return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
		}
	}
	if token, err = decoder.Token(); err != nil || token != json.Delim('}') || len(seen) != 3 {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	if decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	type wire HostingStorageInput
	var value wire
	if strictSourceJSON(raw, &value) != nil {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	*in = HostingStorageInput(value)
	return nil
}

// Validate rejects unsupported request identities, generations and mount paths.
func (in HostingStorageInput) Validate() error {
	if !hostingStorageRequest.MatchString(in.RequestID) || in.ExpectedResourceGeneration < 1 {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	return ValidateHostingStorageMountPath(in.MountPath)
}

// HostingStorageIdentity derives a stable nonsecret identity from one immutable
// binding. The 128-bit identifier is never derived from a display or operation name.
func HostingStorageIdentity(binding string) (id, volume string) {
	suffix := HostingDocumentHash(struct {
		BindingID string `json:"binding_id"`
	}{binding})[7:39]
	return "hsv_" + suffix, "ncdv_" + suffix
}

// DocumentHash covers every immutable identity and mount policy field. Audit
// attribution and timestamps do not change the runtime metadata reference.
func (s HostingStorage) DocumentHash() string {
	return HostingDocumentHash(struct {
		ID            string `json:"id"`
		ProjectID     string `json:"project_id"`
		ResourceID    string `json:"resource_id"`
		BindingID     string `json:"binding_id"`
		DestinationID string `json:"destination_id"`
		Kind          string `json:"kind"`
		Driver        string `json:"driver"`
		VolumeName    string `json:"volume_name"`
		MountPath     string `json:"mount_path"`
		AccessMode    string `json:"access_mode"`
		Retention     string `json:"retention"`
		Generation    int64  `json:"generation"`
	}{s.ID, s.ProjectID, s.ResourceID, s.BindingID, s.DestinationID, s.Kind, s.Driver, s.VolumeName, s.MountPath, s.AccessMode, s.Retention, s.Generation})
}

// Validate checks the fixed initial contract and verifies its complete identity hash.
func (s HostingStorage) Validate() error {
	for _, value := range []string{s.ProjectID, s.ResourceID, s.BindingID, s.DestinationID, s.CreatedBy} {
		if !validRuntimeReferenceID(value) {
			return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
		}
	}
	id, volume := HostingStorageIdentity(s.BindingID)
	if s.ID != id || s.VolumeName != volume || s.Kind != "platform_managed" || s.Driver != "local" || s.AccessMode != "read_write" || s.Retention != "retain" || s.Generation != 1 || s.CreatedAt.IsZero() || s.Hash != s.DocumentHash() {
		return ErrInvalidHostingStorage
	}
	return ValidateHostingStorageMountPath(s.MountPath)
}

// Reference returns the exact immutable document reference for future admission.
func (s HostingStorage) Reference() HostingStorageRef {
	return HostingStorageRef{StorageID: s.ID, Generation: s.Generation, Hash: s.Hash}
}

// HostingStorageAuditID binds a retained creation audit to one resource request.
func HostingStorageAuditID(resource, request string) string {
	return "aud_hosting_storage_" + HostingDocumentHash(struct{ Resource, Request string }{resource, request})[7:]
}

func TestHostingStorageImmutableIdentityAndHash(t *testing.T) {
	id, volume := HostingStorageIdentity("binding_one")
	item := HostingStorage{ID: id, ProjectID: "project", ResourceID: "resource", BindingID: "binding_one", DestinationID: "destination", Kind: "platform_managed", Driver: "local", VolumeName: volume, MountPath: "/app/uploads", AccessMode: "read_write", Retention: "retain", Generation: 1, CreatedBy: "actor", CreatedAt: time.Now()}
	item.Hash = item.DocumentHash()
	if err := item.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := item.Reference(); got.StorageID != id || got.Generation != 1 || got.Hash != item.Hash {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	otherID, otherVolume := HostingStorageIdentity("binding_two")
	if otherID == id || otherVolume == volume {
		t.Fatal("distinct bindings share storage")
	}
	for _, mutate := range []func(*HostingStorage){
		func(s *HostingStorage) { s.ID = otherID }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.ProjectID = "other" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.ResourceID = "other" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.BindingID = "other" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.DestinationID = "other" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.Kind = "external" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.Driver = "nfs" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.VolumeName = "adopted" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.MountPath = "/different" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.AccessMode = "read_only" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.Retention = "delete" }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.Generation = 2 }, func(s *HostingStorage) { s.Hash = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("0", 64) },
	} {
		changed := item
		mutate(&changed)
		if changed.Validate() == nil {
			t.Fatalf("changed immutable document accepted: %+v", changed)
		}
	}
	changed := item
	changed.CreatedBy = "second_actor"
	changed.CreatedAt = changed.CreatedAt.Add(time.Hour)
	if changed.DocumentHash() != item.Hash {
		t.Fatal("audit metadata changed runtime identity")
	}
}

package hostingbuild

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type ownedResources struct{ DaemonID, Token, Builder, Planner, Volume, Group string }
type containerInfo struct {
	ID     string `json:"Id"`
	Config struct {
		Labels map[string]string
		Env    []string
		Image  string
		Cmd    []string
	}
	State struct {
		PID     int `json:"Pid"`
		Running bool
	}
	Mounts []struct{ Type, Source, Destination, Name string }
}

func durableJSON(p string, v any) error {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(p, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, writeErr := f.Write(b)
	syncErr := f.Sync()
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if err = errors.Join(writeErr, syncErr, closeErr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return syncDir(filepath.Dir(p))
}
func syncDir(p string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
	return f.Sync()
}
func (e *Engine) daemon(ctx context.Context, dir, expected string) error {
	b, err := e.docker(ctx, dir, "info", "--format", "{{json .}} ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var info struct {
		ID, OSType, CgroupVersion, DockerRootDir string
		SecurityOptions                          []string
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(b, &info) != nil || info.ID != expected || info.OSType != "linux" || info.CgroupVersion != "2" {
		return errors.New("fixed Linux cgroup-v2 daemon identity mismatch")
	}
	for _, s := range info.SecurityOptions {
		if strings.Contains(s, "rootless") {
			return errors.New("rootful BuildKit daemon host required")
		}
	}
	// The engine must see the daemon storage filesystem, not a remote socket VM.
	if !filepath.IsAbs(info.DockerRootDir) {
		return errors.New("daemon storage path unavailable")
	}
	if _, err = os.Stat(info.DockerRootDir); err != nil {
		return errors.New("engine must run on daemon host with storage visibility")
	}
	return nil
}
func (e *Engine) inspect(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) (containerInfo, error) {
	var c containerInfo
	b, err := e.docker(ctx, dir, "inspect", "--type", "container", name)
	if err != nil {
		return c, err
	}
	var rows []containerInfo
	if json.Unmarshal(b, &rows) != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].ID == "" {
		return c, errors.New("invalid container inspection")
	}
	return rows[0], nil
}
func owned(c containerInfo, r ownedResources) bool {
	return c.Config.Labels["io.nerocd.hostingbuild.owner"] == r.Token
}

// Build is synchronous. A process-wide host flock rejects concurrent admission.
// A durable intent blocks reuse after crashes or uncertain Docker cleanup.
func (e *Engine) Build(parent context.Context, r Request) (result Result, retErr error) {
	return e.BuildWithOutput(parent, r, nil)
}

// BuildWithOutput builds synchronously and observes selected fresh build text.
// Receipt replay emits no output. The sink is not part of immutable identity.
func (e *Engine) BuildWithOutput(parent context.Context, r Request, sink OutputSink) (result Result, retErr error) {
	if err := r.validate(parent); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	// Uncertainty is safe to reject before host admission, including callers
	// without permission to acquire the administrative host lock.
	marker := filepath.Join(e.config.StateDir, "cleanup_unconfirmed.json")
	if _, err := os.Lstat(marker); err == nil {
		return result, ErrCleanupUnconfirmed
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return result, err
	}
	if err := validateSourceSettings(parent, r); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	hostLock, err := acquireHostLock()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = hostLock.Close() }()
	lock, err := acquireLock(e.config.StateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = lock.Close() }()
	if _, err = os.Lstat(marker); err == nil {
		return result, ErrCleanupUnconfirmed
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return result, err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(parent, r.Limits.Deadline)
	defer cancel()
	dir := filepath.Join(e.config.StateDir, r.BuildID)
	policy := currentContextPolicy(r)
	requestHash, err := requestIdentity(r, e.config, policy)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err = os.Lstat(dir); err == nil {
		return e.replay(ctx, dir, r)
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = os.Mkdir(dir, 0700); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(dir, "docker"), 0700); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "docker", "config.json"), []byte("{}"), 0600); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = e.daemon(ctx, dir, r.DaemonID); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = e.admissionFree(ctx, dir, r.Limits); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err = e.docker(ctx, dir, "image", "inspect", BuildKitImage); err != nil {
		return result, errors.New("pinned BuildKit image must be provisioned before admission")
	}
	source := filepath.Join(dir, "context")
	contextHash, err := stageRequestContext(ctx, r, source, policy)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	var tokenBytes [16]byte
	if _, err = rand.Read(tokenBytes[:]); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	token := hex.EncodeToString(tokenBytes[:])
	builder := "nerocd-" + token
	resources := ownedResources{DaemonID: r.DaemonID, Token: token, Builder: "buildx_buildkit_" + builder + "0", Planner: "nerocd-planner-" + token, Volume: "buildx_buildkit_" + builder + "0_state", Group: filepath.Join(e.config.CgroupRoot, "build-"+token)}
	if err = durableJSON(marker, resources); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	defer func() {
		// Cleanup gets its own bounded context after caller/deadline cancellation.
		cleanupCtx, cleanupCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cleanupCancel()
		if cleanupErr := e.cleanup(cleanupCtx, dir, resources); cleanupErr != nil {
			retErr = errors.Join(retErr, ErrCleanupUnconfirmed, cleanupErr)
			return
		}
		if err := os.Remove(marker); err != nil {
			retErr = errors.Join(retErr, ErrCleanupUnconfirmed, err)
			return
		}
		if err := syncDir(e.config.StateDir); err != nil {
			retErr = errors.Join(retErr, ErrCleanupUnconfirmed, err)
		}
	}()
	if err = createBuildGroup(resources.Group, r.Limits); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err = e.docker(ctx, dir, "volume", "create", "--label", "io.nerocd.hostingbuild.owner="+token, resources.Volume); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	config := filepath.Join(dir, "buildkitd.toml")
	if err = os.WriteFile(config, []byte("insecure-entitlements = []\n[worker.oci]\n  enabled = true\n  max-parallelism = 2\n  defaultCgroupParent = "+strconv.Quote(groupRelative(resources.Group))+"\n[worker.containerd]\n  enabled = false\n"), 0600); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	l := r.Limits
	builderQuota, builderMemory, builderSwap := l.CPUQuota, l.MemoryBytes, l.SwapBytes
	if r.Strategy == Railpack {
		builderQuota /= 2
		builderMemory /= 2
		builderSwap /= 2
	}
	args := []string{"create", "--pull=never", "--name", resources.Builder, "--label", "io.nerocd.hostingbuild.owner=" + token, "--privileged", "--cgroupns=host", "--cgroup-parent", groupRelative(resources.Group), "--cpu-period", "100000", "--cpu-quota", strconv.FormatInt(builderQuota, 10), "--memory", strconv.FormatInt(builderMemory, 10), "--memory-swap", strconv.FormatInt(builderMemory+builderSwap, 10), "--log-driver", "none", "--mount", "type=volume,src=" + resources.Volume + ",dst=/var/lib/buildkit", "--mount", "type=bind,src=" + config + ",dst=/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml,readonly", BuildKitImage, "--config", "/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml", "--oci-worker-net=bridge"}
	if _, err = e.docker(ctx, dir, args...); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err = e.docker(ctx, dir, "start", resources.Builder); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	c, err := e.inspect(ctx, dir, resources.Builder)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if !owned(c, resources) || !c.State.Running {
		return result, errors.New("builder ownership/running verification failed")
	}
	group := groupRelative(resources.Group)
	actualGroup, inspectErr := containment(c.State.PID, l, resources.Group)
	err = inspectErr
	if err == nil && actualGroup != group && !strings.HasPrefix(actualGroup, group+"/") {
		err = errors.New("host PID/cgroup view does not match owned builder placement")
	}
	if err == nil {
		err = checkGroup(resources.Group, l)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	logs := &cappedWriter{remaining: l.LogBytes, cancel: cancel}
	observer := newOutputObserver(ctx, cancel, sink)
	// Register the pre-created, explicitly constrained builder. Buildx therefore
	// cannot add its default network.host daemon entitlement.
	if err = e.command(ctx, dir, logs, e.config.BuildxBinary, "create", "--name", builder, "--node", builder+"0", "--driver", "docker-container", "--driver-opt", "image="+BuildKitImage, "unix://"+e.config.Socket); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = e.command(ctx, dir, logs, e.config.BuildxBinary, "inspect", "--bootstrap", builder); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	booted, err := e.inspect(ctx, dir, resources.Builder)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if booted.ID != c.ID || !owned(booted, resources) || !booted.State.Running {
		return result, errors.New("buildx did not reuse the exact owned builder")
	}
	c = booted
	actualGroup, err = containment(c.State.PID, l, resources.Group)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if actualGroup != group && !strings.HasPrefix(actualGroup, group+"/") {
		return result, errors.New("bootstrapped builder escaped owned placement")
	}
	insideConfig, err := e.docker(ctx, dir, "exec", c.ID, "cat", "/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml")
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	expectedConfig, err := os.ReadFile(config)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if string(insideConfig) != string(expectedConfig) {
		return result, errors.New("BuildKit worker configuration changed")
	}
	watchCtx, stopWatch := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	watchDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { watchDone <- e.monitor(watchCtx, dir, resources, c, l, group, cancel) }()
	defer func() {
		if watchErr := joinMonitor(stopWatch, watchDone); watchErr != nil {
			retErr = errors.Join(retErr, watchErr)
		}
	}()
	frontend := DockerfileFrontend
	filename := r.DockerfilePath
	if filename == "" {
		filename = "Dockerfile"
	}
	switch r.Strategy {
	case Static:
		source, filename, err = prepareStaticContext(source, r.SPAFallback)
		if err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	case Railpack:
		frontend = RailpackFrontend
		filename = "railpack-plan.json"
		if err = e.plan(ctx, dir, source, resources, r, logs, observer); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	}
	export := filepath.Join(dir, "image.oci.tar")
	buildArgs := []string{"build", "--no-cache", "--builder", builder, "--platform", r.Platform, "--provenance=false", "--sbom=false", "--progress=plain", "--network=default", "--build-arg", "BUILDKIT_SYNTAX=" + frontend, "--file", filepath.Join(source, filename), "--output", "type=oci,dest=" + export + ",compression=gzip,force-compression=true", source}
	if r.BuildTarget != "" {
		buildArgs = append(buildArgs[:len(buildArgs)-1], "--target", r.BuildTarget, source)
	}
	if err = e.observedCommand(ctx, dir, logs, observer, OutputBuildKit, false, e.config.BuildxBinary, buildArgs...); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = verifyDescendants(ctx, c.State.PID, group, l); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	identity, err := validateExport(ctx, export, filepath.Join(dir, "validated"), r.Platform, l)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = e.daemon(ctx, dir, r.DaemonID); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err = e.docker(ctx, dir, "load", "--input", export); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	result = Result{Origin: "local_build", BuildID: r.BuildID, SourceID: r.SourceID, InputID: r.InputID, RequestDigest: requestHash, ContextDigest: contextHash, DaemonID: r.DaemonID, ImageID: identity.Index, IndexDigest: identity.Index, ManifestDigest: identity.Manifest, ConfigDigest: identity.Config, Platform: identity.Platform, ContextPolicy: policy}
	// Docker's containerd store identifies OCI imports by descriptor digest;
	// classic stores may identify the image by its config digest. Every
	// candidate below comes exclusively from the validated export.
	for _, id := range []string{identity.Index, identity.Manifest, identity.Config} {
		result.ImageID = id
		err = e.verifyImage(ctx, dir, result)
		if err == nil {
			break
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if err = durableJSON(filepath.Join(dir, "receipt.json"), result); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (e *Engine) replay(ctx context.Context, dir string, r Request) (Result, error) {
	var receipt Result
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "receipt.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return receipt, errors.New("build ID already used without completed receipt")
	}
	if len(b) > 16384 || json.Unmarshal(b, &receipt) != nil {
		return Result{}, errors.New("invalid retained build receipt")
	}
	requestHash, err := requestIdentity(r, e.config, receipt.ContextPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if receipt.RequestDigest != requestHash || receipt.Origin != "local_build" || receipt.BuildID != r.BuildID || receipt.SourceID != r.SourceID || receipt.InputID != r.InputID || receipt.DaemonID != r.DaemonID || receipt.Platform != r.Platform || !digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.ContextDigest) {
		return Result{}, errors.New("build ID immutable input mismatch")
	}
	temp, err := os.MkdirTemp(e.config.StateDir, "replay-")
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(temp) }()
	digest, err := stageRequestContext(ctx, r, filepath.Join(temp, "context"), receipt.ContextPolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if digest != receipt.ContextDigest {
		return Result{}, errors.New("completed build source content changed")
	}
	identity, err := validateExport(ctx, filepath.Join(dir, "image.oci.tar"), filepath.Join(temp, "validated"), r.Platform, r.Limits)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if identity.Config != receipt.ConfigDigest || identity.Manifest != receipt.ManifestDigest || identity.Index != receipt.IndexDigest {
		return Result{}, errors.New("retained export identity changed")
	}
	if err = e.daemon(ctx, dir, r.DaemonID); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	if err = e.verifyImage(ctx, dir, receipt); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	return receipt, nil
}
func (e *Engine) verifyImage(ctx context.Context, dir string, r Result) error {
	if !digestPattern.MatchString(r.ImageID) || (r.ImageID != r.ConfigDigest && r.ImageID != r.ManifestDigest && r.ImageID != r.IndexDigest) {
		return errors.New("invalid image identity")
	}
	b, err := e.docker(ctx, dir, "image", "inspect", r.ImageID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var rows []struct {
		ID               string `json:"Id"`
		Architecture, OS string
	}
	if json.Unmarshal(b, &rows) != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].ID != r.ImageID || rows[0].OS+"/"+rows[0].Architecture != r.Platform {
		return errors.New("loaded image config/platform mismatch")
	}
	return nil
}
func checkFree(p string, l Limits) error {
	n, err := freeBytes(p)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if n < l.ReserveBytes {
		return errors.New("free disk reserve breached")
	}
	return nil
}
func usage(ctx context.Context, p string) (int64, error) {
	var total int64
	err := scanTree(newScanBudget(ctx), p, func(_ string, i fs.FileInfo) error {
		if i.Mode().IsRegular() {
			if i.Size() > 1<<50-total {
				return errors.New("usage overflow")
			}
			total += i.Size()
		}
		return nil
	})
	return total, err
}

func (e *Engine) monitor(ctx context.Context, dir string, r ownedResources, c containerInfo, l Limits, group string, cancel context.CancelFunc) error {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(l.PollInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil
		case <-ticker.C:
			err := verifyDescendants(ctx, c.State.PID, group, l)
			if err == nil {
				err = checkFree(e.config.StateDir, l)
			}
			var n int64
			if err == nil {
				n, err = usage(ctx, dir)
				if n > l.UsageBytes {
					err = errors.New("owned workspace disk budget exceeded")
				}
			}
			if err == nil {
				st, e := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "image.oci.tar"))
				if e == nil && st.Size() > l.ExportBytes {
					err = errors.New("export byte budget exceeded")
				}
			}
			// BuildKit storage lives on an owned Docker volume, which must be visible on
			// the local Linux daemon host. It is measured separately from the workspace.
			if err == nil {
				for _, m := range c.Mounts {
					if m.Type == "volume" && m.Name == r.Volume {
						if err = checkFree(m.Source, l); err != nil {
							break
						}
						var v int64
						v, err = usage(ctx, m.Source)
						if err == nil && v > l.UsageBytes-n {
							err = errors.New("owned builder disk budget exceeded")
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if err != nil {
				if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
					return nil
				}
				cancel()
				return err
			}
		}
	}
}

func (e *Engine) admissionFree(ctx context.Context, dir string, l Limits) error {
	storage, err := e.docker(ctx, dir, "info", "--format", "{{.DockerRootDir}}")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	daemonRoot := strings.TrimSpace(string(storage))
	if !filepath.IsAbs(daemonRoot) {
		return errors.New("daemon storage path unavailable")
	}
	// Nominal owned bytes plus an image import fit above the reserve on both
	// filesystems. Sampling still permits overshoot and concurrent disk use.
	required := l.ReserveBytes + uint64(l.UsageBytes) + uint64(l.UnpackedBytes)
	for _, p := range []string{e.config.StateDir, daemonRoot} {
		free, err := freeBytes(p)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if free < required {
			return errors.New("build budgets do not fit above free-space reserve")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

package hostingproxy

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/x509"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"time"
)

// Outcome describes whether a generation was verified, rejected, or left uncertain.
type Outcome string

const (
	// Applied means the desired routing generation loaded; TLS may still be pending.
	Applied Outcome = "applied"
	// RolledBack means the previous routing generation was restored and verified.
	RolledBack Outcome = "rolled_back"
	// Uncertain requires the caller to retain its fenced proxy hold for reconciliation.
	Uncertain Outcome = "uncertain"
	// Refused means validation or admission prevented a new generation mutation.
	Refused Outcome = "refused"
)

// Certificate contains public TLS observations and never certificate or account keys.
type Certificate struct {
	Hostname, Issuer, Fingerprint, Status string
	ExpiresAt                             time.Time
}

// RouteObservation separates loaded HTTP routing from trusted HTTPS readiness.
type RouteObservation struct {
	RouteID               string
	HTTPReady, HTTPSReady bool
	Certificate           Certificate
}

// Result reports the desired and last verified routing generation.
// Outcome remains meaningful when a method also returns an error; callers must
// retain their hold on Uncertain and must not infer HTTPS readiness from Applied.
type Result struct {
	Outcome                             Outcome
	DesiredGeneration, LoadedGeneration uint64
	Hash, ContainerID                   string
	Routes                              []RouteObservation
}

// Engine methods serialize through an owner-only Linux file lock across processes.
// They do not replace the caller's fenced lease or provide atomic Docker fencing.
type Engine struct {
	settings          Settings
	fixtureCA         string
	fixtureRoots      *x509.CertPool
	fixtureDockerArgs []string
	verifyTimeout     time.Duration
}

// New validates trusted operator settings and requires a Linux host.
// It performs no installation; each operation acquires its own local state lock.
func New(s Settings) (*Engine, error) {
	if err := platform(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateSettings(s); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Engine{settings: s, verifyTimeout: 15 * time.Second}, nil
}
func (e *Engine) validate(p Plan) error {
	if p.hash == "" || !reflect.DeepEqual(p.settings, e.settings) {
		return errors.New("plan does not belong to engine settings")
	}
	return platform()
}

// Install creates an absent proxy or verifies a matching installed generation.
// It refuses foreign containers and occupied ports without replacing them.
func (e *Engine) Install(ctx context.Context, p Plan) (Result, error) { return e.apply(ctx, p, true) }

// Apply replaces the complete routing generation after checking its predecessor.
// A replay of the same generation and hash verifies and acknowledges existing state.
func (e *Engine) Apply(ctx context.Context, p Plan) (Result, error) { return e.apply(ctx, p, false) }
func (e *Engine) apply(ctx context.Context, p Plan, install bool) (result Result, err error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	result = Result{Outcome: Refused, DesiredGeneration: p.generation, Hash: p.hash}
	if err = e.validate(p); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if install && p.verification != nil {
		return result, errors.New("verified switch cannot install a proxy")
	}
	s, err := openStorage(ctx, e.settings.Directory)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	defer s.close()
	old, err := s.load()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if old.Generation != 0 && (old.Identity != p.identity || old.StaticHash != p.staticHash) {
		return result, errors.New("persistent identity or static settings mismatch")
	}
	if old.Phase != "" && old.Phase != "committed" {
		result.Outcome = Uncertain
		return result, errors.New("unfinished prior operation; retain controller hold")
	}
	if old.Generation != 0 {
		if err = s.checkFile("certificates/acme.json"); err != nil {
			result.Outcome = Uncertain
			return result, err
		}
	}
	c, err := e.find(ctx, p)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if c != nil {
		result.ContainerID = c.ID
	}
	if old.Hash == p.hash && old.Generation == p.generation {
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(old.Verification, p.verification) {
			result.Outcome = Uncertain
			return result, errors.New("generation verification policy mismatch")
		}
		if c == nil {
			return result, errors.New("recorded proxy container missing; explicit recovery required")
		}
		if err = e.loaded(ctx, p); err != nil {
			result.Outcome = Uncertain
			return result, err
		}
		if old.Phase != "committed" {
			result.Outcome = Uncertain
			return result, errors.New("unfinished generation requires explicit recovery")
		}
		return e.verifiedObservation(ctx, p, c.ID)
	}

	if old.Generation != p.previous {
		return result, errors.New("stale previous generation")
	}
	if err = p.switchPredecessor(old, install); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		if !install || old.Generation != 0 {
			return result, errors.New("proxy is not installed")
		}
		if err = checkPorts(e.settings.ManagementPort); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	} else if old.Generation == 0 {
		return result, errors.New("owned container lacks generation receipt")
	}
	if err = e.daemon(ctx, p); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	previous := p
	previous.generation = old.Generation
	previous.hash = old.Hash
	previous.routes = append([]Route(nil), old.Routes...)
	if p.verification != nil {
		// The selected old routes must be a recoverable baseline before intent.
		if err = e.loaded(ctx, previous); err != nil {
			return result, errors.New("verified switch predecessor is not loaded")
		}
		if _, err = e.verifiedObservation(ctx, previous, c.ID); err != nil {
			return result, errors.New("verified switch predecessor HTTP or trusted HTTPS is not ready")
		}
		b, x := s.read("dynamic/routes.yml")
		if x != nil || !bytes.Equal(b, previous.dynamic()) {
			return result, errors.New("verified switch predecessor file differs from loaded receipt")
		}
	}
	if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	next := receipt{Identity: p.identity, StaticHash: p.staticHash, Hash: p.hash, Generation: p.generation, Routes: p.Routes(), Phase: "intent", Verification: p.verification}
	// An intent precedes external effects. Any lost response after this point is uncertain.
	if err = s.save(next); err != nil {
		result.Outcome = Uncertain
		return result, err
	}
	result.Outcome = Uncertain
	if c == nil {
		if _, err = s.root.Lstat("certificates/acme.json"); errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			f, x := s.root.OpenFile("certificates/acme.json", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
			if x != nil {
				return result, x
			}
			if x = f.Sync(); x != nil {
				_ = f.Close()
				return result, x
			}
			if x = f.Close(); x != nil {
				return result, x
			}
		}
		if err = s.checkFile("certificates/acme.json"); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		if _, err = e.command(ctx, p, "pull", Image); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
	}
	if old.Generation != 0 {
		b, x := s.read("dynamic/routes.yml")
		if x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		if x = s.atomic("previous.json", b); x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
	}
	if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = s.atomic("dynamic/routes.yml", p.dynamic()); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if c == nil {
		if err = e.launch(ctx, p); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		c, err = e.find(ctx, p)
		if err != nil || c == nil {
			return result, errors.New("proxy launch response uncertain")
		}
		result.ContainerID = c.ID
	}
	verified, err := e.waitVerified(ctx, p, c.ID)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return result, ctx.Err()
		}
		if old.Generation == 0 {
			return result, err
		}
		b, x := s.read("previous.json")
		if x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		if x = ctx.Err(); x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		if x = s.atomic("dynamic/routes.yml", b); x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		restored, x := e.waitVerified(ctx, previous, c.ID)
		if x != nil {
			return result, errors.New("rollback not verified; retain controller hold")
		}
		if x = ctx.Err(); x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		outcome, x := persistRollbackReceipt(ctx, p.verification != nil, func() error { return s.save(old) })
		if x != nil {
			return result, x
		}
		result.Outcome = outcome
		result.LoadedGeneration = old.Generation
		if p.verification != nil {
			result.Routes = restored.Routes
		}
		return result, errors.New("candidate rejected; previous generation restored")
	}
	if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	next.Phase = "committed"
	if err = s.save(next); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if p.verification == nil {
		return e.observation(ctx, p, c.ID), nil
	}
	return verified, nil
}

// persistRollbackReceipt keeps durable restoration separate from acknowledgment.
func persistRollbackReceipt(ctx context.Context, strict bool, save func() error) (Outcome, error) {
	if err := save(); err != nil {
		return Uncertain, err
	}
	if strict && ctx.Err() != nil {
		return Uncertain, ctx.Err()
	}
	return RolledBack, nil
}

// Observe verifies the committed receipt, owned container, loaded routes, and probes.
// It never acknowledges unfinished intent or treats an untrusted certificate as ready.
func (e *Engine) Observe(ctx context.Context, p Plan) (Result, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	result := Result{Outcome: Uncertain, DesiredGeneration: p.generation, Hash: p.hash}
	if err := e.validate(p); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	s, err := openStorage(ctx, e.settings.Directory)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	defer s.close()
	r, err := s.load()
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if r.Identity != p.identity || r.Hash != p.hash || r.Generation != p.generation || r.Phase != "committed" || !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Verification, p.verification) {
		return result, errors.New("generation receipt not committed or mismatched")
	}
	if err = s.checkFile("certificates/acme.json"); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	c, err := e.find(ctx, p)
	if err != nil || c == nil {
		return result, errors.New("owned proxy not observable")
	}
	if err = e.loaded(ctx, p); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	return e.verifiedObservation(ctx, p, c.ID)
}
func (e *Engine) waitLoaded(ctx context.Context, p Plan) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, e.verifyTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	for {
		if err := e.loaded(ctx, p); err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}

// waitVerified uses one bounded verification window and no background retries.
// Legacy plans retain their loaded-generation and TLS-pending success contract.
func (e *Engine) waitVerified(ctx context.Context, p Plan, id string) (Result, error) {
	if p.verification == nil {
		return Result{}, e.waitLoaded(ctx, p)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, e.verifyTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	for {
		if err := e.loaded(ctx, p); err == nil {
			if result, err := e.verifiedObservation(ctx, p, id); err == nil {
				return result, nil
			}
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return Result{}, ctx.Err()
		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}

func (e *Engine) verifiedObservation(ctx context.Context, p Plan, id string) (Result, error) {
	result := e.observation(ctx, p, id)
	if p.verification == nil {
		return result, nil
	}
	for _, route := range result.Routes {
		if p.required(route.RouteID) && (!route.HTTPReady || !route.HTTPSReady) {
			result.Outcome = Uncertain
			return result, errors.New("selected route HTTP or trusted HTTPS verification failed; retain controller hold")
		}
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		result.Outcome = Uncertain
		return result, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

package runnerruntime

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingbuild"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingbuildprotocol"
	"nerocd/internal/runner"
	"nerocd/internal/runnerclient"
)

// errSettledBuildFailure is returned only after exact server completion proof
// and durable local journal acknowledgment. It does not describe uncertainty.
var errSettledBuildFailure = errors.New("local build failed after confirmed completion")

// BuildPhaseClient is the authenticated nonsecret build protocol. Implementations
// must support concurrent status requests and honor cancellation.
type BuildPhaseClient interface {
	BuildStatus(context.Context, hostingbuildprotocol.StatusRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.StatusResponse, error)
	BuildSourceBegin(context.Context, hostingbuildprotocol.SourceBeginRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error)
	BuildSourceCommit(context.Context, hostingbuildprotocol.SourceCommitRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error)
	BuildPrepare(context.Context, hostingbuildprotocol.PrepareRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error)
	BuildComplete(context.Context, hostingbuildprotocol.CompleteRequest) (hostingbuildprotocol.PhaseResponse, error)
}

// BuildTarget is trusted placement, never a resource-user request. An empty
// BindingID explicitly permits bindings on this exact runner/server/destination.
type BuildTarget struct{ RunnerID, ServerID, DestinationID, BindingID string }

// BuildConfig contains explicit operator settings. Policy must exactly match the
// server snapshot. SourceRoot and Engine.StateDir must be separate owned roots.
type BuildConfig struct {
	PrivateGit                     *PrivateGitConfig
	SourceRoot                     string
	Engine                         hostingbuild.Config
	Policy                         domain.HostingBuildPolicy
	Target                         BuildTarget
	StatusInterval, RequestTimeout time.Duration
}

// PrivateGitConfig enables trusted HTTPS Basic/PAT checkout explicitly.
// TrustedLoopbackHTTP permits only isolated literal-loopback controller fixtures.
type PrivateGitConfig struct {
	TrustedLoopbackHTTP bool `json:"trusted_loopback_http"`
}

type localBuildEngine interface {
	Build(context.Context, hostingbuild.Request) (hostingbuild.Result, error)
}
type privateBuildCheckout func(context.Context, domain.HostingBuildSnapshot, string, string, func(context.Context) (SourceCredential, error), func(context.Context, domain.HostingBuildSourceReceipt) error, func(context.Context, string) error) error
type buildCheckout func(context.Context, domain.HostingBuildSnapshot, string, string, func(context.Context, domain.HostingBuildSourceReceipt) error, func(context.Context, string) error) error

// BuildExecutor executes explicitly configured trusted Git builds. It never settles a generic run.
// Reconcile must finish before Execute. Host and journal locks prevent concurrent
// effects; an unresolved intent blocks another execution of the same build.
type BuildExecutor struct {
	config          BuildConfig
	client          BuildPhaseClient
	journal         *runner.AttemptJournal
	engine          localBuildEngine
	checkout        buildCheckout
	privateCheckout privateBuildCheckout
	lock            func(string, string) (func(), error)
	observe         func(context.Context) (string, error)
	logSecrets      []runner.SecretMaterial
}

// ComputeBuildToolchainIdentity hashes a versioned inventory without local paths.
// Docker is hashed with a 128 MiB bound; the engine independently checks the
// pinned Buildx binary and immutable planner image before it accepts builds.
func ComputeBuildToolchainIdentity(ctx context.Context, c hostingbuild.Config, platform string) (string, error) {
	if platform != "linux/amd64" && platform != "linux/arm64" {
		return "", errors.New("unsupported build platform")
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(c.DockerBinary) || filepath.Clean(c.DockerBinary) != c.DockerBinary {
		return "", errors.New("explicit Docker binary required")
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(c.DockerBinary)
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode().Perm()&0022 != 0 || info.Mode().Perm()&0111 == 0 || info.Size() > 128<<20 {
		return "", errors.New("unsafe Docker binary")
	}
	f, err := os.Open(c.DockerBinary)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("docker binary unavailable")
	}
	defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
	h := sha256.New()
	b := make([]byte, 64<<10)
	var n int64
	for {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", ctx.Err()
		}
		read, e := f.Read(b)
		n += int64(read)
		if n > 128<<20 {
			return "", errors.New("docker binary exceeds bound")
		}
		_, _ = h.Write(b[:read])
		if e == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if e != nil {
			return "", errors.New("docker binary unreadable")
		}
	}
	inventory := struct{ Version, Protocol, Platform, DockerSHA256, BuildxSHA256, BuildKit, Dockerfile, Railpack, Static, Planner string }{
		"hosting-executor-toolchain.v1", domain.HostingBuildProtocol, platform, "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), c.BuildxSHA256, hostingbuild.BuildKitImage, hostingbuild.DockerfileFrontend, hostingbuild.RailpackFrontend, hostingbuild.StaticImage, c.PlannerImage,
	}
	return domain.HostingDocumentHash(inventory), nil
}

// Validate checks the same local prerequisites as NewBuildExecutor without a
// journal, server request or build effects. It may initialize engine state.
func (c BuildConfig) Validate() error { _, err := validatedBuildEngine(c); return err }
func validBuildPlacementID(id string) bool {
	if len(id) < 1 || len(id) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range id {
		if c != '_' && c != '-' && (c < 'a' || c > 'z') && (c < 'A' || c > 'Z') && (c < '0' || c > '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func validatedBuildEngine(c BuildConfig) (*hostingbuild.Engine, error) {
	if domain.ValidateHostingBuildPolicy(c.Policy) != nil || c.Policy.Platform != "linux/"+runtime.GOARCH || c.StatusInterval < 10*time.Millisecond || c.StatusInterval > time.Second || c.RequestTimeout < 10*time.Millisecond || c.RequestTimeout > 30*time.Second {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid explicit build configuration")
	}
	for _, id := range []string{c.Target.RunnerID, c.Target.ServerID, c.Target.DestinationID} {
		if !validBuildPlacementID(id) {
			return nil, errors.New("explicit build target required")
		}
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(c.SourceRoot) || filepath.Clean(c.SourceRoot) != c.SourceRoot || c.SourceRoot == c.Engine.StateDir || buildPathContains(c.SourceRoot, c.Engine.StateDir) || buildPathContains(c.Engine.StateDir, c.SourceRoot) {
		return nil, errors.New("separate absolute build roots required")
	}
	if err := validateBuildSourceRoot(c.SourceRoot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	identity, err := ComputeBuildToolchainIdentity(context.Background(), c.Engine, c.Policy.Platform)
	if err != nil || identity != c.Policy.ToolchainIdentity {
		return nil, errors.New("build toolchain identity mismatch")
	}

// NewBuildExecutor validates local prerequisites. It creates no build effects.
func NewBuildExecutor(c BuildConfig, client BuildPhaseClient, journal *runner.AttemptJournal) (*BuildExecutor, error) {
	if client == nil || journal == nil {

			return nil, errors.New("typed private credential client required")
		}
	}
	engine, err := validatedBuildEngine(c)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Own the policy slices instead of retaining mutable caller configuration.
	raw, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &c); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	e := &BuildExecutor{config: c, client: client, journal: journal, engine: engine, checkout: checkoutPublicBuild, privateCheckout: checkoutBuildWithCredential, lock: lockBuildSource}

}

// Private delivery never runs during startup reconciliation. Its request ID is
// already durable, and retries cannot mint a fresh server-side credential window.
type privateBuildCredentialClient interface {
	BuildSourceCredential(context.Context, string, domain.HostingSourceCredentialRequest, runnerclient.SourceCredentialTransport) (hostingbuildprotocol.SourceCredential, error)
}

func (e *BuildExecutor) validBuildCredentialSnapshot(s domain.HostingBuildSnapshot) bool {
	if s.Source.CredentialKind == "public" {
		return s.Grant == nil
	}
	if e.config.PrivateGit == nil || s.Source.CredentialKind != "https_basic" || s.Grant == nil {
		return false
	}
	g := s.Grant
	return g.ID != "" && g.Version == 1 && !g.Revoked && g.Kind == "https_basic" && g.SourceID == s.Source.ID && g.ResourceID == s.Source.ResourceID && g.ProjectID == s.Source.ProjectID && g.RepositoryURL == s.Source.RepositoryURL && g.PolicyHash == domain.HostingDocumentHash(s.Source.Policy) && g.SecretID != "" && g.SecretVersion > 0 && g.CreatedBy != ""

func (e *BuildExecutor) privateBuildCredential(ctx context.Context, a domain.HostingBuildAuthority, s domain.HostingBuildSnapshot, intentID string) (hostingbuildprotocol.SourceCredential, error) {

	id, prefixed := strings.CutPrefix(intentID, "build_intent_")
	if !ok || !prefixed || len(id) != 32 || !domain.ValidHostingSourceDeliveryID(id) || !e.validBuildCredentialSnapshot(s) || e.config.PrivateGit == nil {
		return zero, errors.New("private credential intent unavailable")
	}
	retained := false
	for _, entry := range e.journal.Snapshot().Build {
		if entry.ID == intentID && entry.Phase == "attempt_intent" && buildAuthority(entry.Attempt, entry.BuildID) == a && entry.InputHash == domain.HostingDocumentHash(s) {
			retained = true
		}
	}
	if !retained {
		return zero, errors.New("private credential intent not durable")
	}
	request := domain.HostingSourceCredentialRequest{Authority: a, DeliveryID: id}
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		status, err := e.status(ctx, a, &s)
		if err != nil || requireLive(status) != nil || status.Build.State != "sourcing" {
			return zero, errors.New("private credential authority lost")
		}
		call, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, e.config.RequestTimeout)
		material, err := client.BuildSourceCredential(call, e.config.Target.RunnerID, request, runnerclient.SourceCredentialTransport{TrustedLoopbackHTTP: e.config.PrivateGit.TrustedLoopbackHTTP})
		cancel()
		if err == nil {
			if ctx.Err() != nil || material.Authority != a || material.DeliveryID != id || material.RequestHash != hostingbuildprotocol.SourceCredentialRequestHash(e.config.Target.RunnerID, request) || material.Kind != "https_basic" || !hostingbuildprotocol.ValidBasicCredential(material.Username, material.Bytes) || !time.Now().Before(material.UseUntil) || material.UseUntil.After(time.Now().Add(time.Minute)) {

		material.Close()

			return zero, ctx.Err()
		}

			timer := time.NewTimer(100 * time.Millisecond)
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				timer.Stop()
				return zero, ctx.Err()
			case <-timer.C:
			}
		}
	}
	return zero, errors.New("private credential unavailable; intent retained")
}

// buildFrozenCommit keeps trigger intent authoritative across first checkout and replay.
func buildFrozenCommit(snapshot domain.HostingBuildSnapshot, frozen string) (string, error) {
	if err := domain.ValidateHostingBuildTriggerRevision(snapshot); err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("invalid build trigger revision")
	}
	if snapshot.TriggerRevision == nil {
		return frozen, nil
	}
	expected := snapshot.TriggerRevision.ExpectedCommit
	if frozen != "" && frozen != expected {
		return "", errors.New("build trigger revision mismatch")
	}
	return expected, nil
}
