```text
// Config supplies the narrow command-owned settings needed by the runner runtime.
type Config struct {
	StorageArchive         *StorageArchiveExecutionConfig
	Database               *DatabaseExecutionConfig
	DatabaseNetworkCapture *DatabaseNetworkCaptureExecutionConfig
	HostingReadiness       *HostingReadinessConfig
	HostingObservation     *HostingObservationConfig
	HostingRuntimeLogs     *HostingRuntimeLogsConfig
	RuntimeEnvironment     *RuntimeEnvironmentConfig
	LocalBuildDeploy       bool
	Build                  *BuildConfig
	Proxy                  ProxyConfig
	ImageDockerEndpoint    string
	Server                 string
	Token                  string
	RunnerID               string
	WorkDir                string
	JournalDir             string
	SecretRoot             string
	ImagePolicy            string
	Execute                bool
	Once                   bool
	PollInterval           time.Duration
	CancelPollInterval     time.Duration
	CompleteStatus         string
}

// Run owns the runner loop, durable replay, lease lifecycle, and execution.
func Run(config Config) error { return RunContext(context.Background(), config) }

// RunContext joins attempt cleanup before returning after parent cancellation.
// It retains unresolved journal evidence and never treats cancellation as success.
func RunContext(ctx context.Context, config Config) error {
	if config.DatabaseNetworkCapture != nil {
		return runDatabaseNetworkCaptureRuntime(ctx, config)
	}
	if config.StorageArchive != nil {
		ctx = runnerclient.WithStorageArchiveTransport(ctx, runnerclient.StorageArchiveTransport{TrustedLoopbackHTTP: config.StorageArchive.TrustedLoopbackHTTP})
	}
	if config.Database != nil {
		ctx = runnerclient.WithDatabaseTransport(ctx, runnerclient.DatabaseTransport{TrustedLoopbackHTTP: config.Database.TrustedLoopbackHTTP})
	}
	if ctx.Err() != nil {
		return ctx.Err()
	}
	if err := validateDatabaseExecutionConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateStorageArchiveExecutionConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateHostingReadinessConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateHostingRuntimeLogsConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateHostingObservationConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateRuntimeEnvironmentConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if config.LocalBuildDeploy && (!config.Execute || config.CompleteStatus != "") {
		return errors.New("local build deployment requires execution and forbids generic completion")
	}
	if err := config.Proxy.Validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBuildRuntimeConfig(config); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if config.Proxy.Enabled() && !config.Execute {
		return errors.New("configured managed proxy requires execution")
	}
	if config.Database != nil {
		if err := ValidateDatabaseExecution(ctx, *config.Database, config.ImageDockerEndpoint); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if config.StorageArchive != nil {
		if err := ValidateStorageArchiveExecution(ctx, *config.StorageArchive, config.ImageDockerEndpoint); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if config.StorageArchive != nil || config.Database != nil || config.Proxy.Enabled() || config.Build != nil || config.LocalBuildDeploy || config.RuntimeEnvironment != nil || config.HostingObservation != nil || config.HostingRuntimeLogs != nil || config.HostingReadiness != nil {
		if err := validateLocalBuildRuntimeIdentity(ctx, config); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	imagePolicy, err := parseComposeImagePolicy(config.ImagePolicy)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	resolvedJournalDir := strings.TrimSpace(config.JournalDir)
	if resolvedJournalDir == "" {
		resolvedJournalDir = filepath.Join(config.WorkDir, ".nerocd-journal-"+attemptMutationKey("runner", config.RunnerID, 1, "journal"))
	}
	journal, err := runner.OpenAttemptJournal(resolvedJournalDir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("open runner journal: %w", err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = journal.Close() }()
	if len(journal.Snapshot().DatabaseNetworkCapture) != 0 {
		return errors.New("retained database network capture requires explicit exact-ID capture mode")
	}
	if err := validateLocalBuildJournalConfiguration(journal, config.LocalBuildDeploy); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	buildReplayCtx, buildReplayCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
	buildExecutor, buildReplayErr := reconcileRuntimeBuilds(buildReplayCtx, config, journal)
	buildReplayCancel()
	if buildReplayErr != nil {
		return buildReplayErr
	}
	operational := &runnerOperationalCounters{}
	if err := reconcileProxyJournal(config.Server, config.Token, config.RunnerID, journal, config.Proxy, ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("reconcile proxy journal: %w", err)
	}
	if err := reconcileStorageArchiveJournal(ctx, config, journal); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := reconcileHostingDatabaseJournal(ctx, config, journal); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := reconcileHostingJournalWithLocalBuild(config.Server, config.Token, journal, config.ImageDockerEndpoint, config.LocalBuildDeploy, ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("reconcile hosting journal: %w", err)
	}
	if err := reconcileRunnerJournalWithCounters(config.Server, config.Token, journal, operational, ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("reconcile runner journal: %w", err)
	}
	// Preserve legacy uncertain-journal reconciliation before ordinary lifecycle
	// reads. Configured build/proxy runners authenticate before their replay.
	if config.StorageArchive == nil && config.Database == nil && !config.Proxy.Enabled() && config.Build == nil && !config.LocalBuildDeploy && config.RuntimeEnvironment == nil && config.HostingObservation == nil && config.HostingRuntimeLogs == nil && config.HostingReadiness == nil {
		if err := validateLocalBuildRuntimeIdentity(ctx, config); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if config.HostingReadiness != nil {
		stop, err := startHostingReadiness(ctx, config, resolvedJournalDir)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer stop()
	}
	if config.HostingObservation != nil {
		stop, err := startHostingObservation(ctx, config)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer stop()
	}
	if config.HostingRuntimeLogs != nil {
		stop, err := startHostingRuntimeLogs(ctx, config)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer stop()
	}
	for {
		if _, err := runnerclient.New(config.Server, config.Token).Heartbeat(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		retryCount, renewFailures := operational.Snapshot()
		if err := runnerclient.New(config.Server, config.Token).ReportTelemetry(ctx, runnerclient.OperationalTelemetry{JournalDepth: journal.Depth(), RetryCount: retryCount, RenewFailures: renewFailures}); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("report runner telemetry: %w", err)
		}
		claim, err := runnerclient.New(config.Server, config.Token).Claim(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			if runnerHTTPStatus(err, http.StatusNotFound) {
				if config.Once {
					fmt.Println("runner registered; no matching queued run")
					return nil
				}
				if !waitWorkerInterval(ctx, config.PollInterval) {
					return ctx.Err()
				}
				continue
			}
			return err
		}
		if isBuildClaim(claim) {
			if !config.Execute {
				return errors.New("hosting_build_v1 requires explicit execution; generic completion is forbidden")
			}
			if err := executeBuildClaim(ctx, config.Server, config.Token, claim, config.RunnerID, config.CancelPollInterval, buildExecutor, operational); err != nil && !settledBuildMayContinue(ctx, config.Once, err) {
				return err
			}
			if config.Once {
				return nil
			}
			continue
		}
		if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeDatabaseDeploy && (config.Database == nil || !config.Execute || config.CompleteStatus != "") {
			return errors.New("database_deploy requires configured execution; generic completion is forbidden")
		}
		if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeStorageArchive && (config.StorageArchive == nil || !config.Execute || config.CompleteStatus != "") {
			return errors.New("storage_archive requires configured execution; generic completion is forbidden")
		}
		if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeLocalBuildDeploy && (!config.LocalBuildDeploy || !config.Execute || config.CompleteStatus != "") {
			return errors.New("local build deployment requires explicit execution; generic completion is forbidden")
		}
		if err := printRunnerAuthorityEvent("claimed_run", claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if config.Execute {
			if err := executeClaimWithOptionsContext(ctx, config.Server, config.Token, claim, config.WorkDir, config.CancelPollInterval, journal, config.SecretRoot, imagePolicy, operational, claimExecutionOptions{storageArchive: config.StorageArchive, database: config.Database, imageEndpoint: config.ImageDockerEndpoint, proxy: config.Proxy, localBuild: config.LocalBuildDeploy, runtimeEnvironment: config.RuntimeEnvironment}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		} else if config.CompleteStatus != "" {
			if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeProxyApply {
				return errors.New("proxy_apply requires explicit managed proxy execution; generic completion is forbidden")
			}
			if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeImageDeploy {
				return errors.New("image_deploy requires --execute; generic completion is forbidden")
			}
			if strings.TrimSpace(claim.Lease.ID) == "" {
				return errors.New("claim response lease did not include id")
			}
			supervisor := newAttemptSupervisorFrom(ctx, claim.Lease)
			var completed domain.RunLease
			if err := journaledCompletion(supervisor, journal, config.Server, config.Token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, config.CompleteStatus, &completed); err != nil {
				supervisor.Close()
				return err
			}
			supervisor.Close()
			if err := printRunnerAuthorityEvent("completed_run", claim.Run.ID, completed); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if config.Once {
			return nil
		}
	}
}

func printRunnerAuthorityEvent(event, runID string, lease domain.RunLease) error {
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		Event   string `json:"event"`
		RunID   string `json:"run_id"`
		LeaseID string `json:"lease_id"`
		Attempt int    `json:"attempt"`
		Status  string `json:"status,omitempty"`
	}{Event: event, RunID: runID, LeaseID: lease.ID, Attempt: lease.Attempt, Status: lease.Status})
}

func executeClaim(server string, token string, claim domain.ClaimedRun, workDir string, cancelPollInterval time.Duration) error {
	journalDir := filepath.Join(workDir, ".nerocd-execute-journal-"+attemptMutationKey("lease", claim.Lease.ID, claim.Lease.Attempt, "journal"))
	journal, err := runner.OpenAttemptJournal(journalDir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = journal.Close() }()
	return executeClaimWithJournalAndSecretRoot(server, token, claim, workDir, cancelPollInterval, journal, os.Getenv("NEROCD_RUNNER_SECRET_ROOT"))
}

func executeClaimWithJournalAndSecretRoot(server string, token string, claim domain.ClaimedRun, workDir string, cancelPollInterval time.Duration, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, secretRoot string) error {
	return executeClaimWithJournalAndSecretRootAndCounters(server, token, claim, workDir, cancelPollInterval, journal, secretRoot, composeImagePolicyPreloaded, &runnerOperationalCounters{})
}

func executeClaimWithJournalAndSecretRootAndCounters(server string, token string, claim domain.ClaimedRun, workDir string, cancelPollInterval time.Duration, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, secretRoot string, imagePolicy composeImagePolicy, operational *runnerOperationalCounters, imageEndpoints ...string) error {
	options := claimExecutionOptions{}
	if len(imageEndpoints) > 0 {
		options.imageEndpoint = imageEndpoints[0]
	}
	return executeClaimWithOptions(server, token, claim, workDir, cancelPollInterval, journal, secretRoot, imagePolicy, operational, options)
}

type claimExecutionOptions struct {
	storageArchive     *StorageArchiveExecutionConfig
	database           *DatabaseExecutionConfig
	runtimeEnvironment *RuntimeEnvironmentConfig
	localBuild         bool
	imageEndpoint      string
	proxy              ProxyConfig
	build              *BuildExecutor
}

func executeClaimWithOptions(server string, token string, claim domain.ClaimedRun, workDir string, cancelPollInterval time.Duration, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, secretRoot string, imagePolicy composeImagePolicy, operational *runnerOperationalCounters, options claimExecutionOptions) error {
	return executeClaimWithOptionsContext(context.Background(), server, token, claim, workDir, cancelPollInterval, journal, secretRoot, imagePolicy, operational, options)
}
func executeClaimWithOptionsContext(parent context.Context, server string, token string, claim domain.ClaimedRun, workDir string, cancelPollInterval time.Duration, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, secretRoot string, imagePolicy composeImagePolicy, operational *runnerOperationalCounters, options claimExecutionOptions) error {
	if options.storageArchive != nil {
		parent = runnerclient.WithStorageArchiveTransport(parent, runnerclient.StorageArchiveTransport{TrustedLoopbackHTTP: options.storageArchive.TrustedLoopbackHTTP})
	}
	if options.database != nil {
		parent = runnerclient.WithDatabaseTransport(parent, runnerclient.DatabaseTransport{TrustedLoopbackHTTP: options.database.TrustedLoopbackHTTP})
	}
	if parent.Err() != nil {
		return parent.Err()
	}
	if isBuildClaim(claim) {
		return executeBuildClaim(parent, server, token, claim, claim.Lease.RunnerID, cancelPollInterval, options.build, operational)
	}
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeStorageArchive {
		if options.storageArchive == nil || domain.ValidateStorageArchiveTask(claim.Run) != nil {
			return errors.New("invalid or unconfigured storage archive task")
		}
	} else if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeDatabaseDeploy {
		if options.database == nil || domain.ValidateDatabaseDeploymentTask(claim.Run) != nil {
			return errors.New("invalid or unconfigured database task")
		}
	} else if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeLocalBuildDeploy {
		if !options.localBuild || validateLocalBuildClaim(claim) != nil {
			return errors.New("invalid or unconfigured local build deployment task")
		}
	} else if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeImageDeploy {
		if err := domain.ValidateImageDeploymentTask(claim.Run); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	} else if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeProxyApply {
		if err := domain.ValidateProxyApplyTask(claim.Run); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !options.proxy.Enabled() {
			return errors.New("managed proxy execution is not configured")
		}
	} else if domain.ContainsHostingExecution(claim.Run.RunSpec, claim.Run.Workflow) {
		return errors.New("hosting execution cannot enter the generic runtime")
	}
	sequence := 4
	var sequenceMu sync.Mutex
	var supervisor *attemptSupervisor
	var reporter *attemptReporter
	var redactor *runner.Redactor
	emitPersisted := func(stream string, message string) {
		if message == "" {
			return
		}
		sequenceMu.Lock()
		currentSequence := sequence
		sequence++
		sequenceMu.Unlock()
		if supervisor == nil || reporter == nil {
			return
		}
		if err := reporter.Emit(stream, message, currentSequence); err != nil {
			supervisor.cancel()
		}
	}
	emit := func(stream string, message string) {
		if redactor != nil {
			message = redactor.RedactChunk(stream, message)
		}
		emitPersisted(stream, message)
	}
	flushRedactor := func() {
		if redactor == nil {
			return
		}
		for _, event := range redactor.Flush() {
			emitPersisted(event.Stream, event.Message)
		}
	}
	// One attempt-scoped context also governs preparation and checkout.
	supervisor = newAttemptSupervisorFrom(parent, claim.Lease, operational)
	defer supervisor.Close()
	processCtx, stopProcessPolling := context.WithCancel(supervisor.Context())
	defer stopProcessPolling()
	// Confirm authority before any secret resolution or checkout side effect.
	preflightCtx, preflightCancel, err := supervisor.RequestContext()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer preflightCancel()
	initialRenew, err := runnerclient.New(server, token).Renew(preflightCtx, runnerclient.Authority{LeaseID: claim.Lease.ID, Attempt: claim.Lease.Attempt, Fence: claim.Lease.Fence})
	if err != nil {
		supervisor.metrics.RenewFailure()
		return fmt.Errorf("confirm lease authority: %w", err)
	}
	var validators []func(domain.RunLease) error
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeStorageArchive || claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeDatabaseDeploy || claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeLocalBuildDeploy {
		validate := exactBuildLease(claim.Lease)
		if err := validate(initialRenew); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		validators = append(validators, validate)
	}
	claim.Lease.ExpiresAt = initialRenew.ExpiresAt
	supervisor.Update(initialRenew)
	renewEvery := time.Until(claim.Lease.ExpiresAt) / 3
	if renewEvery <= 0 || renewEvery > 30*time.Second {
		renewEvery = 5 * time.Second
	}
	renewer := startLeaseRenewer(supervisor.Context(), supervisor, server, token, claim.Lease, renewEvery, validators...)
	defer renewer.Stop()
	watcher := startLeaseWatcher(supervisor.Context(), server, token, claim.Lease, cancelPollInterval, supervisor.cancel, validators...)
	defer watcher.Stop()
	reporter = startAttemptReporter(supervisor.Context(), supervisor, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease)
	defer reporter.Stop()
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeStorageArchive {
		return executeStorageArchiveClaim(supervisor, journal, reporter, server, token, claim, options.imageEndpoint, options.storageArchive)
	}
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeDatabaseDeploy {
		return executeDatabaseClaim(supervisor, journal, databaseCompletionDrain(supervisor, reporter, watcher, renewer), server, token, claim, options.imageEndpoint, options.database)
	}
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeProxyApply {
		return executeProxyClaim(supervisor, journal, reporter, server, token, claim, options.proxy)
	}
	if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeImageDeploy || claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeLocalBuildDeploy {
		return executeImageClaim(supervisor, journal, reporter, server, token, claim, options.imageEndpoint, options.localBuild, options.runtimeEnvironment)
	}
	if claim.PrimitivePlan.Process == nil {
		if claim.Run.RunSpec.Type == domain.RunTypeComposeDeploy {
			// Resolution is read-only: it cannot start containers or settle the
			// deployment successfully. A later fenced adapter owns application.
			return resolveComposeClaim(supervisor, journal, reporter, server, token, workDir, secretRoot, imagePolicy, claim)
		}
		if err := completeReportedAttempt(supervisor, watcher, renewer, reporter, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, "failed", nil); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return errors.New("claimed run did not include a process plan")
	}
	preparedSecrets, err := runner.PrepareSecrets(supervisor.Context(), claim.PrimitivePlan.Secrets, secretRoot, func(_ context.Context, binding domain.SecretBinding) error {
		accessID := attemptMutationKey("secret_access", claim.Lease.ID, claim.Lease.Attempt, strings.TrimSpace(binding.Name))
		var grant domain.SecretAccessGrant
		authorizeErr := retryAttemptRequest(supervisor, func(requestCtx context.Context) error {
			var accessErr error
			grant, accessErr = runnerclient.New(server, token).AuthorizeSecret(requestCtx, runnerclient.SecretAccessRequest{
				AccessID: accessID, RunID: claim.Run.ID, LeaseID: claim.Lease.ID, Attempt: claim.Lease.Attempt,
				Fence: claim.Lease.Fence, Binding: strings.TrimSpace(binding.Name), Provider: strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(binding.Provider)),
				Version: strings.TrimSpace(binding.Version),
			})
			return accessErr
		})
		if authorizeErr != nil {
			supervisor.cancel()
			return authorizeErr
		}
		if grant.AccessID != accessID || grant.RunID != claim.Run.ID || grant.LeaseID != claim.Lease.ID || grant.Attempt != claim.Lease.Attempt || grant.Binding != strings.TrimSpace(binding.Name) || grant.Provider != strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(binding.Provider)) || grant.Version != strings.TrimSpace(binding.Version) {
			supervisor.cancel()
			return errors.New("secret access acknowledgement did not match request")
		}
		return nil
	})
	if reporterErr := reporter.Err(); reporterErr != nil {
		return reporterErr
	}
	if err != nil {
		if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: secret authorization: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
		}
		emit("system", "Secret preparation failed: "+err.Error())
		completeErr := completeReportedAttempt(supervisor, watcher, renewer, reporter, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, "failed", nil)
		if completeErr != nil {
			return completeErr
		}
		return err
	}
	redactor = preparedSecrets.Redactor
	if preparedSecrets.Count > 0 {
		emit("system", fmt.Sprintf("Prepared %d runner secret binding(s)", preparedSecrets.Count))
	}
	if len(preparedSecrets.Environment) > 0 {
		if claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.Environment == nil {
			claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.Environment = map[string]string{}
		}
		for key, value := range preparedSecrets.Environment {
			claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.Environment[key] = value
		}
	}
	artifactRoot := strings.TrimSpace(claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.WorkingDir)
	if artifactRoot == "" {
		artifactRoot = workDir
	}
	if claim.PrimitivePlan.Checkout != nil {
		if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: before checkout", errLeaseAuthorityLost)
		}
		checkoutPath, err := runner.ExecuteCheckout(processCtx, *claim.PrimitivePlan.Checkout, workDir, func(event runner.ProcessEvent) {
			emit(event.Stream, event.Message)
		})
		if err != nil {
			flushRedactor()
			emit("system", "Checkout failed: "+err.Error())
			completeErr := completeReportedAttempt(supervisor, watcher, renewer, reporter, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, "failed", nil)
			if completeErr != nil {
				return completeErr
			}
			return err
		}
		if claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.WorkingDir == "" {
			claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.WorkingDir = checkoutPath
		}
		artifactRoot = claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.WorkingDir
	}
	if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: before process spawn", errLeaseAuthorityLost)
	}
	emit("system", "Runner starting process: "+strings.Join(claim.PrimitivePlan.Process.Command, " "))
	result, err := runner.ExecuteProcess(processCtx, *claim.PrimitivePlan.Process, func(event runner.ProcessEvent) {
		emit(event.Stream, event.Message)
	})
	flushRedactor()
	stopProcessPolling()
	if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, supervisor.Context().Err())
	}
	if err != nil {
		emit("system", "Process execution failed: "+err.Error())
		completeErr := completeReportedAttempt(supervisor, watcher, renewer, reporter, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, "failed", nil)
		if completeErr != nil {
			return completeErr
		}
		return err
	}

	status := "succeeded"
	switch {
	case result.Canceled:
		status = "canceled"
	case result.TimedOut || result.ExitCode != 0:
		status = "failed"
	}
	emit("system", fmt.Sprintf("Process exited with code %d", result.ExitCode))
	artifactResults, err := runner.CaptureArtifacts(artifactRoot, claim.PrimitivePlan.Artifacts, func(event runner.ProcessEvent) {
		emit(event.Stream, event.Message)
	})
	flushRedactor()
	for _, artifact := range artifactResults {
		if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil || reporter.Err() != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: before artifact reporting", errLeaseAuthorityLost)
		}
		kind := "file"
		if artifact.IsDir {
			kind = "directory"
		}
		reqCtx, cancel, requestErr := supervisor.RequestContext()
		if requestErr != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: before artifact reporting: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, requestErr)
		}
		err := appendArtifactAPIContext(reqCtx, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease.ID, claim.Lease.Attempt, claim.Lease.Fence, artifact.Name, artifact.Path, artifact.Found, artifact.Required, artifact.Size, kind)
		cancel()
		if err != nil {
			supervisor.cancel()
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: append artifact: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		status = "failed"
		emit("system", "Artifact capture failed: "+err.Error())
	}
	var completed domain.RunLease
	if err := completeReportedAttempt(supervisor, watcher, renewer, reporter, journal, server, token, claim.Run.ID, claim.Lease, status, &completed); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return printRunnerAuthorityEvent("completed_run", claim.Run.ID, completed)
}

func completeRunnerLeaseAPIContext(ctx context.Context, server string, token string, lease domain.RunLease, status string, completed *domain.RunLease) error {
	result, err := runnerclient.New(server, token).Complete(ctx, runnerclient.CompleteRequest{LeaseID: lease.ID, Attempt: lease.Attempt, Fence: lease.Fence, Status: status, CompletionKey: attemptMutationKey("complete", lease.ID, lease.Attempt, status)})
	if completed != nil {
		*completed = result
	}
	return err
}
func supervisedComplete(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, server, token string, lease domain.RunLease, status string, completed *domain.RunLease) error {
	ctx, cancel, err := supervisor.RequestContext()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer cancel()
	return completeRunnerLeaseAPIContext(ctx, server, token, lease, status, completed)
}

// databaseCompletionDrain is called only after the engine has returned and the
// exact result is durable. Keep authority workers alive through mutation and
// event drain, then join them before our own completion makes the lease terminal.
// The supervisor's original deadline and every server-side fence remain active.
func databaseCompletionDrain(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, reporter *attemptReporter, watcher *leaseWatcher, renewer *leaseRenewer) func(context.Context) error {
	return func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if err := reporter.WaitEmpty(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		reporter.Stop()
		watcher.Stop()
		renewer.Stop()
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return supervisor.Context().Err()
	}
}

func completeAttempt(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, watcher *leaseWatcher, renewer *leaseRenewer, server, token string, lease domain.RunLease, status string, completed *domain.RunLease) error {
	watcher.Stop()
	renewer.Stop()
	err := supervisedComplete(supervisor, server, token, lease, status, completed)
	if err != nil {
		supervisor.cancel()
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: completion: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func completeReportedAttempt(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, watcher *leaseWatcher, renewer *leaseRenewer, reporter *attemptReporter, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, server, token, runID string, lease domain.RunLease, status string, completed *domain.RunLease) error {
	// Persist terminal intent before waiting for earlier events to drain. A crash
	// during an outage can then replay events first and this exact completion,
	// without ever inventing a second terminal mutation.
	if _, err := ensureJournaledCompletion(supervisor, journal, runID, lease, status); err != nil {
		supervisor.cancel()
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: journal completion: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
	}
	if err := reporter.WaitEmpty(supervisor.Context()); err != nil {
		supervisor.cancel()
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: flush before completion: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
	}
	reporter.Stop()
	watcher.Stop()
	renewer.Stop()
	if supervisor.Context().Err() != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, supervisor.Context().Err())
	}
	if err := journaledCompletion(supervisor, journal, server, token, runID, lease, status, completed); err != nil {
		supervisor.cancel()
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: completion replay: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func journaledCompletion(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, server, token, runID string, lease domain.RunLease, status string, completed *domain.RunLease) error {
	completion, err := ensureJournaledCompletion(supervisor, journal, runID, lease, status)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var discard domain.RunLease
	if completed == nil {
		completed = &discard
	}
	err = retryAttemptRequest(supervisor, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		result, requestErr := runnerclient.New(server, token).Complete(ctx, runnerclient.CompleteRequest{
			LeaseID: lease.ID, Attempt: lease.Attempt, Fence: lease.Fence, CompletionKey: completion.ID, Status: status,
		})
		*completed = result
		return requestErr
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return journal.AckCompletion(completion.ID)
}

func ensureJournaledCompletion(supervisor *attemptSupervisor, journal *runner.AttemptJournal, runID string, lease domain.RunLease, status string) (runner.JournalCompletion, error) {
	var completion runner.JournalCompletion
	for _, pending := range journal.Snapshot().Completions {
		if pending.Attempt.RunID == runID && pending.Attempt.LeaseID == lease.ID && pending.Attempt.Attempt == lease.Attempt && pending.Attempt.Fence == lease.Fence {
			if pending.Status != status {
				return runner.JournalCompletion{}, runner.ErrJournalConflict
			}
			completion = pending
			break
		}
	}
	if completion.ID == "" {
		id, err := runner.NewJournalID("completion")
		if err != nil {
			return runner.JournalCompletion{}, err
		}
		completion = runner.JournalCompletion{ID: id, Attempt: journalAttemptIdentity(runID, lease, supervisor), Status: status, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
		if _, err := journal.AppendCompletion(completion); err != nil {
			return runner.JournalCompletion{}, err
		}
	}
	return completion, nil
}

func renewLeaseWhileRunning(worker context.Context, supervisor *attemptSupervisor, server, token string, lease domain.RunLease, interval time.Duration, failClosed func(), validators ...func(domain.RunLease) error) <-chan struct{} {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		var workers sync.WaitGroup
		workers.Add(2)
		go func() {
			defer workers.Done()
			renewalDelay := boundedRenewalDelay(interval)
			for waitWorkerInterval(worker, renewalDelay) {
				var renewed domain.RunLease
				err := retryWorkerRequest(worker, supervisor, func(ctx context.Context) error {
					var renewErr error
					renewed, renewErr = runnerclient.New(server, token).Renew(ctx, runnerclient.Authority{LeaseID: lease.ID, Attempt: lease.Attempt, Fence: lease.Fence})
					if renewErr != nil && worker.Err() == nil {
						supervisor.metrics.RenewFailure()
					}
					return renewErr
				})
				if err != nil {
					if worker.Err() == nil {
						failClosed()
					}
					return
				}
				for _, validate := range validators {
					if validate(renewed) != nil {
						failClosed()
						return
					}
				}
				supervisor.Update(renewed)
				renewalDelay = boundedRenewalDelay(time.Until(renewed.ExpiresAt) / 3)
			}
		}()
		go func() {
			defer workers.Done()
			heartbeatDelay := boundedHeartbeatDelay(interval)
			for waitWorkerInterval(worker, heartbeatDelay) {
				err := retryWorkerRequest(worker, supervisor, func(ctx context.Context) error {
					_, heartbeatErr := runnerclient.New(server, token).Heartbeat(ctx)
					return heartbeatErr
				})
				if err != nil {
					if worker.Err() == nil {
						failClosed()
					}
					return
				}
			}
		}()
		workers.Wait()
	}()
	return done
}

func boundedRenewalDelay(interval time.Duration) time.Duration {
	if interval <= 0 {
		return time.Second
	}
	if interval > 30*time.Second {
		return 30 * time.Second
	}
	return interval
}

func boundedHeartbeatDelay(interval time.Duration) time.Duration {
	interval = boundedRenewalDelay(interval)
	if interval > 10*time.Second {
		return 10 * time.Second
	}
	return interval
}

func waitWorkerInterval(ctx context.Context, delay time.Duration) bool {
	timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return false
	case <-timer.C:
		return true
	}
}

func retryWorkerRequest(worker context.Context, supervisor *attemptSupervisor, request func(context.Context) error) error {
	backoff := 100 * time.Millisecond
	for {
		requestCtx, cancel, err := supervisor.RequestContextFrom(worker)
		if err != nil {
			if worker.Err() != nil {
				return worker.Err()
			}
			return err
		}
		err = request(requestCtx)
		cancel()
		if err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if worker.Err() != nil {
			return worker.Err()
		}
		if classifyRunnerFailure(err) != runnerFailureTransient {
			return err
		}
		if !waitRunnerRetry(worker, supervisor, backoff) {
			if worker.Err() != nil {
				return worker.Err()
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: retry deadline: %v", errLeaseAuthorityLost, err)
		}
		supervisor.metrics.Retry()
		if backoff < time.Second {
			backoff *= 2
		}
	}
}

func startLeaseRenewer(parent context.Context, supervisor *attemptSupervisor, server, token string, lease domain.RunLease, interval time.Duration, validators ...func(domain.RunLease) error) *leaseRenewer {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	return &leaseRenewer{cancel: cancel, done: renewLeaseWhileRunning(ctx, supervisor, server, token, lease, interval, supervisor.cancel, validators...)}
}

func appendArtifactAPIContext(ctx context.Context, server string, token string, runID string, leaseID string, attempt int, fence string, name string, path string, found bool, required bool, size int64, kind string) error {
	_, err := runnerclient.New(server, token).AppendArtifact(ctx, runnerclient.ArtifactRequest{RunID: runID, LeaseID: leaseID, Attempt: attempt, Fence: fence, Name: name, Path: path, Found: found, Required: required, Size: size, Kind: kind})
	return err
}

func watchLeaseCancellation(ctx context.Context, server string, token string, lease domain.RunLease, interval time.Duration, emit func(string), cancel func(), validators ...func(domain.RunLease) error) <-chan struct{} {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = time.Second
	}
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
				observed, err := runnerclient.New(server, token).Lease(ctx, runnerclient.Authority{LeaseID: lease.ID, Attempt: lease.Attempt, Fence: lease.Fence})
				if err != nil {
					if ctx.Err() != nil {
						return
					}
					if classifyRunnerFailure(err) == runnerFailureTransient {
						continue
					}
					cancel()
					return
				}
				for _, validate := range validators {
					if validate(observed) != nil {
						cancel()
						return
					}
				}
				if observed.Status != "active" {
					cancel()
					return
				}
			}
		}
	}()
	return done
}

func startLeaseWatcher(parent context.Context, server, token string, lease domain.RunLease, interval time.Duration, authorityCancel func(), validators ...func(domain.RunLease) error) *leaseWatcher {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
	return &leaseWatcher{cancel: cancel, done: watchLeaseCancellation(ctx, server, token, lease, interval, func(string) {}, authorityCancel, validators...)}
}

func attemptMutationKey(kind, leaseID string, attempt int, discriminator string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(kind + "\x00" + leaseID + "\x00" + strconv.Itoa(attempt) + "\x00" + discriminator))
	return kind + "_" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum[:16])
}

// A normal failed build is settled work, while every uncertain result remains
// fatal. Once mode keeps its command failure and cancellation always stops.
func settledBuildMayContinue(ctx context.Context, once bool, err error) bool {
	return !once && ctx.Err() == nil && errors.Is(err, errSettledBuildFailure)
}
```

```text
// Package secretcrypto provides bounded, versioned authenticated encryption
// for project-managed secret values. It performs no I/O, configuration loading,
// authorization, or key generation.
//
// Operators must supply cryptographically random 32-byte AES keys and rotate a
// key before it is used for 2^32 total encryptions across all processes. Go does
// not provide reliable cryptographic memory erasure, and Keyring makes no such
// claim.
package secretcrypto

import (
	"crypto/aes"
	"crypto/cipher"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
)

const (
	associatedDataDomain = "nerocd/secretcrypto/aes-256-gcm"
	envelopeVersion      = 1
	maxKeyCount          = 32
	maxKeyIDBytes        = 128
	maxBindingIDBytes    = 256
	maxPlaintextBytes    = 65_536
	randomNonceOverhead  = 12 + 16
)

var (
	// ErrInvalidInput reports malformed configuration, binding, plaintext, or
	// envelope structure without including caller-controlled values.
	ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("secretcrypto: invalid input")
	// ErrDecrypt reports an unknown key or failed authenticated decryption
	// without distinguishing the cause.
	ErrDecrypt = errors.New("secretcrypto: decryption failed")
)

// Binding identifies the immutable domain to which ciphertext is bound.
type Binding struct {
	ProjectID string
	SecretID  string
	Version   int64
}

// Envelope is the durable encrypted representation. Data contains the random
// nonce prefix and authenticated ciphertext produced by Go's AES-GCM helper.
type Envelope struct {
	Version int
	KeyID   string
	Data    []byte
}

// Keyring is an immutable, concurrency-safe collection of AES-256-GCM keys.
// Construct a new ring to change the active key or remove historical keys.
type Keyring struct {
	activeKeyID string
	keys        map[string]cipher.AEAD
}

// New validates and copies the caller's key configuration into an immutable
// keyring. It does not generate keys or assess their entropy.
func New(activeKeyID string, keys map[string][]byte) (*Keyring, error) {
	if !validKeyID(activeKeyID) || len(keys) == 0 || len(keys) > maxKeyCount {
		return nil, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	ring := &Keyring{activeKeyID: activeKeyID, keys: make(map[string]cipher.AEAD, len(keys))}
	for keyID, callerKey := range keys {
		if !validKeyID(keyID) || len(callerKey) != 32 {
			return nil, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		keyCopy := append([]byte(nil), callerKey...)
		block, err := aes.NewCipher(keyCopy)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		aead, err := cipher.NewGCMWithRandomNonce(block)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		if aead.NonceSize() != 0 || aead.Overhead() != randomNonceOverhead {
			return nil, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		ring.keys[keyID] = aead
	}
	if _, ok := ring.keys[activeKeyID]; !ok {
		return nil, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	return ring, nil
}

// Seal encrypts a bounded nonempty plaintext using the active key and binds it
// to the envelope format, key identity, project, stable secret ID, and positive
// secret version. The returned Data never aliases plaintext.
func (k *Keyring) Seal(binding Binding, plaintext []byte) (Envelope, error) {
	if k == nil || !validBinding(binding) || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPlaintextBytes {
		return Envelope{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aead, ok := k.keys[k.activeKeyID]
	if !ok {
		return Envelope{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aad := associatedData(envelopeVersion, k.activeKeyID, binding)
	data := aead.Seal(nil, nil, plaintext, aad)
	return Envelope{Version: envelopeVersion, KeyID: k.activeKeyID, Data: data}, nil
}

// Open validates all bounded structure before decrypting. Unknown keys,
// authentication failures, and key aliases fail with ErrDecrypt. It returns no
// partial plaintext, and successful output never aliases Envelope.Data.
func (k *Keyring) Open(binding Binding, envelope Envelope) ([]byte, error) {
	if k == nil || !validBinding(binding) || envelope.Version != envelopeVersion || !validKeyID(envelope.KeyID) || len(envelope.Data) < randomNonceOverhead+1 || len(envelope.Data) > maxPlaintextBytes+randomNonceOverhead {
		return nil, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aead, ok := k.keys[envelope.KeyID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, ErrDecrypt
	}
	aad := associatedData(envelope.Version, envelope.KeyID, binding)
	plaintext, err := aead.Open(nil, nil, envelope.Data, aad)
	if err != nil || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPlaintextBytes {
		return nil, ErrDecrypt
	}
	return plaintext, nil
}

func validBinding(binding Binding) bool {
	return validBindingID(binding.ProjectID) && validBindingID(binding.SecretID) && binding.Version > 0
}

func validBindingID(value string) bool {
	return len(value) > 0 && len(value) <= maxBindingIDBytes
}

func validKeyID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > maxKeyIDBytes {
		return false
	}
	for index := range len(value) {
		character := value[index]
		if (character >= 'a' && character <= 'z') || (character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z') || (character >= '0' && character <= '9') || character == '.' || character == '_' || character == '-' {
			continue
		}
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func associatedData(version int, keyID string, binding Binding) []byte {
	capacity := len(associatedDataDomain) + 1 + 4 + 4 + len(keyID) + 4 + len(binding.ProjectID) + 4 + len(binding.SecretID) + 8
	aad := make([]byte, 0, capacity)
	aad = append(aad, associatedDataDomain...)
	aad = append(aad, 0)
	aad = binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(aad, uint32(version))
	aad = appendLengthPrefixed(aad, keyID)
	aad = appendLengthPrefixed(aad, binding.ProjectID)
	aad = appendLengthPrefixed(aad, binding.SecretID)
	aad = binary.BigEndian.AppendUint64(aad, uint64(binding.Version))
	return aad
}

func appendLengthPrefixed(destination []byte, value string) []byte {
	destination = binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(destination, uint32(len(value)))
	return append(destination, value...)
}
```

```text
			return nil, ErrInvalidInput
		}
		ring.keys[keyID] = aead

// Seal encrypts a bounded nonempty plaintext using the active key and binds it
// to the envelope format, key identity, project, stable secret ID, and positive
// secret version. The returned Data never aliases plaintext.
func (k *Keyring) Seal(binding Binding, plaintext []byte) (Envelope, error) {
	if k == nil || !validBinding(binding) || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPlaintextBytes {
		return Envelope{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aead, ok := k.keys[k.activeKeyID]
	if !ok {
		return Envelope{}, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aad := associatedData(envelopeVersion, k.activeKeyID, binding)
	data := aead.Seal(nil, nil, plaintext, aad)
	return Envelope{Version: envelopeVersion, KeyID: k.activeKeyID, Data: data}, nil
}

// Open validates all bounded structure before decrypting. Unknown keys,
// authentication failures, and key aliases fail with ErrDecrypt. It returns no
// partial plaintext, and successful output never aliases Envelope.Data.
func (k *Keyring) Open(binding Binding, envelope Envelope) ([]byte, error) {
	if k == nil || !validBinding(binding) || envelope.Version != envelopeVersion || !validKeyID(envelope.KeyID) || len(envelope.Data) < randomNonceOverhead+1 || len(envelope.Data) > maxPlaintextBytes+randomNonceOverhead {
		return nil, ErrInvalidInput
	}
	aead, ok := k.keys[envelope.KeyID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, ErrDecrypt
	}
	aad := associatedData(envelope.Version, envelope.KeyID, binding)
	plaintext, err := aead.Open(nil, nil, envelope.Data, aad)
	if err != nil || len(plaintext) == 0 || len(plaintext) > maxPlaintextBytes {
		return nil, ErrDecrypt
	}
	return plaintext, nil
}
```

```text
func TestHistoricalKeyRotation(t *testing.T) {
	oldKey := testKey(10)
	newKey := testKey(11)
	binding := Binding{ProjectID: "project", SecretID: "secret", Version: 1}
	oldRing := mustRing(t, "old", map[string][]byte{"old": oldKey, "new": newKey})
	oldEnvelope, err := oldRing.Seal(binding, []byte("old value"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("old Seal: %v", err)
	}

	rotatedRing := mustRing(t, "new", map[string][]byte{"old": oldKey, "new": newKey})
	if opened, err := rotatedRing.Open(binding, oldEnvelope); err != nil || string(opened) != "old value" {
		t.Fatalf("rotated ring Open old envelope = (%q, %v)", opened, err)
	}
	newEnvelope, err := rotatedRing.Seal(binding, []byte("new value"))
	if err != nil || newEnvelope.KeyID != "new" {
		t.Fatalf("rotated ring Seal = (%+v, %v)", newEnvelope, err)
	}

	removedRing := mustRing(t, "new", map[string][]byte{"new": newKey})
	if plaintext, err := removedRing.Open(binding, oldEnvelope); plaintext != nil || !errors.Is(err, ErrDecrypt) {
		t.Fatalf("removed-key Open = (%x, %v), want (nil, ErrDecrypt)", plaintext, err)
	}
}
```

```text
package store

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/distribution/reference"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"nerocd/internal/domain"
	"nerocd/internal/hostingjobs"
	"nerocd/internal/store/sqlcgen"
)

// StartHostingExecution installs and starts the real River consumer. The server
// must call its stop function before closing the store pool.
func (s *PostgresStore) StartHostingExecution(ctx context.Context) (func(context.Context) error, error) {
	if err := s.configureHostingPorts(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var handler hostingjobs.Handler = deploymentOnlyHandler{s}
	if s.hostingBuildPolicy != nil {
		handler = s
	}
	client, err := hostingjobs.New(ctx, s.pool, handler, hostingjobs.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = client.Start(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s.hostingJobs = client
	recoveryCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			recoveryAttempt, stop := context.WithTimeout(recoveryCtx, 3*time.Second)
			_ = s.recoverHostingDispatch(recoveryAttempt)
			stop()
			// Runtime plaintext retention progresses independently of dispatch
			// recovery errors, transactions and their timeout budget.
			purgeAttempt, stopPurge := context.WithTimeout(recoveryCtx, 3*time.Second)
			_, _ = s.PurgeRuntimeLogs(purgeAttempt)
			stopPurge()
			pushAttempt, stopPush := context.WithTimeout(recoveryCtx, 3*time.Second)
			_ = s.recoverGitHubPushDispatch(pushAttempt)
			stopPush()
			autoAttempt, stopAuto := context.WithTimeout(recoveryCtx, 3*time.Second)
			_ = s.recoverAutoDeployDispatch(autoAttempt)
			stopAuto()
			bootstrapAttempt, stopBootstrap := context.WithTimeout(recoveryCtx, 3*time.Second)
			_ = s.recoverServerBootstrapDispatch(bootstrapAttempt)
			stopBootstrap()
			select {
			case <-recoveryCtx.Done():
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
			}
		}
	}()
	return func(stopCtx context.Context) error {
		cancel()
		select {
		case <-done:
		case <-stopCtx.Done():
			return stopCtx.Err()
		}
		return client.Stop(stopCtx)
	}, nil
}

// Recovery discovers accepted operations independently from River job retention
// or finite retry exhaustion. Each bounded pass rotates the selected prefix.
func (s *PostgresStore) recoverHostingDispatch(ctx context.Context) error {
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	ids, err := sqlcgen.New(tx).RecoverQueuedHostingOperations(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if _, archive, e := archiveOperation(ctx, tx, id); e != nil {
			return e
		} else if archive {
			continue
		}
		if _, err = s.hostingJobs.EnqueueTx(ctx, tx, hostingjobs.PrepareDeploymentArgs{OperationID: id}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).TouchHostingOperation(ctx, id); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err = s.recoverProxyDispatch(ctx, tx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = s.recoverBuildDispatch(ctx, tx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = s.recoverArchiveDispatch(ctx, tx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

// ErrHostingRestoreHold blocks restored targets until trusted local recovery proof exists.
var ErrHostingRestoreHold = fmt.Errorf("%w: restored hosting ownership requires trusted local journal and process recovery proof", ErrConflict)

func hostingOperation(ctx context.Context, q sqlcgen.DBTX, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	if op, found, err := archiveOperation(ctx, q, id); err != nil || found {
		return op, err
	}
	var op domain.HostingOperation
	var snapshot, release, plan, prepared, complete, result, cleanup []byte
	err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(q).GetHostingOperationSnapshot(ctx, id)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		op.ID = row.ID
		op.ProjectID = row.ProjectID
		op.ResourceID = row.ResourceID
		op.BindingID = row.BindingID
		op.RunID = row.RunID
		op.ReconciliationRunID = row.ReconciliationRunID
		op.State = row.State
		op.ReconcileRequested = row.ReconcileRequested
		op.CreatedBy = row.CreatedBy
		op.CreatedAt = row.CreatedAt
		op.UpdatedAt = row.UpdatedAt
		snapshot = row.Snapshot
		release = row.Release
		plan = row.Plan
		cleanup = row.CleanupPlan
		prepared = row.PreparedReceipt
		complete = row.CompleteReceipt
		result = row.Result
		op.MutationHold = row.MutationHold
		if row.RestoreOwnershipHeld == nil {
			return ErrConflict
		}
		op.RestoreOwnershipHeld = *row.RestoreOwnershipHeld
		return nil
	}()
	if err != nil {
		return op, hostingError(err)
	}
	for _, doc := range []struct {
		raw    []byte
		target any
	}{{snapshot, &op.Snapshot}, {release, &op.Release}, {plan, &op.Plan}, {prepared, &op.PreparedReceipt}, {complete, &op.CompleteReceipt}, {result, &op.Result}, {cleanup, &op.CleanupPlan}} {
		if len(doc.raw) > 0 {
			if err = json.Unmarshal(doc.raw, doc.target); err != nil {
				return domain.HostingOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("decode hosting evidence: %w", err)
			}
		}
	}
	if err = loadDatabaseUpgrade(ctx, q, &op); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return op, nil
}

// GetHostingOperation loads immutable evidence without exposing lease authority.
func (s *PostgresStore) GetHostingOperation(ctx context.Context, id string) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	return buildTransaction(ctx, s, func(tx pgx.Tx) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
		op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, id)
		if err != nil || op.DatabaseUpgrade == nil {
			return op, err
		}
		if err = databaseUpgradeHistoricalRead(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		return op, nil
	})
}

// RequestHostingDeployment captures desired state and inserts the River job in
// one transaction. Reusing a key with changed input is a conflict.
func (s *PostgresStore) RequestHostingDeployment(ctx context.Context, id, resourceID, actorID string, in domain.HostingDeploymentInput, audit domain.AuditEvent) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	if s.hostingJobs == nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingjobs.ErrUnavailable
	}
	if in.StorageRouteContinuity != nil {
		canonical, err := domain.CanonicalHostingStorageRouteContinuityInput(*in.StorageRouteContinuity)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		in.StorageRouteContinuity = &canonical
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateHostingDeployment(in); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	if in.StorageRouteContinuity != nil {
		if _, _, err = storageContinuityPrelock(ctx, tx, resourceID); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	if err = lockHostingResourceDestination(ctx, tx, resourceID); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	var snap domain.HostingSnapshot
	var projectID string
	var source []byte
	err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingResourceTarget(ctx, resourceID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		if row.Kind != "application" {
			return ErrConflict
		}
		projectID = row.ProjectID
		snap.ResourceGeneration = row.Generation
		source = row.Source
		snap.BindingID = row.BindingID
		snap.DestinationID = row.DestinationID
		snap.RuntimeNamespace = row.RuntimeNamespace
		snap.ServerID = row.ServerID
		snap.RunnerID = row.RunnerID
		return nil
	}()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingError(err)
	}
	if err = authorizeBuildActor(ctx, tx, actorID, projectID, "maintainer"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	var existingID, requestHash string
	err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingIdempotency(ctx, sqlcgen.GetHostingIdempotencyParams{ResourceID: resourceID, IdempotencyKey: in.IdempotencyKey})
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		existingID = row.ID
		requestHash = row.RequestHash
		return nil
	}()
	if err == nil {
		if requestHash != domain.HostingDocumentHash(in) {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		op, readErr := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, existingID)
		if readErr != nil {
			return op, readErr
		}
		if err = authorizeBuildActor(ctx, tx, actorID, projectID, "maintainer"); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		return op, tx.Commit(ctx)
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = databaseBindingPendingGate(ctx, tx, resourceID); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if snap.ResourceGeneration != in.ExpectedGeneration {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	var desired domain.ResourceSource
	if err = json.Unmarshal(source, &desired); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if desired.Kind != "image" {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if _, err = domain.NormalizeHostingImage(desired.Image.Reference); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	snap.ResourceID = resourceID
	snap.ImageReference = desired.Image.Reference
	snap.ContainerPort = in.ContainerPort
	snap.HostPort = in.HostPort
	snap.Readiness = in.Readiness
	snap.RuntimeConfiguration, err = lockHostingRuntimeConfiguration(ctx, tx, projectID, resourceID, in.ExpectedRuntimeConfigurationGeneration)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	snap.Storage, err = hostingStorageSnapshot(ctx, tx, projectID, resourceID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if snap.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) && snap.RuntimeConfiguration != (domain.HostingRuntimeConfigurationRef{}) {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	snap.PolicyVersion = domain.HostingPolicyVersion
	if snap.RuntimeConfiguration.Generation > 0 {
		snap.PolicyVersion = domain.HostingRuntimePolicyVersion
	}
	if snap.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) {
		snap.PolicyVersion = domain.HostingOwnedStoragePolicyVersion
	}
	if err = requireHostingStorageAgent(ctx, tx, snap); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = requireHostingRuntimeAgent(ctx, tx, snap); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = hostingTargetGate(ctx, tx, projectID, snap, true); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	continuity, err := prepareStorageContinuity(ctx, tx, id, projectID, &snap, in)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = s.resolveHostingReleasePort(ctx, tx, &snap, in.HostPort); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingPortReservation(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingPortReservationParams{BindingID: snap.BindingID, DestinationID: snap.DestinationID, HostPort: int32(snap.HostPort)})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingError(err)
	}
	var reserved int
	var admitted bool
	var hold *string
	if err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingPortReservation(ctx, snap.BindingID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		reserved = int(row.HostPort)
		admitted = row.RestoreAdmitted
		hold = row.HoldOperationID
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if reserved < 1024 || !admitted || hold != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	var busy bool
	if err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).HostingBindingBusy(ctx, snap.BindingID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		busy = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if busy {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingOperation(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingOperationParams{ID: id, ProjectID: projectID, ResourceID: resourceID, BindingID: snap.BindingID, IdempotencyKey: in.IdempotencyKey, RequestHash: domain.HostingDocumentHash(in), CreatedBy: actorID})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingError(err)
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingReleaseClaim(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingReleaseClaimParams{OperationID: id, DestinationID: snap.DestinationID, HostPort: int32(snap.HostPort), BindingID: snap.BindingID}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingError(err)
	}
	contents, err := json.Marshal(snap)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingSnapshot(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingSnapshotParams{OperationID: id, Body: contents, BodyHash: domain.HostingDocumentHash(snap)}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if continuity != nil {
		if err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateStorageRouteContinuity(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateStorageRouteContinuityParams{OperationID: id, ProxyID: continuity.ProxyID, Descriptor: buildJSON(continuity), DescriptorHash: snap.StorageRouteContinuity.Hash, AcceptedRequest: buildJSON(in)}); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, hostingError(err)
		}
	}
	audit.ActorID, audit.Action, audit.TargetID = actorID, "hosting.deployment_requested", id
	audit.Metadata = map[string]any{"project_id": projectID, "resource_id": resourceID, "binding_id": snap.BindingID}
	if err = createAuditWithQueries(ctx, s.queries.WithTx(tx), audit); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = s.hostingJobs.EnqueueTx(ctx, tx, hostingjobs.PrepareDeploymentArgs{OperationID: id}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	if err = authorizeBuildActor(ctx, tx, actorID, projectID, "maintainer"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = requireHostingRuntimeAgent(ctx, tx, snap); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return op, nil
}

// hostingTargetGate locks grant -> binding state -> runner, always after the
// task/lease locks on attempt paths. Revocation serializes with these locks.
func hostingTargetGate(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, projectID string, snap domain.HostingSnapshot, allowMissingState bool) error {
	return hostingTargetGateMode(ctx, tx, projectID, snap, allowMissingState, false)
}
func hostingTargetGateMode(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, projectID string, snap domain.HostingSnapshot, allowMissingState, observe bool) error {
	if err := requireHostingStorageAgent(ctx, tx, snap); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingExecutionDestination(ctx, snap.DestinationID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if snap.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingReleasePolicyVersion {
		if err := requireHostingReleaseAgent(ctx, tx, snap.RunnerID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	var revoked *time.Time
	if err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingProjectGrant(ctx, sqlcgen.LockHostingProjectGrantParams{DestinationID: snap.DestinationID, ProjectID: projectID})
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		revoked = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return hostingError(err)
	}
	if revoked != nil {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	var restored bool
	if err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).HostingBindingRestoreHeld(ctx, snap.BindingID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		restored = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if restored && !observe {
		return ErrHostingRestoreHold
	}
	var admitted bool
	err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingAdmissionState(ctx, snap.BindingID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		admitted = row.RestoreAdmitted
		return nil
	}()
	if err != nil && (!allowMissingState || !errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows)) {
		return hostingError(err)
	}
	if err == nil && !admitted && !observe {
		return ErrHostingRestoreHold
	}
	err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingExactRunner(ctx, sqlcgen.LockHostingExactRunnerParams{ID: snap.BindingID, ResourceID: snap.ResourceID, ID_2: snap.DestinationID, ID_3: snap.ServerID, ID_4: snap.RunnerID, ProjectID: projectID, Capability: hostingSnapshotTaskType(snap)})
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		_ = row
		return nil
	}()
	if err != nil {
		return hostingError(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// PrepareDeployment is the real River handler: one transaction dispatches one
// typed task and records its immutable exact runner target and dispatch receipt.
func (s *PostgresStore) PrepareDeployment(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if op.State != "queued" {
		return nil
	}
	if err = hostingFreshRuntimeGate(ctx, tx, op); err == nil {
		err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, false)
	}
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrHostingRestoreHold) {
			return nil
		}
		if errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) || errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			if _, updateErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).FailQueuedHostingOperation(ctx, id); updateErr != nil {
				return updateErr
			}
			if _, releaseErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).ReleaseHostingFailedClaim(ctx, id); releaseErr != nil {
				return releaseErr
			}
			if releaseErr := releaseUnmutatedStorageContinuity(ctx, tx, op); releaseErr != nil {
				return releaseErr
			}
			if auditErr := hostingPhaseAudit(ctx, tx, s.queries, op, op.CreatedBy, "preflight_failed"); auditErr != nil {
				return auditErr
			}
			return tx.Commit(ctx)
		}
		return err
	}
	var state string
	if err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingOperationState(ctx, id)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		state = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if state != "queued" {
		return nil
	}
	runID, mode := "run_"+id, "deploy"
	if op.CleanupPlan != nil {
		runID, mode = "cleanup_"+id, "cleanup"
	}
	spec := domain.RunSpec{Type: hostingSnapshotTaskType(op.Snapshot), Inputs: map[string]any{}, HostingOperationID: id, HostingMode: mode}
	body, err := json.Marshal(spec)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingTask(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingTaskParams{ID: runID, ProjectID: op.ProjectID, RunSpec: body, RequestedBy: op.CreatedBy})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if mode == "cleanup" {
		_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingCleanupTaskTarget(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingCleanupTaskTargetParams{RunID: runID, OperationID: id, BindingID: op.BindingID, RunnerID: op.Snapshot.RunnerID})
	} else {
		_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingDeploymentTarget(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingDeploymentTargetParams{RunID: runID, OperationID: id, BindingID: op.BindingID, RunnerID: op.Snapshot.RunnerID})
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingDispatchReceipt(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingDispatchReceiptParams{OperationID: id, RunID: runID}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).DispatchHostingOperation(ctx, sqlcgen.DispatchHostingOperationParams{ID: id, RunID: hostingStringPointer(runID)}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	audit := domain.AuditEvent{ID: "aud_dispatch_" + id, ActorID: op.CreatedBy, Action: "hosting.dispatched", TargetID: id, CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Metadata: map[string]any{"project_id": op.ProjectID, "resource_id": op.ResourceID, "binding_id": op.BindingID, "run_id": runID, "runner_id": op.Snapshot.RunnerID}}
	if err = createAuditWithQueries(ctx, s.queries.WithTx(tx), audit); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = localHostingOperationAuthority(ctx, tx, op, false); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = runtimeHostingActorAuthority(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if op.CleanupPlan == nil {
		if err = requireHostingRuntimeAgent(ctx, tx, op.Snapshot); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if op.DatabaseUpgrade != nil {
		if err = finalizeDatabaseUpgradeRequest(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func hostingAuthorityExists(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, runnerID string, a domain.HostingAuthority, live bool) error {
	// PostgreSQL stores attempts as int32. Reject values before narrowing so
	// another submitted integer cannot alias the persisted lease authority.
	if a.Attempt < 1 || a.Attempt > math.MaxInt32 {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	if _, err := sqlcgen.New(tx).LockHostingTaskForAuthority(ctx, a.RunID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).CheckHostingAuthority(ctx, sqlcgen.CheckHostingAuthorityParams{ID: a.LeaseID, RunID: a.RunID, RunnerID: runnerID, Attempt: int32(a.Attempt), Fence: a.Fence, OperationID: a.OperationID, Column7: live})
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		_ = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return hostingError(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// HostingRunnerPlan checks current exact-target lease authority before returning a plan.
func (s *PostgresStore) HostingRunnerPlan(ctx context.Context, runnerID string, a domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	if err = hostingAuthorityExists(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, true); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, a.OperationID)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	var mode string
	if err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingTaskMode(ctx, a.RunID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		mode = row
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op.TaskMode = mode
	if mode == "observe" {
		if !op.ReconcileRequested || op.ReconciliationRunID != a.RunID {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		if err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, true); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		var raw []byte
		if err = func() error {
			row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingHealthy(ctx, op.BindingID)
			if queryErr != nil {
				return queryErr
			}
			raw = row
			return nil
		}(); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		if len(raw) > 0 {
			if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &op.ReconciliationHealthy); err != nil {
				return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
			}
		}
		if op.ReconciliationHealthy != nil && domain.ValidateHostingHealthyStorage(*op.ReconciliationHealthy) != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		if err = finalLocalHostingAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op, true); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		if op.Snapshot.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) {
			if err = finalHostingStorageAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op); err != nil {
				return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
			}
		}
		return op, nil
	}
	if op.State != "dispatched" && op.State != "preparing" && op.State != "prepared" {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if err = hostingFreshRuntimeGate(ctx, tx, op); err == nil {
		err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, false)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.MutationHold {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).BeginHostingPreparation(ctx, op.ID); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if mode == "cleanup" {
		if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).FinishHostingPreparation(ctx, op.ID); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	op, err = hostingOperation(ctx, tx, op.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	op.TaskMode = mode
	if err = finalLocalHostingAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op, false); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = finalHostingRuntimeAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	return op, tx.Commit(ctx)
}

// replayHostingReceipt checks stable identity/body before live-lease admission.
func replayHostingReceipt(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, a domain.HostingAuthority, phase, id, hash string) (bool, error) {
	var storedID, storedHash string
	var authority []byte
	err := func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingReceipt(ctx, sqlcgen.GetHostingReceiptParams{OperationID: a.OperationID, Phase: phase})
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		storedID = row.ReceiptID
		storedHash = row.BodyHash
		authority = row.Authority
		return nil
	}()
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	var old domain.HostingAuthority
	if err = json.Unmarshal(authority, &old); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if old != a || storedID != id || storedHash != hash {
		return false, ErrConflict
	}
	op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, a.OperationID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if op.DatabaseUpgrade != nil {
		if err = databaseUpgradeHistoricalRead(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}

func insertHostingReceipt(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, a domain.HostingAuthority, phase, id string, body any) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	authority, err := json.Marshal(a)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingReceipt(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingReceiptParams{OperationID: a.OperationID, Phase: phase, ReceiptID: id, Authority: authority, Body: raw, BodyHash: domain.HostingDocumentHash(body)})
	return hostingError(err)
}

// HostingPrepared atomically commits immutable preparation evidence or replays its receipt.
func (s *PostgresStore) HostingPrepared(ctx context.Context, runnerID string, in domain.HostingPreparedRequest) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	if in.ReceiptID == "" || len(in.ReceiptID) > 128 || domain.ValidateHostingRelease(in.Release) != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	if err = hostingRequireMode(ctx, tx, in.HostingAuthority, "deploy"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = hostingAuthorityExists(ctx, tx, runnerID, in.HostingAuthority, false); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	replay, err := replayHostingReceipt(ctx, tx, in.HostingAuthority, "prepared", in.ReceiptID, domain.HostingDocumentHash(in.Release))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if replay {
		op, readErr := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, in.OperationID)
		if readErr != nil {
			return op, readErr
		}
		op.TaskMode = "deploy"
		return op, nil
	}
	if err = hostingAuthorityExists(ctx, tx, runnerID, in.HostingAuthority, true); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := hostingOperation(ctx, tx, in.OperationID)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	if op.State != "preparing" && op.State != "prepared" {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if err = hostingFreshRuntimeGate(ctx, tx, op); err == nil {
		err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, false)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.Release != nil {
		if *op.Release != in.Release {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		op.TaskMode = "deploy"
		return op, nil
	}
	if op.Snapshot.Database != (domain.HostingDatabaseExecutionRef{}) {
		if domain.ValidateHostingDatabaseRelease(op.Snapshot, in.Release) != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
	} else if op.Snapshot.LocalBuild != (domain.HostingLocalBuildSource{}) {
		if domain.ValidateHostingSnapshotRelease(op.Snapshot, in.Release) != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
	} else {
		// Supplied digest must match the repository and digest recorded by Docker.
		original, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeHostingImage(op.Snapshot.ImageReference)
		if normalizeErr != nil || in.Release.LocalBuild != (domain.HostingBuildArtifact{}) || !hostingReleaseMatchesSource(original, in.Release.CanonicalImage) {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
	}
	var daemon *string
	var previousRaw []byte
	var hold *string
	if err = func() error {
		row, queryErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingPreparedBinding(ctx, op.BindingID)
		if queryErr != nil {
			return queryErr
		}
		daemon = row.DaemonID
		previousRaw = row.Healthy
		hold = row.HoldOperationID
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if hold != nil || (daemon != nil && *daemon != in.Release.DaemonID) {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	var previous *domain.HostingHealthy
	if len(previousRaw) > 0 {
		if err = json.Unmarshal(previousRaw, &previous); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	var plan domain.HostingApplyPlan
	if op.Snapshot.Database != (domain.HostingDatabaseExecutionRef{}) {
		plan, err = compileHostingStoragePlan(ctx, tx, op, in.Release, previous, nil)
	} else if op.Snapshot.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingOwnedStoragePolicyVersion || op.Snapshot.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingReleasePolicyVersion || op.Snapshot.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingLocalBuildPolicyVersion || op.Snapshot.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingRuntimePolicyVersion || op.Snapshot.PolicyVersion == domain.HostingLocalBuildRuntimePolicyVersion {
		var retained []domain.HostingHealthy
		rows, readErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).GetHostingRetainedReleases(ctx, op.BindingID)
		if readErr != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, readErr
		}
		for _, row := range rows {
			if previous != nil && row.OperationID == previous.OperationID {
				continue
			}
			var old domain.HostingHealthy
			if err = json.Unmarshal(row.Body, &old); err != nil {
				return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
			}
			retained = append(retained, old)
		}
		if op.Snapshot.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) {
			plan, err = compileHostingStoragePlan(ctx, tx, op, in.Release, previous, retained)
		} else if op.Snapshot.LocalBuild != (domain.HostingLocalBuildSource{}) {
			plan, err = domain.CompileLocalBuildHostingPlan(op.Snapshot, in.Release, previous, retained)
		} else {
			plan, err = domain.CompileRetainedHostingPlan(op.Snapshot, in.Release, previous, retained)
		}
	} else {
		plan, err = domain.CompileHostingPlan(op.Snapshot, in.Release, previous)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	releaseRaw, err := json.Marshal(in.Release)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	planRaw, err := json.Marshal(plan)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).ObserveHostingDaemon(ctx, sqlcgen.ObserveHostingDaemonParams{BindingID: op.BindingID, DaemonID: hostingStringPointer(in.Release.DaemonID)}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingRelease(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingReleaseParams{OperationID: op.ID, Body: releaseRaw, BodyHash: in.Release.Hash}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).CreateHostingApplyPlan(ctx, sqlcgen.CreateHostingApplyPlanParams{OperationID: op.ID, Body: planRaw, BodyHash: plan.Hash}); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = insertHostingReceipt(ctx, tx, in.HostingAuthority, "prepared", in.ReceiptID, in.Release); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = hostingPhaseAudit(ctx, tx, s.queries, op, runnerID, "prepared"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if _, err = sqlcgen.New(tx).FinishHostingPreparation(ctx, op.ID); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err = hostingOperation(ctx, tx, op.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	if err = finalLocalHostingAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, in.HostingAuthority, op, false); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = finalHostingRuntimeAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, in.HostingAuthority, op); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.Snapshot.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) {
		if err = finalHostingStorageAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, in.HostingAuthority, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	op.TaskMode = "deploy"
	return op, tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func hostingReleaseMatchesSource(source, canonical string) bool {
	original, err := reference.ParseNormalizedNamed(source)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	resolved, err := reference.ParseNormalizedNamed(canonical)
	if err != nil || reference.TrimNamed(original).Name() != reference.TrimNamed(resolved).Name() {
		return false
	}
	if digest, ok := original.(reference.Digested); ok {
		actual, ok := resolved.(reference.Digested)
		return ok && actual.Digest() == digest.Digest()
	}
	return true
}

// HostingApplyBegin atomically admits mutation after rechecking the target and live lease.
func (s *PostgresStore) HostingApplyBegin(ctx context.Context, runnerID string, a domain.HostingAuthority) (domain.HostingOperation, error) {
	tx, err := s.pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	defer rollbackTransaction(ctx, tx)
	if err = hostingAuthorityExists(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, true); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	op, err := hostingTaskOperation(ctx, tx, a)
	if err != nil {
		return op, err
	}
	storageHeld := op.Snapshot.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) && op.MutationHold && op.State == "prepared"
	if op.Snapshot.Storage != (domain.HostingStorageRef{}) {
		if !op.MutationHold {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		if err = hostingFreshRuntimeGate(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		if err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, false); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		if err = hostingStorageWriterReady(ctx, tx, a, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		if err = finalHostingStorageAuthority(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
	}
	if op.MutationHold && op.State == "applying" && op.CleanupPlan == nil {
		if !hostingOperationPlanMatches(op) {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
		if err = replayHostingApplyAdmission(ctx, tx, a, op); err != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
		}
		return op, nil
	}
	if err = autoFirstMutation(ctx, tx, op.ID, true); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = hostingFreshRuntimeGate(ctx, tx, op); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if err = hostingOperationTargetGate(ctx, tx, op, false); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.CleanupPlan != nil {
		return s.admitHostingCleanup(ctx, tx, runnerID, a, op)
	}
	if err = hostingRequireMode(ctx, tx, a, "deploy"); err != nil {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, err
	}
	if op.Release == nil || !hostingOperationPlanMatches(op) {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if op.Snapshot.Database == (domain.HostingDatabaseExecutionRef{}) && !op.Plan.RetainPrevious {
		referenced, checkErr := sqlcgen.New(tx).HostingReleasePortReferenced(ctx, sqlcgen.HostingReleasePortReferencedParams{DestinationID: op.Snapshot.DestinationID, HostPort: int32(op.Snapshot.HostPort)})
		if checkErr != nil {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, checkErr
		}
		if referenced && op.Snapshot.StorageRouteContinuity == (domain.HostingStorageRouteContinuityRef{}) {
			return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
		}
	}
	if op.State != "prepared" || op.MutationHold && !storageHeld {
		return domain.HostingOperation{}, ErrConflict
	}
	if !storageHeld {
		tag, err := sqlcgen.New(tx).AdmitHostingMutation(ctx, sqlcgen.AdmitHostingMutationParams{BindingID: op.BindingID, HoldOperationID: hostingStringPointer(op.ID), DaemonID: hostingStringPointer(op.Release.DaemonID)})
		if err != nil {
```
