      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateSessionRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Session created. The token is returned once and should be stored by the client.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateSessionResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
    delete:
      summary: Revoke the current session
      operationId: revokeSession
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Session revoked.
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/sessions/revoke:
    post:
      summary: Revoke a local session (system administrator)
      operationId: revokeSessionByID
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RevokeSessionRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Session revoked.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Session"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/browser-sessions:
    post:
      summary: Create a browser session
      operationId: createBrowserSession
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateSessionRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Browser session created. The session credential is set only in the HttpOnly `nerocd_session` cookie.
          headers:
            Set-Cookie:
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/BrowserSessionResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "429":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
    delete:
      summary: Revoke the current browser session
      operationId: revokeBrowserSession
      security:
        - browserSession: []
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Browser session revoked and cookie expired.
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/api-tokens:
    post:
      summary: Create a platform API token
      operationId: createAPIToken
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:

            application/json:

          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":

        required: true

          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"

        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"

      summary: Create a managed service account and first credential
      operationId: createServiceAccount
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/ServiceAccountCreateInput"}}}
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Account created; credential plaintext is returned once.
          content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/CreatedServiceAccount"}}}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}

      operationId: updateServiceAccount
      requestBody:
        required: true

        "200":
          description: Updated service-account metadata.
          content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/ServiceAccount"}}}

        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}

          description: Credential rotated; replacement plaintext is returned once.
          content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/RotatedServiceAccountCredential"}}}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "404": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
  /api/v1/service-accounts/revoke:
    post:
      summary: Revoke a service account and all its credentials
      operationId: revokeServiceAccount
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/ServiceAccountRevokeInput"}}}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Revoked service-account metadata.
          content: {application/json: {schema: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/ServiceAccount"}}}
        "400": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "401": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "403": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
        "404": {$ref: "#/components/responses/Error"}
  /api/v1/users:
    get:
      summary: List safe local user metadata (system administrator)
      operationId: listUsers

        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"

              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/UserOffboardingResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"

      operationId: createRepository
      requestBody:
        required: true

        "201":
          description: Created repository.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Repository"

          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"

        - name: id

        required: true

         application/json:
           schema:

            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/InventoryInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created inventory metadata.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Inventory"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runner-primitive-plan:
    get:
      summary: Get runner primitive plan for a run
      operationId: getRunnerPrimitivePlan
      parameters:
        - name: run_id
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Runner primitive plan.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerPrimitivePlan"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runs:
    get:
      summary: List task runs
      operationId: listRuns
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ProjectID"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Task run list. When `project_id` is supplied, only runs in that project are returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskRunListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
    post:
      summary: Request task run
      operationId: requestRun
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunRequestInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created task run.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskRun"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runs/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get one authorized task run
      operationId: getRun
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Authorized task run detail.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskRun"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runs/approve:
    post:
      summary: Approve a waiting run
      operationId: approveRun
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [run_id]
              properties:
                run_id:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Approved run.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Approval"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runs/reject:
    post:
      summary: Reject a waiting run
      operationId: rejectRun
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [run_id]
              properties:
                run_id:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Rejected approval and canceled run.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Approval"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runs/cancel:
    post:
      summary: Cancel a run
      operationId: cancelRun
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [run_id]
              properties:
                run_id:
                  type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Canceled run.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskRun"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners:
    get:
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      summary: List runners
      operationId: listRunners
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Runner list.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get runner administrative detail
      operationId: getRunner
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Safe runner identity, status, heartbeat, bounded telemetry, tags, and capabilities.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerDetail" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
  /api/v1/runners/register:
    post:
      summary: Register runner
      operationId: registerRunner
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Registered runner and one-time runner token.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerRegistration"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runner-enrollments:
    post:
      summary: Create a one-time runner enrollment
      operationId: createRunnerEnrollment
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerEnrollmentInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Enrollment metadata and the enrollment token returned exactly once.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreatedRunnerEnrollment"
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
  /api/v1/runner-enrollments/revoke:
    post:
      summary: Revoke an unused runner enrollment
      operationId: revokeRunnerEnrollment
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerEnrollmentRevokeInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Revoked enrollment metadata.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerEnrollment" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
  /api/v1/runner-enrollments/consume:
    post:
      summary: Consume an enrollment using its one-time bearer token
      operationId: consumeRunnerEnrollment
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerEnrollmentConsumeInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Bound runner identity. The long-lived credential is generated and retained only by the runner.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ConsumedRunnerEnrollment"
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Error" }
  /api/v1/runners/rotate-token:
    post:
      summary: Rotate runner token
      operationId: rotateRunnerToken
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerTokenInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Rotated runner token. The token is only returned once.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerRegistration"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/revoke-token:
    post:
      summary: Revoke runner token
      operationId: revokeRunnerToken
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerTokenInput"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Revoked runner token and marked runner revoked.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Runner"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/heartbeat:
    post:
      summary: Heartbeat runner
      operationId: heartbeatRunner
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EmptyRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Heartbeat accepted.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Runner"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/telemetry:
    post:
      summary: Report bounded runner operational telemetry
      operationId: reportRunnerOperationalTelemetry
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunnerOperationalTelemetry"
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Latest bounded runner telemetry accepted.
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/claim:
    post:
      summary: Claim queued run
      operationId: claimRun
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EmptyRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Claimed run.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ClaimedRun"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/renew:
    post:
      summary: Renew a fenced runner lease
      operationId: renewRunnerLease
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [lease_id, attempt, fence]
              properties:
                lease_id: {type: string}
                attempt: {type: integer, minimum: 1}
                fence: {type: string}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Lease renewed.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLease"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/lease:
    get:
      summary: Get runner lease status
      operationId: getRunnerLease
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: lease_id
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - in: query
          name: attempt
          required: true
          schema: {type: integer, minimum: 1}
        - in: query
          name: fence
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Runner-scoped lease status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLease"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/logs:
    post:
      summary: Append runner log
      operationId: appendRunnerLog
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLogInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created run log entry.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLog"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/artifacts:
    post:
      summary: Record runner artifact metadata
      operationId: createRunArtifact
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/ArtifactInput"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created artifact record.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ArtifactRecord"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/runners/complete:
    post:
      summary: Complete run lease
      operationId: completeLease
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [lease_id, attempt, fence, completion_key, status]
              properties:
                lease_id:
                  type: string
                attempt:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 1
                fence:
                  type: string
                completion_key:
                  type: string
                status:
                  type: string
                  enum: [succeeded, failed, canceled]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Completed lease.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLease"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/run-logs:
    get:
      summary: List run logs
      operationId: listRunLogs
      parameters:
        - name: run_id
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Optional run identifier filter.
          schema:
            type: string
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Run log list. When `run_id` is supplied, only logs for that run are returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/RunLogListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/artifacts:
    get:
      summary: List run artifact records
      operationId: listRunArtifacts
      parameters:
        - name: run_id
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Run artifact list.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ArtifactListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/approvals:
    get:
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      summary: List approvals
      operationId: listApprovals
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Approval list.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApprovalListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
  /api/v1/audit-events:
    get:
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Limit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/Offset"
      summary: List audit events
      operationId: listAuditEvents
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Audit event list.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuditEventListResponse"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Error"
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: NeroCD session token
      description: CLI session and API token credential.
    browserSession:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: nerocd_session
      description: "Browser-only local session cookie. Unsafe cookie-authenticated requests require X-NeroCD-CSRF: 1."
  parameters:
    ProjectID:
      name: project_id
      in: query
      required: false
      description: Optional project identifier filter.
      schema:
        type: string
    Limit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      required: false
      description: Maximum number of items to return (0-100). Omit to use the bounded default.
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        maximum: 100
    Offset:
      name: offset
      in: query
      required: false
      description: Number of items to skip from the filtered result.
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        maximum: 100000
  responses:
    Error:
      description: Stable error envelope.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
  schemas:
    ServerBootstrapTarget:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "ip"
        - "port"
        - "user"
        - "host_fingerprint"
      properties:
        ip:
          type: "string"
        port:
          type: "integer"
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 65535
        user:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "root"
        host_fingerprint:
          type: "string"
    ServerBootstrapArtifactOption:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "artifact_id"
        - "version"
        - "architecture"
        - "size"
        - "sha256"
        - "profile"
      properties:
        artifact_id:
          type: "string"
        version:
          type: "string"
        architecture:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "arm64"
        size:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
        sha256:
          type: "string"
        profile:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "prepared_debian12_v1"
    ServerBootstrapOptions:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "available"
        - "unavailable_reason"
        - "profile"
        - "preset"
        - "artifacts"
      properties:
        available:
          type: "boolean"
        unavailable_reason:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - ""
            - "disabled"
            - "durable_store_required"
            - "managed_secrets_unavailable"
        profile:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "prepared_debian12_v1"
        preset:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "hosting_image_v1"
        artifacts:
          type: "array"
          items:
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerBootstrapArtifactOption"
    ServerBootstrapCreateInput:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "request_id"
        - "project_id"
        - "name"
        - "target"
        - "ssh_secret_id"
        - "ssh_secret_version"
        - "artifact_id"
      properties:
        request_id:
          type: "string"
          format: "uuid"
        project_id:
          type: "string"
        name:
          type: "string"
        target:
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerBootstrapTarget"
        ssh_secret_id:
          type: "string"
        ssh_secret_version:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
        artifact_id:
          type: "string"
    ServerBootstrapCommandInput:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "command_id"
        - "expected_version"
      properties:
        command_id:
          type: "string"
          format: "uuid"
        expected_version:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
          minimum: 1
    ServerBootstrapReviewInput:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "command_id"
        - "expected_version"
        - "probe_receipt_id"
      properties:
        command_id:
          type: "string"
          format: "uuid"
        expected_version:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
          minimum: 1
        probe_receipt_id:
          type: "string"
    ServerBootstrapInstallInput:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "command_id"
        - "expected_version"
        - "manifest_sha256"
        - "acknowledge_install_and_start"
        - "grant_project"
      properties:
        command_id:
          type: "string"
          format: "uuid"
        expected_version:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
          minimum: 1
        manifest_sha256:
          type: "string"
        acknowledge_install_and_start:
          type: "boolean"
          enum:
            - true
        grant_project:
          type: "boolean"
    ServerBootstrapPrerequisites:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "profile"
        - "os_state"
        - "os_id"
        - "os_version"
        - "architecture"
        - "systemd_state"
        - "systemd_status"
        - "docker_state"
        - "docker_api_version"
        - "compose_state"
        - "compose_version"
        - "disk_state"
        - "disk_total_bytes"
        - "disk_available_bytes"
      properties:
        profile:
          type: "string"
        os_state:
          type: "string"
        os_id:
          type: "string"
        os_version:
          type: "string"
        architecture:
          type: "string"
        systemd_state:
          type: "string"
        systemd_status:
          type: "string"
        docker_state:
          type: "string"
        docker_api_version:
          type: "string"
        compose_state:
          type: "string"
        compose_version:
          type: "string"
        disk_state:
          type: "string"
        disk_total_bytes:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
        disk_available_bytes:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int64"
    ServerBootstrapProbe:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "receipt_id"
        - "prerequisites"
        - "observed_at"
        - "expires_at"
      properties:
        receipt_id:
          type: "string"
        prerequisites:
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ServerBootstrapPrerequisites"
        observed_at:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
        expires_at:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
    ServerBootstrapReview:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "manifest_sha256"
        - "probe_receipt_id"
        - "expires_at"
      properties:
        manifest_sha256:
          type: "string"
        probe_receipt_id:
          type: "string"
        expires_at:
          type: "string"
          format: "date-time"
    ServerBootstrapProgress:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - "command_id"
        - "action"
        - "status"
        - "outcome"
      properties:
        command_id:
          type: "string"
        action:
          type: "string"
          enum:
            - "probe"
            - "review"

          type: "string"

        path_prefix:

        hostname:
          type: "string"

          type: "string"

          type: "integer"
    HostingStorageRouteContinuityInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [expected_loaded_generation, expected_loaded_proxy_operation_id, routes]
      description: Existing opt-in for a same-port storage replacement over the complete loaded own-route scope. All selections are compared again at request and mutation admission.
      properties:
        expected_loaded_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
        expected_loaded_proxy_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        routes:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 32
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [route_id, expected_version, expected_selected_release_operation_id]
            properties:
              route_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
              expected_version: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
              expected_selected_release_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
    HostingStorageRouteContinuityRef:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [hash]
      properties:
        hash: {type: string, pattern: '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'}
    HostingStorageDeploymentOptions:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [resource_id, resource_generation, storage_ref, previous_healthy_operation_id, host_port, container_port, readiness, available, reason, routes, storage_route_continuity]
      properties:
        resource_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        resource_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
        storage_ref:
          anyOf: [{$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageRef"}, {type: "null"}]
        previous_healthy_operation_id: {type: [string, "null"]}
        host_port: {type: [integer, "null"], minimum: 1024, maximum: 65535}
        container_port: {type: [integer, "null"], minimum: 1, maximum: 65535}
        readiness:
          anyOf: [{$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingReadiness"}, {type: "null"}]
        available: {type: boolean}
        reason: {type: string, enum: [available, initial_deployment, unsupported_source, unbound, storage_unconfigured, runtime_configuration_unsupported, no_previous_healthy, stale_storage, restore_hold, busy, runner_ineligible, proxy_unavailable, no_loaded_generation, stale_routes, https_unavailable, foreign_port_reference, continuity_unresolved]}
        routes:
          type: array
          maxItems: 32
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [id, hostname, path_prefix, version, selected_release_operation_id]
            properties:
              id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
              hostname: {type: string}
              path_prefix: {type: string}
              version: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
              selected_release_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        storage_route_continuity:
          description: Copy this existing accepted write field only when available. When available, null means an ordinary redeploy without own public routes.
          anyOf: [{$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageRouteContinuityInput"}, {type: "null"}]
    HostingStorageRouteRecoveryInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [expected_descriptor_hash, expected_complete_receipt_id, expected_complete_receipt_hash]
      properties:
        expected_descriptor_hash:
          type: string
          pattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          description: Exact snapshot.storage_route_continuity.hash from the authorized deployment operation.
        expected_complete_receipt_id:
          allOf: [{$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}]
          description: Exact complete_receipt.id from the authorized deployment operation.
        expected_complete_receipt_hash:
          type: string
          pattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
          description: Exact complete_receipt.body_hash from the authorized deployment operation.
    HostingStorageRouteContinuityStatus:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [resource_id, operation_id, state, reason]
      properties:
        resource_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        state: {type: string, enum: [reserved, unresolved, proxy_pending, loaded, proxy_failed, released]}
        successor_proxy_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        loaded_generation:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 1
          description: Historical generation backed by a committed applied completion receipt. It does not claim current loaded routes, certificate freshness, or HTTPS health.
        reason: {type: string, enum: [pending, reconciliation_required, loaded_historical, released]}
    HostingRouteSwitchOptions:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [resource_id, loaded_generation, routes, targets, available, reason, next_after_operation_id]
      properties:
        resource_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        loaded_generation: {type: [integer, "null"], format: int64, minimum: 1}
        available: {type: boolean}

            properties:

              version: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}

          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 32
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [route_id, before_release_operation_id, after_release_operation_id]
            properties:
              route_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
              before_release_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
              after_release_operation_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}

      type: object
      additionalProperties: false

      properties:
        idempotency_key: {type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128}
        expected_loaded_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
        target_release_operation_id: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        routes:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 32
          uniqueItems: true
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [route_id, expected_version, expected_selected_release_operation_id]
            properties:
              route_id: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}

              expected_selected_release_operation_id: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}

      type: object

      properties:

        prior_applied_proxy_operation_id: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        routes:

          items:
            type: object

            required: [route_id, prior_version, prior_target]
            properties:
              route_id: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
              prior_version: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
              prior_target: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingProxyRouteTarget"}
    HostingProxySnapshot:
      type: "object"
      additionalProperties: false
      required: ["proxy_id", "server_id", "destination_id", "runner_id", "generation", "configuration", "routes"]
      properties:
        verified_switch: {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingVerifiedSwitch"}
        proxy_id:
          type: "string"
        server_id:
          type: "string"
        destination_id:
          type: "string"
        runner_id:

        - path

      properties:
        path:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 1024
          description: >-
            Origin-relative HTTP path without authority, scheme, fragment or controls; redirects are not
            followed.
        timeout_seconds:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 120
    HostingDatabaseReadiness:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      description: Private database snapshots carry no HTTP probe. Authenticated engine readiness belongs to the qualified database runtime.
      required: [path, timeout_seconds]
      properties:
        path: {type: string, enum: [""]}
        timeout_seconds: {type: integer, enum: [0]}
    HostingDeploymentInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - expected_generation
        - idempotency_key
        - container_port
        - readiness
      properties:
        storage_route_continuity: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageRouteContinuityInput"}
        expected_runtime_configuration_generation:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          description: Saved runtime generation to admit. Omitted zero requires an untouched configuration; positive generations require hosting_runtime_env_v1 and image_release_ports_v1. This admission reference does not implement container environment delivery.
        expected_generation:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 1
        idempotency_key:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        container_port:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 65535
        host_port:
          type: integer
          description: Omit or use zero for allocation from the operator-controlled range; requires image_release_ports_v1. Explicit nonzero ports must be available.
          anyOf:
            - enum: [0]
            - minimum: 1024
              maximum: 65535
        readiness:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingReadiness'
    HostingBuildDeploymentInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [build_id, expected_source_generation, expected_generation, idempotency_key, container_port, readiness]
      properties:
        expected_runtime_configuration_generation:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0

        container_port: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 65535}
        host_port:

            "type": "object",
            "nullable": true,
            "maxProperties": 0,
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      }

      {
        "type": "object",

        ],
        "properties": {

    HostingDatabaseDeploymentInput:

    HostingDatabaseExecutionRef:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [engine, recipe_version, configuration_hash]
      properties:
        engine: {type: string, enum: [postgresql, redis]}

        configuration_hash: {type: string, pattern: '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'}
    HostingDatabasePlan:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [reference, network_name, credentials]
      properties:
        reference: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseExecutionRef'}
        network_name: {type: string, pattern: '^ncdn_[0-9a-f]{32}$'}
        credentials:
          type: array
          minItems: 2
          maxItems: 2
          items: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseCredentialRef'}
    HostingSnapshot:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      oneOf:
        - required: [database, storage]
          properties:
            policy_version: {type: string, enum: [database.private.owned-storage.v1]}
            host_port: {type: integer, enum: [0]}
            container_port: {type: integer, enum: [5432, 6379]}
            readiness: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseReadiness'}
          not:
            anyOf:
              - required: [local_build]
              - required: [runtime_configuration]
              - required: [storage_route_continuity]
        - not: {required: [database]}
          properties:
            policy_version:
              type: string
              enum:
                - public-image.loopback.v1
                - public-image.release-ports.v1
                - local-build.release-ports.v1
                - public-image.runtime-env.release-ports.v1
                - local-build.runtime-env.release-ports.v1
                - public-image.owned-storage.release-ports.v1

      required:
        - resource_id
        - image_reference
        - binding_id
        - destination_id
        - server_id
        - runner_id
        - runtime_namespace
        - resource_generation
        - container_port
        - host_port
        - readiness
        - policy_version
      properties:
        database: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseExecutionRef"}
        storage_route_continuity: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageRouteContinuityRef"}
        storage: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingStorageRef'}
        runtime_configuration: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingRuntimeConfigurationRef'}
        local_build: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingLocalBuildSource'}
        resource_id:
          type: string
        image_reference:
          type: string
        binding_id:
          type: string
        destination_id:
          type: string
        server_id:
          type: string
        runner_id:
          type: string
        runtime_namespace:
          type: string
        resource_generation:
          type: integer
          format: int64
        container_port:
          type: integer
        host_port:
          type: integer
        readiness:
          oneOf:
            - {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingReadiness'}
            - {$ref: '#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseReadiness'}
        policy_version:
          type: string
          enum:
            - public-image.loopback.v1
            - public-image.release-ports.v1
            - local-build.release-ports.v1
            - public-image.runtime-env.release-ports.v1
            - local-build.runtime-env.release-ports.v1
            - public-image.owned-storage.release-ports.v1
            - database.private.owned-storage.v1

    HostingApplyPlan:

            - local-build-hosting.v1

            - local-build-hosting.runtime-env.v1

    HostingReceipt:

    HostingResult:

    HostingAuthority:

        lease_id:

    HostingOperation:
      {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "id",
          "project_id",
          "resource_id",
          "binding_id",
          "created_by",
          "state",
          "snapshot",
          "mutation_hold",
          "restore_ownership_held",
          "reconcile_requested",
          "created_at",
          "updated_at"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "project_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "resource_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "binding_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "run_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "reconciliation_run_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "created_by": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "state": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "queued",
              "dispatched",
              "preparing",
              "prepared",
              "applying",
              "verifying",
              "succeeded",
              "failed",
              "canceled",
              "cancel_requested",
              "reconciliation_required"
            ]
          },
          "snapshot": {
            "oneOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingSnapshot"
              },
              {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageArchiveZeroSnapshot"
              }
            ]
          },
          "database_upgrade": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingDatabaseUpgradeProof"
          },
          "cleanup_plan": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingCleanupPlan"
          },
          "release": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingRelease"
          },
          "plan": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingApplyPlan"
          },
          "prepared_receipt": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingReceipt"
          },
          "complete_receipt": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingReceipt"
          },
          "result": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingResult"
          },
          "restore_ownership_held": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "description": "Restored ownership remains blocked until trusted local journal and process recovery proof is supported. Read-only target observation cannot lift this hold."
          },
          "mutation_hold": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "reconcile_requested": {
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "created_at": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "date-time"
          },
          "updated_at": {
            "type": "string",
            "format": "date-time"
          },
          "task_mode": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "deploy",
              "observe",
              "cleanup",
              "backup",
              "restore",
              "recover"
            ]
          },
          "observation_lease": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/RunLease"
          },
          "reconciliation_healthy": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingHealthy"
          },
          "storage_archive": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageArchive"
          }
        },
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "not": {
              "required": [
                "storage_archive"
              ]
            },
            "properties": {
              "snapshot": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingSnapshot"
              },
              "task_mode": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "deploy",
                  "observe",
                  "cleanup"
                ]
              }
            }
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "storage_archive",
              "task_mode"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "snapshot": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HostingStorageArchiveZeroSnapshot"
              },
              "task_mode": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "backup",
                  "restore",
                  "recover"
                ]
              }
            },
            "not": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "required": [
                    "plan"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "release"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "result"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "prepared_receipt"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "cleanup_plan"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "reconciliation_run_id"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "reconciliation_healthy"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "required": [
                    "observation_lease"
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    HostingStorageBackupInput:

        "type": "object",

          },
          "os": {

              "linux"
            ]
          },
          "architecture": {
            "type": "string",

              "arm64"
            ]
          },
          "variant": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              ""
            ]
          },
          "daemon_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "hash": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"
          }
        }
      }
    HostingStorageArchiveLimits:
      {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "archive_bytes",
          "data_bytes",
          "file_bytes",
          "members",
          "depth",
          "path_bytes"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "archive_bytes": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1536,
            "maximum": 1073741824
          },
          "data_bytes": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 1073741824
          },
          "file_bytes": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 1073741824
          },
          "members": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 1000000
          },
          "depth": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 128
          },
          "path_bytes": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 255
          }
        },
        "description": "All six limits are explicit. file_bytes <= data_bytes <= archive_bytes. Zero is never a default or unbounded."
      }
    HostingStorageArchiveBlob:
      {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "backup_id",
          "destination_id",
          "daemon_id",
          "sha256",
          "size_bytes",
          "format"

        "properties": {

          },

          },

            "type": "string"
          },

          },

          },

    HostingStorageArchiveWriterState:
      {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,

      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [runner_id]

          type: array

        created_at: {type: string, format: date-time}

        id: {type: string}
        server_id: {type: string}

        runtime_kind: {type: string, enum: [docker_compose]}
        created_at: {type: string, format: date-time}

        destination_id: {type: string}
        project_id: {type: string}
        granted_by: {type: string}

        revoked_at: {type: string, format: date-time}
    ResourceBindingInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [destination_id]
      properties:
        destination_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
    HostingRuntimeSecretReference:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [secret_id, version]
      properties:
        secret_id: {type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 128, description: "Exact same-project managed secret ID, UTF-8 at most 128 bytes without control or surrounding whitespace"}
        version: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
    HostingRuntimeEntry:
      oneOf:
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [name, kind, value]
          properties:
            name: {type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$', description: "Exact NEROCD_ prefix is reserved"}
            kind: {type: string, enum: [literal]}
            value: {type: string, maxLength: 4096, description: "Explicitly nonsecret viewer-readable literal, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL CR LF; empty allowed"}
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [name, kind, secret]
          properties:
            name: {type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,127}$', description: "Exact NEROCD_ prefix is reserved"}
            kind: {type: string, enum: [managed_secret]}
            secret: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingRuntimeSecretReference"}
    HostingRuntimeConfigurationInput:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [expected_resource_generation, expected_runtime_generation, request_id, entries]
      properties:
        expected_resource_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
        expected_runtime_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0, maximum: 9223372036854775806}
        request_id: {type: string, pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{32}$', description: "Client-generated cryptographically random 128-bit ID retained across retries"}
        entries: {type: array, maxItems: 64, items: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingRuntimeEntry"}, description: "Unique names, at most 16 distinct secret ID/version pairs; sorted by name when saved"}
    HostingRuntimeConfigurationResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [runtime_configuration]
      properties:
        runtime_configuration: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingRuntimeConfiguration"}

      properties:
        resource_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        project_id: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingIdentifier"}
        resource_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 1}
        runtime_generation: {type: integer, format: int64, minimum: 0}
        entries: {type: array, maxItems: 64, items: {$ref: "#/components/schemas/HostingRuntimeEntry"}}
        created_by: {type: string}
        created_at: {type: string, format: date-time}

        - type: object

          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            version: {type: integer, enum: [1]}
            state: {type: string, enum: [configured]}

            allowed_schemes: {type: array, minItems: 1, maxItems: 2, items: {type: string, enum: [https, ssh, http]}}
            allowed_hosts: {type: array, minItems: 1, maxItems: 32, items: {type: string}}
            allowed_cidrs: {type: array, maxItems: 32, items: {type: string}}
            redirect_hosts: {type: array, maxItems: 32, items: {type: string}}
            ssh_host_fingerprints: {type: array, maxItems: 32, items: {type: string}}
            credential_reference_id: {type: string, pattern: '^cred_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,128}$'}
            allow_internal: {type: boolean}

### `web/app/src/router/metadata.ts` lines 1-31

Subject `563fb88f707b75563d03f0408df0267e3af473e9`. Reproduce with `git show 563fb88f707b75563d03f0408df0267e3af473e9:web/app/src/router/metadata.ts` and select lines 1-31.

```text
export type ViewKey = "home" | "runs" | "deployments" | "runners" | "operations" | "approvals" | "projects" | "templates" | "logs" | "audit" | "settings";
export type NavigationGroup = "Hosting" | "Advanced" | "Observe" | "Account";
export type NavigationPath = "/" | `/${Exclude<ViewKey, "home">}`;
export type NavigationItem = { key: ViewKey; to: NavigationPath; label: string; group: NavigationGroup; adminOnly?: boolean; filterable?: boolean };

export const navigationGroups: NavigationGroup[] = ["Hosting", "Advanced", "Observe", "Account"];
export const navigationItems: NavigationItem[] = [
  { key: "home", to: "/", label: "Home", group: "Hosting", filterable: true },
  { key: "deployments", to: "/deployments", label: "Deployments", group: "Advanced", filterable: true },
  { key: "runs", to: "/runs", label: "Runs", group: "Advanced", filterable: true },
  { key: "approvals", to: "/approvals", label: "Approvals", group: "Advanced", filterable: true },
  { key: "projects", to: "/projects", label: "Projects", group: "Hosting", filterable: true },
  { key: "templates", to: "/templates", label: "Templates", group: "Advanced", filterable: true },
  { key: "runners", to: "/runners", label: "Servers and runners", group: "Hosting", filterable: true },
  { key: "logs", to: "/logs", label: "Logs", group: "Observe", filterable: true },
  { key: "audit", to: "/audit", label: "Audit", group: "Observe", filterable: true },
  { key: "operations", to: "/operations", label: "Operations", group: "Observe", adminOnly: true },
  { key: "settings", to: "/settings", label: "Settings", group: "Account" },
];

export function navigationForRoles(roles: readonly string[]): NavigationItem[] {
  return navigationItems.filter((item) => !item.adminOnly || roles.includes("system_admin"));
}

export function navigationForView(view: ViewKey): NavigationItem {
  return navigationItems.find((item) => item.key === view)!;
}

export function viewForPath(pathname: string): ViewKey {
  return navigationItems.find((item) => item.to !== "/" && (pathname === item.to || pathname.startsWith(`${item.to}/`)))?.key ?? "home";
}

import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { join } from "node:path";
function runtimeDir(): string {
  const id = test.info().config.metadata.NEROCD_BROWSER_RUN_ID;
  if (typeof id !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}$/.test(id)) throw new Error("Missing owned browser runtime");
  return join("/tmp", `nerocd-browser-${id}`);
}
async function signIn(page: Page) {
  await page.goto("/");
  const status = await page.request.get("/api/v1/bootstrap-status");
  expect(status.ok()).toBe(true);
  const [email, password] = readFileSync(join(runtimeDir(), "credentials"), "utf8").trim().split("\n");
  if ((await status.json()).status === "required") {
    execFileSync(join(runtimeDir(), "nerocd"), ["bootstrap-admin", "--email", email!, "--name", "Browser Administrator", "--password-file", join(runtimeDir(), "password")], { env: { ...process.env, NEROCD_DATABASE_URL: readFileSync(join(runtimeDir(), "database-url"), "utf8") }, stdio: "pipe" });
    await page.reload();
  }
  await page.getByLabel("Email", { exact: true }).fill(email!); await page.getByLabel("Password", { exact: true }).fill(password!); await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Account", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
}
async function navigation(page: Page, width: number) {
  if (width < 1024) { await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open mobile navigation" }).click(); return page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Mobile navigation", exact: true }); }
  return page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Desktop navigation", exact: true });
}
test("compiled Go UI leads with hosting links and preserves navigation, keyboard access, history and deep links", async ({ page }, info) => {
  test.setTimeout(90_000); await signIn(page);
  for (const width of [320, 390, 430, 1440]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 1000 }); await page.goto("/");
    await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Host an application", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Connect a server", exact: true })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/runners");
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Configure an application", exact: true })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/projects");
    await page.screenshot({ path: info.outputPath(`hosting-home-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
    const nav = await navigation(page, width); expect((await nav.getByRole("link").allTextContents()).slice(0, 3)).toEqual(["Home", "Projects", "Servers and runners"]);

          const deployment: ConnectedDeploymentInput = { expected_generation: latest.generation, expected_runtime_configuration_generation: runtime.runtime_generation, idempotency_key: databaseRequestID(), container_port: Number(port), readiness: { path: readiness, timeout_seconds: Number(timeout) } };

      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">The readiness path is local, such as /health. The server allocates a separate runner-local application port. These actions do not promise public traffic or uninterrupted service. Database redeployment can interrupt database access.</p>
      <label className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" checked={confirmed} disabled={accessPaused || busy} onChange={(event) => setConfirmed(event.target.checked)} /><span>I reviewed the selected database and application settings and approve this request.</span></label>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><Button type="submit" className="h-auto min-h-9 max-w-full min-w-0 whitespace-normal break-words" disabled={Boolean(paused) || conflict || !confirmed || (attempt ? attempt.kind === "maintain" : connection ? connection.state !== "active" || Boolean(connection.hold_operation_id) : !canConnect)}>{attempt?.kind === "connect" ? "Retry identical connection request" : attempt?.kind === "deploy" ? "Retry identical application request" : connection ? "Redeploy connected application" : "Connect database and deploy application"}</Button>
      {connection ? <Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-auto min-h-9 max-w-full min-w-0 whitespace-normal break-words" disabled={Boolean(paused) || conflict || !confirmed || (attempt ? attempt.kind !== "maintain" : connection.state !== "active" || connection.membership_revision < 1 || Boolean(connection.hold_operation_id))} onClick={() => void requestAction("maintain")}>{attempt?.kind === "maintain" ? "Retry identical database request" : "Redeploy connected database"}</Button> : null}</div>
    </form> : <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Project owner access is required for database connection changes.</p>}
    {attempt ? <p className="break-all text-xs">Retained request: {attempt.kind === "connect" ? attempt.body.binding.request_id : attempt.body.idempotency_key}. Settings stay frozen for an identical retry.</p> : null}
    {conflict ? <section className="space-y-2" aria-label="Review changed connection"><p role="status">Nothing was resubmitted. Refresh the recorded connection, then explicitly approve a separate request.</p><Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-auto min-h-9 max-w-full min-w-0 whitespace-normal break-words" disabled={busy || accessPaused} onClick={() => void review()}>Refresh for conflict review</Button><Button type="button" variant="outline" className="h-auto min-h-9 max-w-full min-w-0 whitespace-normal break-words" disabled={!reviewed || busy || accessPaused || status.isError} onClick={() => { setReviewBase(reviewResource); setConflict(false); setAttempt(undefined); setConfirmed(false); setReviewed(false); setError(""); }}>Use refreshed configuration for a new request</Button></section> : null}
    {error ? <p role="alert">{error}</p> : null}{notice ? <p role="status" className="break-all">{notice}</p> : null}
    {status.data === null && !status.isError && !attempt && !busy && !conflict ? <ResourceDeployments resource={resource} writable={legacyWritable} blocked={accessPaused} /> : null}
  </section>;
}
```
